Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is an opportunity to contribute to technology initiatives in a collaborative environment with opportunities for professional growth.

Job Title: Cloud Network Engineer
Location: Remote
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2 - [Not open to C2C or 1099]
Salary Range: $115,000–$165,000 Annually
Experience Required: 10+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card holders, EAD holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. Bright Vision Technologies is unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a Cloud Network Engineer to build, secure, automate, and operate cloud or enterprise infrastructure and platforms. The work focuses on availability, scalability, security, observability, automation, and dependable service operations. The successful candidate will apply practical expertise in TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, VPN, load balancing, AWS VPC/Azure VNet, and network security, work with cross-functional teams, and contribute to reliable, maintainable solutions through the delivery lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, provision, configure, and operate cloud or infrastructure components using approved architecture patterns.
  • Automate repeatable provisioning, deployment, configuration, and operational tasks.
  • Implement security, identity, networking, backup, monitoring, and availability controls.
  • Investigate incidents, capacity issues, vulnerabilities, and performance problems.
  • Maintain runbooks, diagrams, standards, and change records; collaborate across engineering and operations.
Required Qualifications
  • Experience Required: typically 4+ years in a related professional role; exact threshold must match the approved requisition.
  • Practical experience with the role-specific technology stack: TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, VPN, load balancing, AWS VPC/Azure VNet, and network security.
  • Professional experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, or systems operations relevant to the role.
  • Hands-on knowledge of the named cloud, operating-system, container, or automation technologies.
  • Understanding of networking, identity, security, monitoring, and availability fundamentals.
  • Experience with scripting, automation, source control, or infrastructure as code.
  • Ability to troubleshoot infrastructure and production issues methodically.
  • Strong documentation and cross-team collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Additional hands-on depth in TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, VPN, load balancing, AWS VPC/Azure VNet, and network security.
  • Experience with cloud services, automation, and modern delivery practices relevant to the project.
  • Familiarity with secure development, accessibility, governance, or regulatory requirements where applicable.
  • Relevant professional certifications or advanced training in the role’s technology area.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact Venkat Raju at (908) 505-3899. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.
Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

US, Nevada

The SHOW comes alive at MGM Resorts International

Have you ever wondered what it would be like to work in a place full of excitement, diversity, and entertainment? Are you enthusiastic about being a team player in one of the most fascinating industries in the world? At MGM Resorts, we seek individuals like YOU to create unique and show-stopping experiences for our guests.

THE JOB:

It is the primary responsibility of the Senior Manager Accounting to plan and organize resources to perform routine and scheduled functions as well as to respond to business unit questions. The Senior Manager ensures the team is effectively trained in their assigned processes and work products are appropriately reviewed and communication on changes, issues or status are appropriately distributed to affected parties. This role models the core values of the department in their deadlines with others and develops and implements practices that ensure the satisfaction, recognition, and engagement of their team members. The Manager works to ensure processes are operation effectively and efficiently, implementing best practices and improvements in a standardized way across all finance related functions. Responsibilities include ensuring all balance sheet accounts continuously reflect accurate financial position adhering to GAAP and MGM Resorts International corporate accounting policies. All duties are to be performed in accordance with departmental and MGM Resorts policies, practices, and procedures.


THE DAY-TO-DAY:

  • Possesses knowledge of Shared Services and integrates principles into decisions regarding departmental processes, procedures, and projects.
  • Enhance process design across multiple business units to improve scalability and consistency.
  • Recommend strategy and implementation design for new business or increased business volumes and integrate into existing processes.
  • Monitors and drives the LEAN Educated program and training amongst the team, ensuring implementation of continuous improvement ideas and providing recognition.
  • Participates in execution of FSSC strategy for continuous improvements, including influencing the culture within the department to initiate and execute LEAN ideas.
  • Initiates and sponsor qualified processes for automation that support the department’s strategic direction on the use of technology (RPA, AI, etc.).
  • Continuously build, develop and improve operations, processes, and procedures in Shared Services to support strategic direction through the use of technology (RPA, AI, etc.).
  • Develop and manage a changing work environment from the use of automation and digital innovation.
  • Participate and execute technology developments that supports the strategic direction of Shared Services.
  • Builds and develops personnel to continually sustain a high‐quality and high‐performing team. Manage, develop and engage personnel in a way that motivates and encourages elevated level performance while adapting to the demands of a large‐scale company.
  • Supports and manages initiatives and policies for a paperless work environment.
  • Evaluates and enhances financial controls and other risk measurement and mitigation elements. Proactively identifies and evaluates issues and potential problems and provides timely solutions.
  • Manage service level (SLA) expectations, performance metrics and KPIs. Establish goals, monitor key metrics, execute analysis and reporting and enhances processes as needed to ensure compliance.
  • Maintains an understanding of Finance concepts, methods, standards, principles, and technology, and makes sound decisions and recommendations based on that understanding.
  • Understands how the business works and the upstream and downstream activities that impact and are impacted by Finance.
  • Coordinates activities and production of documents for business units/multiple properties and FSSC in response to requests from internal Auditors, independent auditors, and local, state, and federal agencies.
  • Ensure journal entries are recorded to accurately reflect appropriate accrual basis accounting transactions for assigned functions in the correct period including accruals of expenses, accruals of revenue, amortization of prepaid expenses, etc.
  • Maintain all accounting records and ensure practices adhere to MGM Resorts accounting policies and remain standard across all business units.
  • Ensure that Company assets are appropriately protected, including collection of rents, avoidance of excess payments, proper authorization for expenditures.
  • Monitor regulatory business licenses and taxes, property taxes, contractual arrangements and other regulatory reporting requirements are completed and/or paid on a timely basis.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:

  • Have a Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Management
  • Has 2+ Years of prior relevant experience in Supervisory and relevant experience
  • Advanced knowledge of general accounting principles, accounting practices and theories - Preferred
  • Advanced experience and knowledge of PC computer software programs (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Access or equivalent) - Preferred
  • Previous knowledge and experience with MGM Resorts International gaming and financial systems (Tandem, CMS, Machine Accounting, CBS, Bravo Poker, XpertX, MLife, Showcase Strategy, Oracle, Archtics, Infogenesis, Coupa, OnBase, Opera, YARDI, AMT Direct, Cognos BI) - Preferred
  • Bilingual, English as the primary or secondary language - Preferred
  • Previous experience working in a similar resort or Financial Shared Services Center setting - Preferred

THE PERKS & BENEFITS:

  • Wellness incentive programs to help you stay healthy physically and mentally
  • Access to company hotel, food and beverage, retail, and entertainment discounts as well as discounts with company partners on things like travel, electronics, online shopping, and more
  • Free parking on and off shift
  • Health & Income Protection benefits (for eligible employees)
  • Professional and personal development through programs and networking opportunities as well as volunteer opportunities in the community

raw.description:
At 2U, we are all in on purpose. We are motivated by our mission – to eliminate the back row in education – and connected by our shared passion to deliver world-class digital education at scale. As the parent company of edX, the world’s leading online learning platform, 2U powers more than 4,000 online higher education offerings – from free courses to full degrees. Together with more than 230 colleges, universities, and corporate partners, we are helping to unlock human potential.

What We’re Looking For:

We are seeking a highly motivated and intellectually curious Senior Product Support Specialist to join our dynamic team. In this pivotal role, you will provide guidance to specialists taking incoming calls, chats or emails from students and faculty; addressing both technical and non-technical inquiries with a white-glove service approach. Your role extends beyond troubleshooting, as you will collaborate closely with other teams to report and analyze bugs, features, and ticket trends, contributing to continuous improvement in our services. You will also be responsible for effectively managing and escalating cases related to faculty or students, ensuring swift and accurate resolutions. This role is essential in maintaining and enhancing the quality of support we offer, making a direct impact on our learning community's success and satisfaction.

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To:

  • Customer and Technical Support: Provide comprehensive customer and technical support for students and faculty issues. This includes real-time monitoring of support channels to ensure coverage, and ensuring a positive user experience.
  • Team Leadership and Training: Lead and train the team, assist with new hire onboarding, and coordinate with external departments for technical challenges and needs.
  • Process Improvement and Analysis: Develop and implement initiatives for department efficiency, streamline processes, participate in root cause analysis, and communicate findings.
  • Technical Expertise and Troubleshooting: Master tools like Zoom and Learning Management Systems. Troubleshoot technical issues in coordination with technical teams and stay updated with emerging web technologies.
  • Collaboration and Project Management: Work with internal stakeholders, representing the Support organization, and develop subject-matter expertise. Contribute to support ticket handling and resolution with an emphasis on empathy and quality service.

Things That Should Be In Your Background:

  • 5+ years of experience in customer support, technical support, or related fields.
  • Experience with ticketing or case management systems (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce).
  • Solid technical acumen, including proficiency with Google and/or Microsoft environments.
  • Strong leadership and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to multitask, work under pressure, and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with a customer-first mindset.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Flexibility to work evening and weekend hours as needed.
  • Project management and time management skills.
  • Fluent in simplifying and translating technical concepts for varied audiences.

Other Attributes That Will Help You In This Role:

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
  • Experience with JIRA and Confluence is a plus.
  • Experience in utilizing data to assess the health and productivity of a team.
  • Experience in supporting online higher education degrees or certificate programs.
  • Multilingual abilities.
  • Enthusiasm for continuous learning and adaptability in a fast-paced environment.

Working Conditions

This role supports a 24/7 global operation and requires schedule and location flexibility under a rotational shift agreement, which may include irregular hours and rotating weekends (no more than one per month) as needed to meet business requirements.

Benefits & Culture

Our global employee base is a diverse collection of innovators, dreamers, and doers working together to transform lives through higher education. We believe that every employee can advance our shared purpose, and that life at 2U should be fun and meaningful. If you’re excited by the opportunity to provide over 40 million learners and counting with access to world-class online higher education, then join us – and do work that makes a difference. #NoBackRow

We offer comprehensive benefits (unique per country) and excellent work/life balance.

Full-time, ZA benefits include:

  • 2 complimentary Getsmarter short courses per year
  • Subsidised medical aid with Discovery Health Medical Scheme
  • 4% 2U contribution towards Discovery Life Pension Fund and Group Risk Benefit
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous leave policy including time off to volunteer for non-profit organization, study leave, sports leave and a company-wide festive season break

2U Diversity and Inclusion Statement

At 2U, we are committed to building and sustaining a culture of belonging, respect, and inclusion. We are proud of the steps we’ve taken to bring together an employee base that embodies diverse walks of life, ideas, genders, ages, races, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities and other unique qualities. We strive to offer a workplace where every employee feels empowered by what makes us different, as well as by how we are alike.

2U is committed to providing reasonable accommodations during our recruitment process. If you need assistance or accommodations, please reach out to us at: .

About 2U, Inc.

For more than a decade, 2U, Inc. has been the digital transformation partner of choice to great non-profit colleges and universities delivering high-quality online education at scale. As the parent company of edX, a leading global online learning platform, 2U provides over 45 million learners with access to world-class education in partnership with more than 230 colleges, universities, and corporations. Our people and technology are powering more than 4,000 digital education offerings — from free courses to full degrees — and helping unlock human potential. To learn more: visit 2U.com.

About edX

edX is the education movement for restless learners and a leading global online learning platform from 2U, Inc. Together with the majority of the world’s top-ranked universities and industry-leading companies, we bring our community of over 45 million learners world-class education to support them at every stage of their lives and careers, from free courses to full degrees. And we're not stopping there — we're relentlessly pursuing our vision of a world where every learner can access education to unlock their potential, without the barriers of cost or location. Learn more at edX.org.

Learn more at

raw.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm’s Identity team is mission-critical to the customer checkout experience. When a customer chooses Affirm, one of the first steps is an identity check, and our ability to make the right decision directly impacts conversion, revenue, fraud exposure, and regulatory compliance. Our team owns Identity for all markets outside North America, playing a key role in Affirm’s international expansion. We are responsible for KYC, user lifecycle management, and identity decisioning across multiple regulatory environments. This work is about shaping how Affirm adapts its core Identity platform to new market dynamics, customer expectations, and compliance requirements.

We are a team of six engineers based across Spain and Poland. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can turn ambiguous business and customer problems into reliable, well-designed technical solutions.

In this role, you will help shape our quarterly technical direction, translate team goals into concrete projects, and identify cross-cutting risks, tradeoffs, and opportunities. You should be comfortable designing across system boundaries, driving collaboration with partner teams, and advocating for technical investments that improve long-term execution. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership beyond shipping code: raising code quality and review standards, making performance, availability, and scale tradeoffs explicit, and improving the operational health of the systems they own. You’ll help reduce toil, create useful playbooks, mentor engineers, support new hires and interns, and contribute to high-signal hiring.

Most importantly, we’re excited to work with someone who leaves things better than they found them, communicates clearly across audiences, uses customer feedback to influence technical plans, and helps the team continuously improve.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on coding role where feature velocity and operational excellence go hand-in-hand. You’ll spend most of your week in the codebase - leveraging AI tools to write robust Kotlin and Python, ship impactful features, investigate complex production issues, and keep our systems rock-solid and reliable. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for someone who wants to work on foundational systems that directly enable Affirm’s global growth.

What You'll Do

· You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.
· You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
· You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.
· You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
· You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
· You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

· On-Call Rotation - There would be an on-call rotation for this role as a requirement.

What We Look For

· You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
· You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.
· You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
· You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.
· Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
· You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

Compensation & Benefits

Pay Grade - N

Equity Grade - 4

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

ESP base pay range per year: €86,000 - €122,000

Additional benefits include:
• Flexible Spending Wallets for tech, food and lifestyle
• Away Days - wellness days to take off work and recharge
• Learning & Development programs
• Parental benefits

• Employee Resource & Community Groups

Location - Remote Spain

We are able to offer visa sponsorship for this role, but do require that someone is based in Spain for the role.

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

Role Title: Hematology Physician

Role Type: Contractor

Location: United States, Remote

micro1 is engaging Hematology Physicians to participate in a high-impact customer project focused on advancing clinical AI solutions. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. This opportunity is ideal for independent clinical experts interested in leveraging their hematology experience for transformative technology.

Scope of Work

  1. Review and annotate AI Generated transcripts of outpatient hematology clinic conversations for accuracy, clinical completeness, and clarity.
  2. Assess AI Generated documentation sections such as History of Present Illness (HPI), interval histories, and Assessment & Plans (A&Ps), providing input on appropriate information inclusion.
  3. Identify and comment on nuances of anticoagulation management, transfusion and iron therapy, treatment toxicities, laboratory discussions, and decision-making processes in clinical documentation.
  4. Provide feedback on how well AI Generated transcripts reflect real-world clinical reasoning and patient interactions, especially during follow-up visits.
  5. Contribute to the evaluation and improvement of AI scribe outputs or EHR note templates, as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Board certification in Hematology or Oncology with demonstrable outpatient clinical experience.
  2. Proficiency with electronic health records (EHR) and clinical documentation workflows.
  3. Deep familiarity with chemotherapy cycle management and hematologic malignancy care.
  4. Experience in crafting or reviewing patient histories, including histories of present illness and differential diagnosis.
  5. Strong attention to detail and ability to communicate complex concepts clearly in both written and spoken formats.
  6. Previous participation in clinical research, quality improvement, or AI/data-driven healthcare projects is a plus.
  7. Motivation to support innovative healthcare projects with real-world impact.

Role type: Contractor

Location: Remote, United States only

Commitment: Part-time, project-based

Compensation: $160–$180 USD per hour

About the role

micro1 is looking for experienced Medical Oncologists to support a customer project focused on improving AI-generated clinical documentation.

In this role, you'll use your clinical expertise to evaluate AI-generated transcripts and medical notes from outpatient oncology encounters. Your feedback will help improve the accuracy, completeness, and clinical relevance of AI-assisted documentation.

What you'll do

  1. Review AI-generated transcripts of outpatient oncology visits for clinical accuracy, completeness, and clarity.
  2. Evaluate clinical documentation, including History of Present Illness (HPI), interval histories, and Assessment and Plans (A&Ps).
  3. Identify inaccuracies or missing details related to cancer diagnoses, staging, treatment plans, and laboratory or imaging findings.
  4. Assess documentation of systemic cancer therapies, including chemotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapies, and supportive care.
  5. Review how clinical notes capture treatment responses, adverse effects, disease progression, and follow-up care.
  6. Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve AI-generated clinical notes and EHR documentation.

Required qualifications

  1. MD, DO, or equivalent medical degree, with board certification or eligibility in Medical Oncology.
  2. At least 2 years of recent outpatient medical oncology experience following fellowship.
  3. Strong clinical experience diagnosing and managing solid tumors, including treatment planning and longitudinal patient care.
  4. Proven ability to independently document HPIs, interval histories, and Assessment and Plans.
  5. Solid understanding of systemic cancer therapies, treatment-related toxicities, supportive care, and interpretation of laboratory and imaging results.
  6. Strong written communication skills and attention to clinical detail.
  7. Based in the United States.

Preferred qualifications

  1. Experience managing a broad range of solid tumors and complex oncology cases.
  2. Familiarity with AI scribe technology, EHR documentation templates, medical chart review, or clinical annotation projects.

Application process

Candidates will complete an AI interview to assess their relevant clinical expertise and experience.

About micro1

micro1 is a data lab that connects professionals with opportunities to apply their expertise to customer projects. We work with specialists across fields such as engineering, finance, healthcare, and law to support AI labs and enterprises. Through our extended network, contributors bring their knowledge and judgment to projects with their own scope, requirements, and engagement terms.

raw.description:
Are you ready to make a real impact on the world of robotics? At Teradyne Robotics, a division of Teradyne, we are revolutionizing industries through cutting-edge collaborative and autonomous mobile robotic technologies. As part of our team, you’ll work with global leaders Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), driving innovation that enhances manufacturing, logistics and workplaces across the world.

Our Purpose:

TERADYNE, where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity and diversity of thought and in our workforce. Our employees are supported to innovate and learn something new every day. Teradyne Robotics, comprised of Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), is a leading provider of collaborative robots (cobots) and autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) used in a variety of industries, including manufacturing, logistics, electronics assembly, and warehousing.

We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results.

Opportunity Overview:

The Technical SBM Lead (Supply Base Management Lead) is the senior technical person for Robotics supply base management and reports to the Senior Director of Technical Sourcing. You need an engineering background. You work with Robotics engineering on the technology roadmap for navigation, precision motion, gears, motors, plastics, sheet metal, and batteries, and you need to know those designs well enough to tell whether a supplier can build the part the way it is drawn.

You get the preferred supplier into the design while it is still open, and you agree the quality requirements with engineering before the part is released. You work cost, capacity, and the award with the commercial lead. You give them the technical fit, what the part should cost, and a supplier that can manufacture the design.

You bring Robotics technical sourcing up to the same standard as the rest of Teradyne. When a supplier or a design misses the requirement, you lead the root cause with engineering and the supplier and use what you find on the next design. After release, you stay on that quality requirement with the supplier.

Essential Functions / Responsibilities

  • Co-author the technology roadmap with Robotics engineering for navigation, precision motion, gears, motors, plastics, sheet metal, and batteries.
  • Lead supplier and technology selection during development so engineering designs with the preferred supplier the first time.
  • Be the SBM leader for Robotics on how the product is designed with suppliers.
  • Refine and implement the technical plan already in motion. Hold the lane between design-in and the commercial book.
  • Work with Enterprise teams to align process best practices.
  • Lead and participate in root cause investigations with engineering and the supplier, and drive the corrective action to the cause.
  • Use root cause findings to strengthen the technology roadmaps.
  • Lead proactive quality with Robotics engineering. Choose the supplier, the process, and the checks before the design is released, and hold that quality with the supplier afterward in partnership with Supplier quality.
  • Judge technical fit with engineering before the commercial lead makes the award.
  • Partner with the commercial lead on supplier selection so the award holds the technical fit, the cost, and the scale.

All About You:

We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.

  • An engineering degree is highly preferred. A seasoned supply-chain leader who has sat with engineering on supplier and technology selection can still qualify.
  • A senior leader, with strong executive presence to represent SBM with robotics leadership.
  • 15 years of work experience in a complex product company, including leadership of technical sourcing, commodity management, supply base management, or another senior supply-chain seat that has sat with engineering.
  • The ideal person has worked in design and in operations with a strong financial acumen.
  • Experience selecting suppliers with engineering during new product development, including technology choices that reached production.
  • Experience leading root cause investigations with engineering and suppliers, and a record of turning the finding into a design or supplier change before the next release.
  • Working knowledge of mechanical and electromechanical parts, including precision motion, gears, motors, plastics, sheet metal, batteries, or navigation (Cameras, Lidar, and similar) hardware.
  • Experience influencing senior leaders inside the company and at suppliers.
  • Clear communication with engineering, suppliers, and senior leaders.
  • Preferred location is North Reading, Massachusetts. US remote and Odense, Denmark are also open.
  • Travel to the other site and to suppliers, US based up to 30%

Compensation:

The base salary range for this role is $142,000 - $227,200. This range is a good faith estimate, and the amount of base salary will correspond with experience and skill set. This range can also fluctuate depending on demand and location.

Incentive Plan:

This job is eligible for discretionary bonus(es) based on financial performance.

Benefits:

Teradyne offers a variety of robust health and well-being benefit programs, including medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance, paid vacation & holidays, tuition assistance programs, and more. Please click 2027 Benefit Information for US Employees | Teradyne to see details.

With over 1,200 employees worldwide, Teradyne Robotics provides a global, fast paced and highly innovative working environment. If you are passionate about working with cutting-edge robotics, solving complex challenges and collaborating with motivated colleagues across the world, this is the place for you.

We offer a dynamic environment that fosters creativity, growth, and career advancement. If you’re passionate about cutting-edge technology, solving complex challenges, and building the future alongside talented, forward-thinking colleagues—this is the place for you. Let’s change the way the world works together.

Job Description:

GDIT has an opportunity for an ICAM Radiant Logic Identity Data Management Engineer supporting a large line of business that delivers enterprise-scale Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) capabilities. This role supports the DoW ICAM mission by designing, developing, integrating, and maintaining Identity Data Management capabilities that enable identity services to operate across enterprise, mission partner, tactical, and edge environments.

This position is fully remote.


Meaningful Work and Personal Impact:

The ideal candidate is a senior hands-on ICAM engineer with expertise in Radiant Logic or a similar identity governance and identity data management platforms. Focuses on identity lifecycle management, entitlement governance, role management, identity correlation, authoritative data integration, and extending identity services beyond traditional enterprise boundaries to support distributed and disconnected operational environments.


HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

  • Design, develop, configure, and maintain Radiant Logic RadiantOne FID solutions supporting DoD enterprise ICAM requirements
  • Develop and customize Radiant Logic components, including workflows, rules, connectors, aggregation logic, and provisioning policies
  • Engineer solutions that extend identity governance and identity data management services to mission partners, tactical users, and edge computing environments.
  • Develop and maintain integrations between authoritative data sources, identity repositories, directories, and downstream applications.
  • Support Joiner, Mover, Leaver (JML) processes, access requests, approvals, certifications, and entitlement management capabilities.
  • Support enterprise role management, access governance, Segregation of Duties (SoD), and compliance monitoring initiatives.
  • Design and support identity synchronization and identity distribution mechanisms supporting disconnected, intermittent, low-bandwidth, and mission-partner environments.
  • Collaborate with customer stakeholders to onboard applications and identity sources into enterprise and edge ICAM ecosystems.
  • Support implementation of Zero Trust and identity-centric security initiatives through governance, authoritative identity management, and access controls.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues involving identity aggregation, provisioning, entitlement management, identity correlation, and identity data services.
  • Develop technical documentation including architecture diagrams, SOPs, TTPs, deployment guides, and operational procedures.
  • Participate in Agile development activities and support continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Actively manage technical risks and contribute to mission readiness objectives.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED (Required):

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree. An additional 4 years of experience may be substituted in lieu of degree.
  • Clearance: Minimum of an active Secret security clearance.
  • Certification: 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification (Security+ CE or higher).
  • Experience: 10+ years’ experience supporting Identity and Access Management (IAM), Identity Data Management, or ICAM solutions within government or regulated environments

Technical Skills:

  • Strong experience with Radiant Logic, RadiantOne, or equivalent identity data management and virtual directory technologies.
  • Experience integrating identity platforms with Active Directory, LDAP directories, HR systems, enterprise applications, and authoritative data sources.
  • Experience supporting identity lifecycle management, access certifications, entitlement governance, role modeling, and Segregation of Duties (SoD) controls.
  • Experience supporting identity correlation, identity reconciliation, identity aggregation, and identity data quality management.
  • Experience designing or supporting identity services in distributed, federated, or mission-partner environments.
  • Experience with Java, XML, SCIM APIs, REST APIs, LDAP queries, or similar technologies used to support identity platforms.
  • Experience supporting Linux and/or Windows Server environments.
  • Experience deploying and supporting enterprise COTS products in secure customer environments.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments and utilizing associated tools.

Desired Skills (Preferred):

  • Experience with Radiant Logic synchronization, identity analytics, identity correlation, and Master User Record (MUR) implementations.
  • Experience supporting DoW Enterprise ICAM, authoritative identity services, or enterprise identity data management initiatives.
  • Experience supporting disconnected, intermittent, low-bandwidth (DDIL) operational environments.
  • Experience implementing identity solutions supporting tactical, coalition, mission partner, or edge-computing use cases.
  • Experience implementing enterprise role management, ABAC, and attribute synchronization capabilities.
  • Experience supporting identity data replication and synchronization across geographically distributed environments.
  • Experience with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust Architecture, NIST 800-63, and DoW ICAM reference architectures.
  • Experience supporting enterprise reporting, analytics, and governance capabilities using identity data.

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE

At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

  • Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities
  • Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals
  • Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off
  • Flexibility: Full-flex work week to own your priorities at work and at home
  • Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace
  • OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY Explore a career in software development at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your dedication to advancing innovation.

Our mission is to cut through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates, ensuring they have the tools to make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

We are a high-growth, intense, and heart-led team. Ardent isn’t a place to coast; it’s a place to redefine the patient experience through urgency, precision, and empathy.

About the Role

As a Care Advisor I, you will serve as the operational backbone of the patient journey. This is a hybrid role that blends high-touch customer support with rigorous backend operations. You will be the human voice and heart of our service, supporting patients and healthcare advocates via phone, email, and chat.

Your goal is to handle escalated patient inquiries that require thoughtful problem-solving and relationship management.

This role focuses on addressing complex patient concerns, processing sensitive requests, and preserving patient relationships during challenging interactions. You aren’t just answering questions; you are orchestrating a seamless workflow between clinical teams, advocates, and patients to ensure world-class outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Omnichannel Support: Resolve inquiries to complete satisfaction via phone, email, and chat, acting as the primary point of contact for members throughout their journey.
  • Operational Execution: Manage the backend tasks required to move members through healthcare processes, including appointment confirmations, medical information retrieval, and troubleshooting.
  • Relationship Management: Build strong, empathetic bonds with clients and advocates, navigating tough conversations with grace and a solution-oriented mindset.
  • Process Improvement: Identify bottlenecks or "friction points" in the customer journey and collaborate with leadership to implement automation or workflow optimizations.
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Act as a natural troubleshooter, guiding users through basic browser, mobile app, or connectivity issues related to the platform.
  • Data & Feedback: Meticulously document all interactions in the CRM and track feedback to help our partners build a world-class experience.
  • Liaison & Coordination: Facilitate quick resolutions for site-specific issues and ensure seamless handoffs between clinical teams and advocates.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Experience: 1–3 years of experience in customer service, healthcare advocacy, or BPO operations.
  • Empathy as a Superpower: You thrive on helping people from all walks of life and are comfortable forming quick bonds with clients, even when they are upset or stressed.
  • Technical Fluency: You are a quick learner with computers, CRM systems (like Salesforce or Zendesk), and digital communication tools.
  • Operational Curiosity: You don’t just follow a script; you want to understand the "why" behind the process and suggest better ways to get things done.
  • Reliability: You are disciplined in a remote environment, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced "startup" atmosphere.
  • Mission-Driven: A genuine passion for healthy living and a desire to help people navigate the complexities of the healthcare system.

Requirements & Work Environment

  • Remote Work-Home: Enjoy the flexibility of a 100% remote role with the support of an established, connected team.
  • Work Hours: Ability to work full-time including evenings and weekends
  • Education: High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Internet: Must have a high-speed, stable internet connection with a router capable of a wired (plug-in) connection and speeds of 100 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload.
  • Workspace: A dedicated, distraction-free home office space.
  • Location: Must be based in Douglas (Roseburg), Josephine (Grants Pass), Jackson (Medford), or Coos (Coos Bay) Counties in Oregon.

Perks and Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance plans.
  • Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays.
  • Recognition & Rewards: Monthly and quarterly performance awards for those who consistently exceed KPIs and deliver exceptional care.
  • Employee Referral Program: Earn potential significant bonuses for bringing top-tier talent into the Ardent Outsourcing Services family.
  • Growth: Access to continuous coaching, professional development, and a culture that emphasizes learning from mistakes.
  • Paid Training Program: A robust onboarding experience to set you up for success with our systems and platforms.

Up for the challenge? We’re looking for someone with heart, grit, and a "get it done" mentality. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, we look forward to meeting you.

This job description is intended to convey the general nature and scope of the role. Responsibilities may evolve based on business need. Ardent is an equal opportunity employer.

Salary: $17.00

Bring people together. Turn innovation into impact.

What if your ability to connect people, understand complex challenges and turn ideas into action could help shape the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing?

At BioPhorum, we bring together experts from across the global biopharmaceutical industry to collaborate on shared challenges and drive meaningful change. Working with more than 150 organisations, including 18 of the world's 20 largest biopharmaceutical companies, our network of over 7,000 experts is helping shape the future of the industry.

We are looking for a Global Change Facilitator to join our Synthetic Molecule Process Innovation Phorum, bringing together industry experts to accelerate innovation in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

From chemical APIs, peptides and oligonucleotides to advanced manufacturing technologies, digital transformation and sustainable processing, this is an opportunity to help tackle some of the industry's biggest challenges and turn collective expertise into practical solutions.

  • Lead collaborative workstreams: Bring industry experts together, agree priorities and guide initiatives towards meaningful outcomes.
  • Facilitate and influence: Lead engaging discussions and workshops, draw out specialist knowledge and help diverse stakeholders reach agreement.
  • Drive projects forward: Establish clear objectives, manage deliverables and maintain momentum across multiple initiatives.

  • Deliver industry impact: Work with members to develop guidance, frameworks, publications, business cases and proof of concepts.

We are looking for someone who combines a scientific understanding with strong project management and stakeholder engagement skills.

Monday, January 04, 2027

If Temporary or Visiting, Estimated End Date

Position Duties

Provide information and counsel to prospective and current graduate students. This role is instrumental in the recruitment of prospective graduate students. Determine eligibility for and award financial aid in accordance with Federal, state, and institutional policies. Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and institutional legislation, regulations, and policies. Manage programs and special projects as assigned by department leadership. Assist with communication, technology and reporting. Serves as back-up to the Director of Graduate Financial Aid.

Essential Functions


Manage all aspects of a graduate student caseload including file review and application processing, verification, and awarding in accordance with Federal, state, and institutional guidelines. Counsel prospective and enrolled graduate students and community members on all aspects of financial aid including eligibility, application procedures, charges, loan processing, return of funds, satisfactory academic progress, and information resources. Ensure an outstanding customer experience. Respond to prospective and enrolled graduate student inquiries and concerns promptly and professionally. Facilitate graduate student aid issue resolution (e.g. student loan rejects at COD, ATB, loan default, and citizenship).

Manage Title IV awarding including Federal Direct Loans and TEACH Grant, in accordance with federal regulations and institutional policy. Ensure compliance with Title IV regulations, including maintenance of accurate records for audits and program reviews. Manage Common Origination & Disbursement and National Student Loan Data System for program reporting. Conduct periodic internal review of system records to ensure program integrity. Assist with reconciling Title IV programs. Provide outreach and resources to students related to financial literacy and Federal aid programs.


Provide direct support to Director of Graduate Financial Aid. Responsibilities include assisting with report creation, communication management, troubleshooting, and offering technical assistance to the Director as needed. Develop and implement communication strategies for the Graduate Financial Aid unit. Serve as a liaison to key university offices to support integrated service delivery. Perform data analysis including the ability to create charts, graphs, spreadsheets, and reports and make recommendations for improvement. Assist in the management of technology and resources to streamline and improve processes, reporting, and service to students. Assist in developing and implementing plans and goals for the department. Ensure compliance with regulations and internal policies.


Manage special projects or programs vital to the administration of financial aid. Assume leadership and support various office programs and assignments including, but not limited to, recruiting special populations, managing satisfactory academic progress, monitoring Federal aid eligibility, etc. Participate in the recruitment of prospective graduate students and programs focused on retention and customer satisfaction. Provide financial aid presentations to both prospective and enrolled graduate students. Participate in University-sponsored recruitment events, orientation, and university presentations.


Performs all other duties and responsibilities as assigned or directed by the supervisor. This may include attendance of and participation in required training for role.


Physical/Environmental Demands


Office environment/no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands.


Physical/Environmental Example


N/A


Additional Information


N/A

Education Required


Bachelor's degree


Required Certifications/Licensures


No Required Certifications


Work Experience


5 - 8 years


Describe Required Experience


At least 5 years of experience with financial aid or similarly related experience. Closely related experience could include, career counseling, non-profit roles involving financial assistance, higher education administration, admissions, and/or student affairs support services.


Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities


Ability to understand, interpret, and synthesize information from students/parents to effectively counsel

Ability to diffuse difficult and emotional situations

Able to handle multiple tasks or projects at one time meeting assigned deadlines

Working knowledge of state program rules and regulations, as they pertain to financial aid.

Working knowledge of Title IV rules and regulations, as they pertain to Federal Student Financial Aid

Working knowledge of and abides by the regulations of Family Education Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA)

Excellent interpersonal, initiative, teamwork, problem solving, independent judgment, organization, communication (verbal and written), time management, project management and presentation skills

Proficient with computer applications and programs associated with the position (i.e. Microsoft Office suite, Colleague, Workday, Slate, PowerFaids).

Strong attention to detail and follow up skills

Strong customer service skills and phone and e-mail etiquette

Ability to work autonomously and as part of a team.

Final compensation offers are determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to, job-related experience, internal equity, and alignment with organizational budget.

Successful candidates for any staff, faculty, or administrative position at Loyola University Maryland will be subject to a pre-employment background check. Note: Experience and/or education may be substituted for requirements.

Employment Eligibility

All candidates must be eligible to work in the United States and complete employment eligibility verification by the first day of employment at Loyola University Maryland, as required by law (e.g., Form I-9). Unless explicitly stated otherwise in the job description or job advertisement, Loyola University Maryland does not sponsor employment visas for this position.

University Description

Founded in Baltimore, Maryland in 1852, Loyola University Maryland is a Jesuit, Catholic university and the first institution of higher learning in the United States to bear the name of the founder of the Society of Jesus, Saint Ignatius Loyola. The University inspires students to learn, lead, and serve in a diverse and changing world.


At Loyola, the ideals that have guided Jesuit universities for nearly 500 years—academic excellence, care for the whole person, service, justice, diversity, and integrity, among others—continue to mold the academic, social, and spiritual experiences we offer our roughly 5,000 undergraduate and graduate students, the programs we pursue, and the relationships we build with our surrounding communities. Loyola offers a variety of undergraduate, graduate, and certificate programs through its three schools: the Sellinger School of Business and Management, the School of Education, and Loyola College, the University’s school of arts and sciences.


The benefits of Loyola’s Jesuit, liberal arts experience lead to a life-long approach of learning, questioning, and critical analysis that prepare our alumni for—and set them apart in—the workforce and the world.


The Wall Street Journal ranked Loyola No. 19 overall in the nation in its 2026 “Best Colleges” list. Loyola was also ranked No. 5 in the nation for career preparation, No. 22 in the nation for student experience, and No. 65 in the nation for impact on graduate salaries. U.S. News & World Report has ranked Loyola among the top 10 universities in the North Region for more than a decade. The Princeton Review named it one of the nation’s top institutions for undergraduate higher education and one of the best Mid-Atlantic colleges for 2027. It is among Washington Monthly’s top master’s universities nationally and is listed among the “best value” private colleges in Kiplinger’s Personal Finance.


Learn more about some of the prestigious rankings and notable accoladesthat Loyola University Maryland has earned from major national, international, and regional reports, studies, and surveys.

Diversity Statement

Loyola University Maryland strongly values the benefits that diversity brings to the workplace. In accord with its Ignatian values, the University is committed to creating and promoting a community that recognizes the inherent value and dignity of each person. Loyola University Maryland does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, military status, or any other legally protected classification. The University recruits, hires, and promotes in accord with this policy and its Core Values.

Founded in 2017, NinjaHoldings works to give everyday Americans better access to financial services than traditional institutions typically provide. Through our CreditNinja and NinjaCard brands, we offer digital banking and lending products designed for consumers often overlooked, paired with incentives that support long-term financial improvement. Our Edge brand extends this expertise to other companies, providing underwriting, fraud detection, and analytics services. Headquartered in Chicago with a distributed global workforce, we are a lean, growing organization committed to advancing consumer finance in the US.

Job Summary

NinjaHoldings is seeking an AI-first Sr. Data Analyst who can take a business question from start to finish. You will use AI tools daily to do more, and you will check the results. You stay responsible for whether the answer is right. You don't need to know consumer lending yet. You do need to want to understand how the business makes money, bring your own ideas, and make clear recommendations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Ownership: Frame the business question, plan the work, pull the data, and finish with a recommendation people can act on
  • Decision Making: Make decisions as the work moves, explain them, and push through the next step. Bring a recommendation, not just a list of options
  • AI-First Analysis: Use AI tools daily for analysis, SQL, code, and reporting. Decide what to hand over to them and how you will check it
  • Checking the Work: Test results against a quick estimate before you trust them. Catch mistakes in AI output, and understand everything you deliver
  • Business Curiosity: Learn how the business works. Spot problems and opportunities, and raise questions and ideas without being asked
  • Data and Reporting: Work in SQL and Python on Snowflake. Build reports and dashboards, and contribute DBT data models through our review process
  • Communication: Give senior leaders and cross-functional partners short, clear findings and recommendations

Ideal Candidate Will Have:

  • Bachelor's degree; graduate or other research training in a quantitative or scientific field strongly preferred
  • 5+ years of experience in analytics of data science
  • Advanced working knowledge of SQL, and a solid grounding in statistics. Working knowledge of Python, or the ability to pick it up quickly
  • Experience owning a substantial project from start to finish, at work or in research
  • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate data, identify inaccuracies or inconsistencies in analytical findings or AI-generated outputs, with examples of numbers or AI output you caught being wrong and what you changed as a result
  • Strong business acumen with examples of a question or idea you raised that changed what a team did
  • You set your own analysis priorities and bring ideas to business leaders
  • You treat AI tools like a team you lead: set the questions, review the work, and catch the errors

Additional Pluses:

  • Experience with Snowflake and DBT, or in consumer lending or fintech

Benefits & Perks:

  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Health Benefits with generous medical, dental and vision insurance plans
  • 401(k) with matching contribution
  • Paid Family Leave
  • Annual Wellness & WFH Subsidies
  • Employee Referral Program
  • Remote first culture with convenient downtown office in the heart of the city

raw.title: Staff Software Engineer, OS Integration
raw.excerpt: Why Mozilla?  Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
raw.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, installer, updater, device APIs, and enterprise DLP support.

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. The role will lean on your Windows expertise, but projects may have a cross-platform component. This role will include development of features for Firefox in enterprise environments especially implementation of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) features. As a Staff Software Engineer, you’re a clear communicator and expert in your domain, ready to work on multi-month projects. You’ll contribute to the team through code review, mentoring, and discussion.

What you’ll do:

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Lead projects that improve the stability, security, and performance of Firefox.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring:

  • 7+ years of overall software engineering experience.
  • Experience with desktop application development on Windows with C++.
  • Advanced knowledge of C and C++ and a solid understanding of assembly language such as x64, x86, or arm64.
  • Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Welcoming differences
    • Being relationship-minded
    • Practicing responsible participation
    • Having grit

Bonus Points for experience with:

  • Enterprise DLP development or deployment
  • Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

raw.description:
About Us

DLH delivers improved health and national security readiness solutions for federal programs through scientific research and development, systems engineering and integration, and digital transformation. Our experts in public health, performance evaluation, and health operations solve the complex problems faced by civilian and military customers alike by leveraging advanced tools – including digital transformation, artificial intelligence, data analytics, cloud enablement, modeling, and simulation, and more. DLH is dedicated to the idea that “Your Mission is Our Passion” and brings a unique combination of government sector experience, proven methodology, and unwavering commitment to innovation to improve the lives of millions.

Overview

DLH Corporation is seeking an accomplished, results-driven Human Capital Manager to provide strategic and operational human capital support within our federal government contracting environment. This management-level individual contributor position is ideal for an experienced HR professional who brings strong employee relations expertise, business acumen, analytical capabilities, and a demonstrated ability to independently solve complex workforce challenges. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to their supported business group, manage sensitive employee relations matters, leverage workforce data to support decision-making, and lead initiatives that strengthen human capital operations. We are seeking a proactive, resourceful professional who takes ownership, identifies opportunities for improvement, and translates ideas into practical, measurable results. If you are an experienced HR professional who enjoys solving complex problems, improving processes, and making a meaningful impact on organizational performance, we encourage you to apply.

This position reports to the Director of Human Capital Operations & Employee Development.

Responsibilities

Strategic Human Capital Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted HR advisor to the assigned business group, providing guidance on workforce challenges, organizational priorities, and employee-related matters.
  • Partner with business leaders on performance management, employee engagement, organizational changes, and policy interpretation.
  • Engage with senior and executive leadership to provide human capital guidance, present recommendations, and support informed business decisions.
  • Provide practical, well-supported recommendations that balance employee considerations, business objectives, and compliance requirements.
  • Develop and facilitate training sessions, presentations, and learning initiatives that support organizational objectives and strengthen management and employee capabilities.

Employee Relations and Compliance

  • Independently manage complex employee relations matters, including workplace investigations, employee complaints, corrective actions, and involuntary separations.
  • Conduct objective investigations, assess risks, document findings, and recommend appropriate resolutions.
  • Coach managers on performance concerns, conflict resolution, and consistent application of company policies.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable employment laws, regulations, and federal contracting workforce requirements.

Human Capital Analytics and Process Improvement

  • Develop, customize, and analyze ADP reports to identify workforce trends and provide actionable insights.
  • Evaluate HR policies, processes, and procedures to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop and implement sustainable solutions that strengthen operational efficiency, accuracy, compliance, and service delivery.
  • Apply AI-enabled tools and other technologies to support HR analysis, workflow efficiencies, and continuous improvement.

Enterprise New Employee Orientation

  • Lead the planning, coordination, facilitation, and continuous improvement of the company's enterprise-wide New Employee Orientation program.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure a consistent and effective new employee experience.
  • Develop and maintain orientation materials, presentations, and supporting resources.
  • Evaluate program effectiveness and implement improvements based on feedback and operational measures.

Project Management and Enterprise Initiatives

  • Independently manage human capital projects from planning through implementation.
  • Establish project timelines, coordinate stakeholders, and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
  • Support enterprise-wide performance management, workforce planning, employee development, and other human capital initiatives.
  • Prepare and present professional reports, analyses, and recommendations to business and HC leadership.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • Eight or more years of progressively responsible HR experience, including at least five years in federal government contracting.
  • Current, active PHR, SHRM-CP, SPHR, or SHRM-SCP certification.
  • Demonstrated experience as an HR Manager, senior HR Business Partner, or comparable HR professional independently advising business leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively engage, communicate, and collaborate with senior and executive leadership.
  • Demonstrated experience developing, facilitating, and delivering professional training, presentations, and learning sessions to diverse audiences, including management and leadership team.
  • Demonstrated expertise independently managing complex employee relations matters and conducting workplace investigations.
  • Proficiency using ADP, including report creation, customization, and workforce data analysis.
  • Intermediate or higher proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Proficiency using Microsoft SharePoint.
  • Experience managing, coordinating, or facilitating New Employee Orientation programs.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify process gaps, develop solutions, and implement improvements.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and time management skills.
  • Knowledge of employment laws, regulatory compliance, and HR best practices.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in a related discipline.
  • Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Super Intelligence (SI) certification relevant to the HR field from a recognized professional education or certification provider.
  • Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt certification or higher.
  • Experience supporting multi-state, geographically dispersed federal contracting workforces.
  • Experience with contract transitions, workforce realignments, and organizational restructuring.
  • Experience developing HR dashboards, workforce metrics, and operational reports.
  • Experience with Microsoft Power Automate, SharePoint workflows, or other HR automation technologies.
  • Experience designing or improving enterprise-wide New Employee Orientation programs.

Basic Compensation: $90,400 - $104,000 yearly salary

The salary range listed reflects what we reasonably expect to pay for this role at the time of posting. The final offer may vary based on skills, experience, geographic location, market conditions, and internal equity. Additional compensation may include performance incentives and program-specific awards. We do not use salary history to determine compensation, in line with applicable law.

Benefits

DLH Corp offers our employees an excellent benefits package, including Personal Time Off (PTO), medical, dental, vision, supplemental life with AD&D, disability coverage, flexible spending accounts, and more. We want our employees to save for their future; therefore, we offer a 401(k) Retirement Plan, which includes a matching component. DLH is dedicated to your career development, providing training to help drive success, with access to our best-in-class e-learning suite for formal and informal learning, professional and technical certification preparation, and education assistance at accredited institutions.

EEO

DLH Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. DLH will provide reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities and disabled Veterans who need assistance to apply.

DLH is committed to maintaining a fair and authentic interview process
