Overview

Ready to shape the future of science and global health? A global nonprofit that provides trusted biological materials for science and health, ATCC is hiring Senior Manager, Product - Primary & Advanced Models to support Product Management within the Commercial organization. This remote role is responsible for the commercial success and lifecycle management of ATCC’s advanced cellular models and primary cell product portfolio, including organoids, induced pluripotent stem cells, 3D culture systems, hepatocytes, and PBMCs. The role develops and executes product strategies, multi-year roadmaps, portfolio plans, commercialization approaches, pricing strategies, and lifecycle plans that support revenue growth, customer adoption, and market competitiveness across biomedical research, drug discovery, disease modeling, toxicology, precision medicine, and cell and gene therapy markets.

Seeking Senior Manager, Product, ideally with product management experience in advanced cellular models or primary cells and experience supporting commercial portfolio strategy in life sciences markets. Join ATCC and be part of a team that supports the global scientific community with trusted, authenticated biological materials.

Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy: Develop and execute product strategies, multi-year product roadmaps, and portfolio plans aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and market opportunities.
  • Lifecycle Management: Lead the complete product lifecycle for assigned product lines, including concept development, commercialization, growth, portfolio optimization, and retirement decisions.
  • Commercial Planning: Translate customer insights, market opportunities, application requirements, and portfolio strategies into product requirements, launch strategies, pricing approaches, and lifecycle plans.
  • Portfolio Performance: Develop product business plans, revenue forecasts, pricing strategies, profitability targets, and investment recommendations that support portfolio growth and financial performance.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with Scientific, Operations, Quality, Marketing, Sales, and Commercial stakeholders to support product development, commercialization, go-to-market execution, and customer adoption.
  • Market Insights: Monitor market trends, competitive activity, customer feedback, portfolio performance, and lifecycle indicators to identify risks, growth opportunities, enhancements, and expansion strategies.

Qualifications

  • Minimum Requirement: Bachelor's degree and 12 years of experience, or equivalent experience (Master's degree and 8 years, PhD and 5 years, or HS Diploma and 16 years).
  • Experience developing and executing product strategies, multi-year roadmaps, portfolio plans, commercialization plans, pricing strategies, and lifecycle plans.
  • Knowledge of advanced cellular models and primary cell products, including organoids, induced pluripotent stem cells, 3D culture systems, hepatocytes, and PBMCs.
  • Experience supporting biomedical research, drug discovery, disease modeling, toxicology, precision medicine, or cell and gene therapy markets.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze market trends, competitive activity, customer feedback, financial performance, and portfolio performance to guide product and investment decisions.
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with Scientific, Operations, Quality, Marketing, Sales, Commercial, customers, distributors, and key opinion leaders.
  • Experience presenting product strategies, business cases, portfolio performance, investment recommendations, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership.
  • Preferred: Experience leading teams of professional level individual contributors, mentoring staff, supporting performance management, and aligning execution with organizational objectives.

Benefits

The expected salary range for this position is $140,000 to $160,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience and qualifications as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for additional incentive compensation including regular merit increases and the corporate bonus program.

We Invest in You

  • Health & Wellness:
    • Comprehensive medical coverage and company paid Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, AD&D, and paid parental leave
    • Work life balance with Paid Holidays and PTO
    • Fitness and cell phone subsidies, and additional benefits such as legal services, pet insurance and additional supplemental coverage.
    • Employee Assistance Program offering around-the-clock counseling
  • Financial security:
    • 401(a) (6% employer contribution) and 403(b) (2% match) retirement plans
    • Exceptional career advancement opportunities, recognition, and rewards
    • Corporate bonus program
  • Mission Focused:
    • Non-profit organization supporting critical life science research
    • We give scientists the tools they need to make discoveries that improve and save lives
    • Contribute to community involvement and social responsibility

Join ATCC, where we fuel your success, well-being, and development. We're a mission-focused non-profit Equal Opportunity Employer, celebrating a century of supporting global public health. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. Shape the future of science with us.

Worldwide, with partial overlap with Pacific Time required

About the role

You coordinate fund operations in the back office of Kinship Ventures, engaged through Trolley. You own the records behind every investor, deal and relationship, so the fund's memory lives in shared systems and not in personal inboxes. You take the admin load off the Fund Principal so he can focus on sourcing, allocations and raising. You prepare and recommend, and a senior person validates statements, updates and anything sent to investors; you never sign, approve payments or give legal or tax answers.

You report to the Finance Lead, with a dotted line to the Fund Principal, and work closely with the Managing Partner, the Bookkeeper and the Production and Marketing team.

About Moj and Trolley

Moj Mahdara is an entrepreneur and investor. She is Co-Founder and Managing Partner of Kinship Ventures, the venture platform she launched alongside Gwyneth Paltrow, and the founder of Trolley. Before Kinship, Moj was CEO of Beautycon Media, the global festival and media company built at the intersection of beauty and pop culture.

Trolley is a fast-growing creative operations company delivering high-impact digital and marketing solutions. We work with high-profile clients and founder-led brands to strategize, produce and optimize content that drives engagement, brand visibility and business growth. Our team combines strategy, design, production and performance analysis, and we work AI-first. We are a fast-moving, collaborative remote team that values respect, teamwork and open communication.

  • A short weekly update, an SOP for every recurring task, AI workflows that save time, and support for the Finance Lead on Trolley finance operations as capacity allows.

Who you are

  • You come from fund operations or financial operations, such as a fund administrator, VC or PE fund, family office, or an accounting, audit, legal operations or investor relations operations team serving funds.
  • You have hands-on experience in at least two of these: capital calls, investor records, K-1 or tax document distribution, investor onboarding, fund administrator requests and entity paperwork.
  • You have kept a system of record others trusted, such as a CRM, investor database, cap table or data room, and you check your work before you report it.
  • You work comfortably in Google Sheets or Excel, read a capital account statement and check receipts against commitments.
  • Advanced written and spoken English.
  • Advanced use of AI: it is already part of how you work every day.

Nice to have

  • Spanish, or experience with a US-based leadership team in a remote contractor setup.
  • Hands-on use of Carta, Real Deal or a similar CRM, DocuSign and a data room platform.
  • Experience supporting a fund close, placement agent work, investor relations, expense and management fee tracking, or plain-language summaries of insurance policies and agreements.

This role is not

Not an investment analyst, fundraiser, controller, signer, payment approver, legal or tax advisor, or HR role.

How we hire

Equal opportunity

Description

About LiveU

LiveU provides live video streaming and connectivity solutions for 1st responders, law enforcement, transportation agencies and public information agencies. Through our patented bonding and video transport technology, LiveU delivers consistent bandwidth and a reliable connection from anywhere in the world, so agencies can acquire, manage and distribute high-quality live video, build a common operating picture, enhance situational awareness, and maintain resilient edge connectivity and communications.

If you are passionate about technology that can help save lives, this could be a great opportunity for you!

Position Overview

LiveU is seeking a results-driven Regional Sales Manager to accelerate growth across the Public Safety, and Critical Infrastructure. The successful candidate will develop and close new business, expand customer relationships, and achieve assigned regional revenue objectives.

LiveU specializes in reliable, low-latency live video delivery and connectivity using bonded cellular, 5G, IP networks, and advanced video transmission technologies for mission-critical operations. This role positions LiveU solutions with public safety agencies, emergency response organizations, utilities, telecommunications providers, and critical infrastructure operators.

Key Responsibilities

  • Revenue Ownership: Develop and execute regional sales strategies to achieve assigned bookings and revenue targets.
  • New Business Development: Identify, qualify, advance, and close opportunities across public safety, government, telecommunications, and critical infrastructure.
  • Full Sales Cycle Management: Lead discovery, solution positioning, demonstrations, proposals, procurement, negotiations, and contract execution.
  • Customer Relationships: Build relationships with law enforcement leadership, emergency management officials, public-sector decision-makers, utilities, and technology stakeholders.
  • Solution Positioning: Communicate the operational value of LiveU video delivery infrastructure, bonded connectivity, and resilient live-streaming solutions.
  • Proof-of-Concept Execution: Partner with Sales Engineering on structured evaluations with clear objectives, timelines, and commercial outcomes.
  • Channel Collaboration: Work with resellers, systems integrators, OEM partners, and telecommunications providers to expand regional revenue.
  • Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain accurate Salesforce records, qualified pipeline coverage, opportunity progression, and reliable forecasts.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product Management, Customer Success, and Channel Sales.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of successful B2B technology sales experience, preferably in Public Safety, Critical Infrastructure, Telecommunications, Government, or adjacent mission-critical markets.
  • Demonstrated success managing the complete sales cycle and consistently achieving revenue quotas.
  • Experience selling live video delivery, wireless communications, network connectivity, IP-based transmission, cloud services, or related technologies.
  • Understanding of public safety operations, emergency response, situational awareness, command centers, and field communications.
  • Ability to translate complex technical capabilities into operational and financial value.
  • Experience with channel partners, systems integrators, and technology solution providers.
  • Strong relationship management, negotiation, presentation, and closing skills.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms, including pipeline management and forecasting.
  • Self-directed territory management and willingness to travel regularly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relationships within law enforcement, fire services, emergency management, government agencies, utilities, or critical infrastructure organizations.
  • Familiarity with UAS/drone operations, Drone as First Responder (DFR), Real-Time Crime Centers (RTCCs), mobile command, and video management systems.
  • Knowledge of bonded cellular, LTE/5G, FirstNet, private wireless networks, satellite communications, and IP video transport.
  • Experience with public-sector procurement, cooperative purchasing, government contracts, RFPs, and grant-funded acquisitions.
  • Experience converting technical evaluations and proof-of-concept deployments into recurring revenue.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

Performance Expectations

Success will be measured through assigned bookings and revenue targets, qualified pipeline development, customer acquisition, opportunity conversion, forecast accuracy, and strategic account expansion. The RSM owns commercial outcomes from initial engagement through purchase and deployment.

Why LiveU?

LiveU is an established leader in resilient live video transmission and connectivity. As demand for real-time operational visibility expands, LiveU brings proven video delivery capabilities into mission-critical environments. This role directly contributes to Public Safety and Critical Infrastructure growth.

About Lyra

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be contracted by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Opportunity

Lyra’s provider network is composed of in-person and virtual therapists, physicians, and coaches across the US. With our advanced matching technology, supportive provider platform, and opportunities for training and clinical consultation, being part of our network is an incredible chance to do what you love (like patient care) with support for the things you don’t love (like self promotion and scheduling).
We are looking for contract psychiatrists who are passionate about whole-person, whole family mental health care and working within a connected network to provide patients with easily accessible, culturally responsive, high-quality mental health care.
As a contract psychiatrist, you’ll provide evidence-based treatment via live 60-minute video intake appointments and regular follow-up appointments. You'll conduct psychiatric evaluations and provide medication management. Lyra makes it easy to refer patients to evidence-based therapy and coaching services in tandem with your care.
You will provide care to individuals from a multitude of different backgrounds and experiences, as well as those with varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally-responsive care—an approach that is mindful of the impact of cultural background on each person’s care experience.

Responsibilities:

  • Clinical Assessment and Diagnostic Skills - Conduct comprehensive psychiatric evaluations, formulate accurate diagnoses, and create individualized treatment plans tailored to each developmental stage.
  • Evidence-Based Treatment - Utilize proven therapeutic techniques and medication management strategies to address conditions such as anxiety, depression, ADHD, and mood disorders, ensuring safe and appropriate interventions.
  • Family-Centered Approach - Foster a collaborative treatment environment, educating families on mental health issues, involving them in care planning, and providing guidance on supportive measures at home.
  • Virtual Care Delivery - Conduct virtual psychiatric sessions, ensuring a high-quality and supportive experience, and leverage technology to maintain regular communication with members and families.
  • Collaborative Teamwork - Actively participate in team meetings, contribute to collaborative care planning, and provide consultative support to other team members for comprehensive member care.
  • Data-Driven Practice and Documentation - Maintain accurate, timely documentation of assessments, care plans, and progress notes. Use data analytics to assess outcomes and continuously improve care quality.
  • Ethics and Compliance - Ensure compliance with all regulatory and quality standards, engage in ongoing professional development, and commit to ethical, patient-centered care practices.

Requirements:

  • Board-certified or -eligible Child and Adolescent Psychiatrist with an active license in at least one state
  • Experience providing telehealth therapy services in a virtual environment (video and teletherapy) preferred but not required
  • Computer and live video tools literacy (e.g., Zoom, Google Meets, DoxyMe, Skype, etc.)
  • Demonstrated family engagement skills and experience working with children, adolescents, and young adults
  • Commitment to and familiarity with JCAHO guidelines and competency in practicing within an accredited framework to ensure safety, quality, and compliance

Here are some of the advantages of joining the Lyra provider network:

  • Set your own schedule without a minimum hours requirement
  • Focus less on the administrative burden of billing with Lyra’s paperless billing and quick payment turnaround
  • Access to a custom-built calendar for new patients to connect seamlessly
  • Access to experienced clinical consultations to get rapid support with your patients as well as access a range of specialty group consultation meetings
  • Have peace of mind with Lyra’s 24/7 Care Navigation team for client crisis support

Job Description:

The Data Insights Manager is responsible for transforming operational, customer and commercial data into actionable intelligence that supports strategic decision-making, service transformation and business performance improvement.

The role provides advanced analytics, forecasting trend analysis, executive insight and decision-support capability across the contract. Working alongside operational leaders, and the MIS function, the postholder will identify emerging trends, future risks, efficiency opportunities and customer insights that drive performance and inform business strategy.

The role is accountable for developing executive-level dashboards, predictive analytics and business intelligence solutions that enable evidence-based decision making across the service.


This role will be remote based but travel will be expected on an ad hoc basis, mainly to Coventry.

Responsibilities


  • Analyse operational, customer and commercial data to identify trends, risks, opportunities and performance drivers.
  • Provide strategic recommendations that improve customer outcomes, operational performance and commercial effectiveness.
  • Develop analytical frameworks that support decision making across service delivery, planning and transformation activities.
  • Produce insight-led assessments and recommendations for senior leadership teams.
  • Design and develop executive Power BI dashboards and strategic data visualisations that support leadership decision making.
  • Continuously evolve executive reporting capability to improve decision making and organisational visibility.
  • Analyse the end-to-end customer journey to identify how customer behaviour, channel choice, service changes and external factors influence contact demand and operational workload.

  • Evaluate service performance data to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Measure and track benefits realised from transformation and change initiatives.
  • Provide analytical support to strategic programmes, operational change projects and service modernisation activities.

About You

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Significant experience delivering business intelligence and analytical solutions.
  • Advanced Power BI development and dashboard design skills.
  • Experience developing executive-level dashboards and strategic performance visualisations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with experience of root-cause analysis.
  • Experience of forecasting, predictive analytics and scenario modelling.
  • Ability to interpret complex operational datasets and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience presenting insight and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Strong SQL and data-modelling knowledge.

Tangem is looking for an entrepreneurial and results driven Head of Middle East & Africa (MEA) to lead the growth of Tangem products across the MEA region. Your main responsibility will be to develop and scale Tangem as a consumer product in the region, driving revenue growth through a combination of sales, marketing, distribution, and strategic partnerships.

We are looking for a business leader who understands how to bring a product to market, identify the right growth channels, build brand presence, and convert commercial and marketing initiatives into measurable sales results.
You will own the regional growth strategy, lead a local team, and work closely with central sales and marketing functions to accelerate Tangem's expansion across the MEA region.

raw.excerpt: About Megaport We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be.
raw.description:
About Megaport

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

Our Team Culture

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to spearhead the strategy, design vetting, and end-to-end delivery of our next-generation, high-density AI Data Center footprint. In this role, you will bridge the gap between abstract capacity needs and physical execution, serving as the primary orchestrator for complex, high-capacity GPU cluster deployments.

You will lead pre-approval technical vetting (evaluating space, power, cooling, and network floor plans before site acquisition) and take ownership of the full deployment lifecycle through to operational handoff.

Proactive and a self-starter, you must be highly organized with the ability to manage competing priorities. Driven and motivated, you can operate both autonomously and in a collaborative team environment, coordinating across multiple internal groups and external vendors to deliver comprehensive high-capacity GPU cluster deployments.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Technical Design & Floorplan Vetting:

  • Review, design, and vet floor plans

  • Create High-Level Designs

  • Plan power distributions and cooling architectures.

  • Work alongside engineering and vendor partners prior to purchasing or leasing data center space.

  • Infrastructure Planning:

  • Conduct technical diligence on data center facilities.

  • Validate that physical infrastructure (power redundancy, floor loading, high-density liquid/air cooling capabilities) aligns with massive AI/GPU compute requirements (multi-MW deployments, liquid-cooled racks at 100kW+, NVIDIA clusters).

  • End-to-End Project Ownership:

  • Manage the complete project lifecycle for high-capacity GPU cluster deployments.

  • Drive progress from pre-approval site vetting through infrastructure design, physical implementation, cabling, commissioning, documentation, and final operational handoff.

  • Cross-Functional Coordination:

  • Serve as the central hub aligning Data Center operators, Network Engineering, Hardware Systems, Facilities, Procurement, and Enterprise IT teams around unified goals and timelines.

  • Milestone & Progress Tracking:

  • Establish critical paths, schedule dependencies, and project milestones.

  • Actively monitor progress while holding internal teams and external vendors accountable for updates.

  • Risk Management & Quality Control:

  • Proactively identify spatial, power, or logistical constraints early in the planning process.

  • Mitigate post-procurement delays, budget overruns, and technical bottlenecks.

  • Reporting & Governance:

  • Maintain accurate project documentation, inventory tracking, and transparent status reporting for executive leadership and stakeholders.

What We Are Looking For

  • Technical knowledge and a proven track record delivering complex hardware infrastructure or data center engineering projects.

  • 5+ years of technical project management experience in high-density or infrastructure environments.

  • Strong familiarity with DC facility design, power delivery systems, thermal management, and spatial planning for high-density environments.

  • Direct experience or strong foundational understanding of high-density AI cluster architectures.

  • Ability to read, interpret, and refine CAD drawings, as well as create rack elevations, single-line diagrams, and floor plans.

  • Demonstrated ability to drive accountability across technical, engineering, and third-party vendor teams.

  • Strong hands-on proficiency with modern project management software (Jira, Confluence).

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of distilling technical complexities into concise updates for leadership.

What We Offer

  • Flexible working environment – a remote-first culture with coworking options available

  • Generous leave plans – including, parental leave, birthday leave, and a purchased annual leave program

  • Health and wellness support – through a wellness allowance and employee wellbeing initiatives

  • Comprehensive learning support – generous study and training allowance plus paid study leave

  • Creative, modern workspaces – designed to inspire when you're not working remotely, plus access to coworking spaces via our global WeWork membership if you work remotely, but like to get out of the house sometimes

  • Motivated, inclusive team – work alongside industry experts and fresh talent

  • Recognition programs – celebrate achievements with our Legend and Kudos award

If you have any questions, please reach out to Megaport's Talent Acquisition Team at
NOTE: All Megaport business correspondence is conducted via our business email accounts (@megaport.com). If you have any concerns, please reach out to Megaport's careers team directly and we will verify the legitimacy of any communication. Megaport will not ask you to create an account via Microsoft teams, and does not associate with any email accounts under "@megaportau.com".
All applications will be treated in confidence.
Please see Part 2 of our Privacy Policy to see what information Megaport collects from job applicants, why, and how we store and use it. Note that you’re entitled to know what personal data of yours Megaport holds, to request updates, rectification, and in some circumstances restriction or deletion thereof if you object (you being entitled to withdraw your consent to our holding your information at any time). Please see Part 5 of our Privacy Policy for more details on this and how to contact Megaport's data protection officer if you have any further privacy-related questions. Candidates who meet the selection criteria will be invited to attend an interview. Strictly no Recruitment Agencies.

You will help shape how these technologies and the capabilities they support come together, identifying opportunities for integration, reuse, simplification, modernization, and long-term scalability.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead architecture strategy for Ortho Tech & Medical, aligning business capabilities, growth priorities, operating-model needs, and customer outcomes with enterprise technology direction.

  • Partner across Business, Product, Data & Analytics, AI, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Integration, Engineering, and delivery teams to build alignment and influence outcomes without relying on direct authority.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and vendors through the lens of business value, organizational readiness, security, privacy, regulatory requirements, and sustainable enterprise scale.

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Data Science, or a related discipline preferred; applicable relevant professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

Overview

Symbria Rx Services is seeking a team oriented. As one of the few 100% employee-owned companies in healthcare, our business practices are guided strictly by the values to which our employee owners are committed to. For more than 20 years, Symbria has been providing an outstanding work environment for talented employees to deliver patient-centered care to the geriatric population in senior-living and post-acute settings.

The LTC Pharmacy Adjudicator is responsible for communicating to the communities when order exceptions occur such as non-formulary, expensive medications, and incomplete orders. This position works closely with the community staff to have orders clarified and medications changed to less expensive alternatives. Coordinates all adjudication on Medicare D claims where needed and to perform all functions required to maintain, update, and bill customers’ accounts timely and accurately.

Working Schedule:

  • 10:00am-6:30PM CST Monday-Friday and every 4th weekend, Saturday and Sunday from 6:00am-2:30pm CST.
  • Must work rotating holidays.
  • Must currently live in a state Symbria Rx Services is licensed in: AZ, CO, FL, IL, IN, KS, MA, MI, MO, PA, OH, WI.
  • 100% Remote
  • Must have high-speed, internet access provided by a cable or fiber provider (no DSL or satellite). Internet is not provided or reimbursed by Symbria.
    • Users with no more than three (3) local devices connected, a minimum connection speed of 50 Mbps for downloads, and10 Mbps for uploads is required. Latency must be below 35. Cable internet service is strongly recommended over DSL service.
    • Users with four (4) or more devices such as laptops/ computers, mobile phones/ tablets, VOIP home phone, gaming systems, and streaming video systems (Netflix, Amazon Fire/ TV, Google, Roku, Apple TV, etc.), the minimum connection speed required should be 75 Mbps for downloads and 10 Mbps for uploads. Latency must be below 35.
    • We recommend a wire connection to your home internet router. Slow or poor internet connection may impact or prohibit the ability to perform your job. The use of Wi-Fi ‘air cards’ (mobile hot spots) are prohibited as your main internet connection.
    • Symbria reserves the right to verify that your system will meet or exceed these requirements.
  • All requirements & recommendations are subject to change with technological advances.

Responsibilities

  • Initiate communication to communities regarding expensive and non-formulary medication orders and educate on less expensive alternatives identified by staff pharmacists.
  • Initiate communication to community regarding incomplete orders which require further clarification.
  • Keep detailed records of all orders that require communication to the community for potential follow up if needed.
  • Follow up with the community per policy timeframe if the medications have not been changed or clarified. Send another supply of medication if needed.
  • Communicate professionally with community management staff including Director of Nursing and Administrator via phone or email.
  • Assist with data entry of orders as needed.
  • Assist with answering phone calls for the data entry department.
  • Review Medicare D rejections and prior authorizations, and coordinate with pharmacists or physicians to successfully adjudicate all claims.
  • Work in conjunction with designated operations staff to prepare for formulary changes.
  • Perform insurance and billing clerical duties, including review and maintenance of patient account information.
  • Prepare and submit claims to various third parties either electronically or by paper.
  • Identify and resolve claim denials.
  • Act as liaison between patients and third parties.
  • Work collaboratively with other team members and supervisor to ensure best practices are shared.
  • Provide backup support to other pharmacy departments based on business needs or production levels, as needed.
  • Any and all duties as assigned.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, the ability to perform each essential duty satisfactorily is necessary and the qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required:

  • High School diploma or general education degree (GED).
  • Pharmacy Technician License and/or Certification (CPhT) as per State requirements (must be licensed in Illinois and Massachusetts within 60 days of hire).
  • Data entry experience; minimum one year.
  • Excellent customer service, interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills.
  • General computer knowledge including Microsoft Office: Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Ability to maintain organization, multi-task and prioritize to manage assignments/projects.
  • Strong knowledge of Brand/Generic drugs and medical terminology.

QUALIFICATIONS PREFERRED• Prescription billing experience; minimum one year.

Why work for us?

At Symbria our employees act like owners – because we are owners! As one of the few 100% employee-owned healthcare providers, our focus remains on delivering best-in-class services within our Pharmacy, Rehabilitation and Well-Being operations, which allows our clients to improve the lives and well-being of their patients and residents. Our teams utilize insights and analytics to drive better health outcomes for our partnered post-acute and senior living communities while providing them with flexible service options.

Symbria’s Core Values drive the way we partner with those clients, their patients and residents and the way our diverse employee-owners work together:

  • Integrity – Honest, Fairness and ethics
  • Compassion – Commitment to serving seniors
  • Stewardship – Maximizing mission and margin
  • Innovation – Striving to enhance our value to your organization
  • Teamwork – Working together unselfishly toward goals

As an employee-owner, Symbria’s success becomes your success. In addition, we provide:

  • Competitive pay, aligned with market guidelines
  • Full Benefits Package, including very generous paid time off plans
  • Professional liability coverage
  • 100% employer-funded ESOP retirement plan
  • 401(k) and Roth(k) plans
  • Continuing education
  • Credit union membership

  • NLP models: train, fine-tune and maintain BERT-based models (intent detection, classification, entity extraction, embeddings); prepare and label data; decide when a smaller specialized model should replace an LLM call.
  • LLM services in production: Python services within a 20+ microservice system; model routing, fallbacks, retries, caching, rate-limit handling; versioned REST APIs; clean, tested code and code reviews.
  • Evaluation & monitoring: quality metrics and evaluation datasets; automated evaluation including LLM-as-a-judge and regression tests for prompt/model changes; tracing of LLM calls; experiments and A/B tests.
  • AWS: train, deploy and operate models on AWS (EKS, Lambda, S3, SageMaker, GPU instances); CI/CD for models and prompts with DevOps; track and reduce cost.
  • Collaboration: work with product, backend, DevOps and financial domain experts; contribute to architecture and modelling decisions.

Requirements

Must-have:

  • 5+ years of commercial experience in Data Science, Machine Learning or AI Engineering
  • 3+ years hands-on with LLMs and NLP
  • Strong Python, OOP and software engineering fundamentals
  • Proficient prompt engineering; experience with LLM evaluation
  • Good understanding of modern deep-learning architectures; hands-on with PyTorch or TensorFlow
  • SQL and NoSQL databases
  • Docker and containerized applications; deploying and operating services on Kubernetes
  • Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar)
  • Upper-Intermediate English or higher (spoken and written)
  • Fluency in Ukrainian
  • BSc or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field


Nice to have:

  • RAG, vector databases and semantic search
  • Fine-tuning or training LLMs
  • Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex or similar
  • Observability: Grafana, Prometheus, Langfuse, LangSmith
  • Financial markets / fintech / trading domain knowledge
  • Mathematical optimization (LP/MILP, constraint programming)
  • Kaggle competitions

Role Overview

Responsible for the development, management, and performance of the Supplier Network through supplier relationship management, operational support, data analysis, communication, and performance monitoring. Partners with Account Management, Operations, and Sales to optimize network utilization, enhance customer and client satisfaction, and support organizational goals. Collaborates with the Director/Senior Manager to develop and execute supplier strategies while managing strategic suppliers and service lines.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

% of time (must total to 100%)

Description of Duty

60%

Supplier Management

Perform end-to-end supplier management including, but not limited to: researching, sourcing, selection, onboarding, ongoing analysis, price negotiation, contract management, continued training, performance management and quality for assigned relocation suppliers. Develop and maintain strong relationships with suppliers while promoting company initiatives and values.

Serve as a point of contact for global supply chain for supplier inquiries, escalations and resolutions.

Implement and monitor standard processes to meet Sirva and client-directed service level agreements (SLAs). Maintain supplier records, performance data, and service line/supplier reporting within company systems. Create and assist with internal training to Sirva Account Management, Operations and Sales teams on service categories.

20%

Supplier / Service Line Strategy

Directly responsible for the development and implementation of service strategies on a global basis based on best practices, market conditions, global, regional and local needs. Support initiatives to maximize value, minimize cost and increase revenue. Perform market analysis and new supplier research based on need. Gather, analyze, and organize supplier market and industry data. Identify opportunities to improve supplier performance, operational efficiency, and cost management. Prepare reports, presentations, and data analysis to support decision-making and service line initiatives. Monitor industry trends, market conditions, and competitor activity and communicate relevant findings to management. Contribute to continuous improvement projects and supplier network development efforts. Coordinate with Supplier Management team to conduct market research on market data/trends and provide interpretation and organization of data into report format with graphical illustrations of findings to advise Clients, Employees, and Internal Clients on implications. Coordinates with Supplier Management team to determine long and short-term goals and strategic objectives both internally and for our network of suppliers.

20%

Client Support

Act as primary contact for Global Sirva Relocation, Account Management, Operations and Sales to provide quality and performance analysis and reports for client specific needs.

Partner with internal stakeholder and clients on Special Projects and Client specific requirements.

Participate in client presentations, client reviews and new client implementations as needed.

Support for RFPs, RFIs, and rebids for existing client business

Prepare client-facing documentation, presentations, and supplier performance reports as requested.

Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent work experience; master’s degree a plus CRP, GMS or CIPS certification a plus

Qualifications and Experience Requirements

Native or fluent English proficiency, both written and verbal Minimum of 2 years of supplier management experience preferably in relocation, global mobility, or a related industry Ability to work autonomously and as part of a collaborative global team Strong relationship management and leadership skills Professional verbal and written communication skills Strong presentation skills with the ability to effectively lead presentations for suppliers, clients, and internal stakeholders Ability to respond resourcefully and constructively to new demands, priorities and challenges Demonstrated ability to influence decisions and build effective relationships Analytical mindset with experience in reporting, supplier metrics, and dashboards Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Suite skills (including Excel, Word & PowerPoint) Understanding of e-procurement systems Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities Results-driven with strong project coordination and problem-solving abilities Ability to quickly analyze, identify and implement opportunities and company initiatives for improvement and revenue growth Process-oriented with a focus on continuous improvement Ability to research, evaluate, and recommend suppliers Experience working effectively across global, cross-functional teams and diverse cultures You foster belonging and encourage authenticity. You are inclusive, value diversity, and recognize that these behaviors empower and inspire positive action and promote innovation

If you want your work to count and the room to become your best, you'll find it here.

We’re changing the way we work at Bayer, for higher productivity, faster innovation, and better results. We call it Dynamic Shared Ownership (DSO). Learn more about what DSO will mean for you in your new role here


Senior Director National HP PBM Accounts

The Senior Director, National Accounts, Health Plans/PBMs, builds and maintains effective, long-term relationships with senior decision-makers and key influencers across assigned customer accounts, including major strategic health plan and PBM customers. This role drives a high level of customer satisfaction by understanding each account’s business priorities, market dynamics, and evolving needs.


This role identifies, develops, and closes new sales opportunities while creating demand for the organization’s products and services. By elevating the organization’s profile and demonstrating strategic value, the role expands customer engagement and increases revenue spend within each account.


The Senior Director National Accounts, Health Plans/PBMs regularly leads status updates, business reviews, and strategic planning discussions with customer senior management. These discussions help identify unmet needs, uncover growth opportunities, and align the organization’s product and service strategies with customer objectives.


Operating within the Account and Relationship Management function, the Senior Director applies broad commercial expertise across relevant disciplines to strengthen partnerships, achieve revenue targets, and deliver sustainable account growth.

YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES


The primary responsibilities of this role, Senior Director, National Accounts, Health Plan PBM’s, are to:


Enterprise Strategy and Business Leadership

  • Develop strategic plans and ensure flawless execution;
  • Create innovative business opportunities to drive profitable short and long-term customer partnerships;
  • Understand the long-term impact based on market dynamics now and in the future, and facilitates strategy and plan implementation to produce long-term profitable access while meeting short-term key brand performance metrics;

Executive Customer Leadership

  • Develop and enhance customer partnerships across the customer enterprise and cross-functionally at Bayer, developing deep enduring executive relationships;
  • Be the customer expert by providing insight into customer policy, benefit, clinical evaluation, and legislation impact to market and navigate into the payer/PBM executive/C-suite;
  • Facilitate Payer Champion and value for product access within the PBM in Mega Accounts: Drive payer access across regional Payers through alignment of Regional Payer team in PBMs in Mega-Accounts;
  • Drive outcomes and take ownership of the customer organization;

Enterprise Influence and Matrix Leadership

  • Drive customer strategy and initiatives with internal contracting, Access Strategy, and Pricing teams for the Payer and PBM customers;
  • Resource Management: High-level interactions with Medical/HEOR, Brand Teams, and Legal optimizing customer opportunities;
  • Act as the Mega Account point and manage strategy across the organization through coordination of Regional Account Directors, Pull Through Account Directors, SP Account Directors, FRMs, Contracting, Access Strategy, and Brand Key Tasks;
  • Lead high-level communications that will align brands with market dynamics and competitive trends that could impact profitable access;

Market Access, Negotiation and Commercial Performance

  • Deliver and maintain profitable access, advantageous policy, and appropriate reimbursement for Bayer products at National Payer through commercialization of launch products and life cycle management of the portfolio;
  • Meet departmental and brand expectations inclusive of stretch goals through appropriate resource management, strategic and novel innovative, best-in-class approaches;
  • Strong negotiation capabilities, ability to deliver value despite nominal differentiation.

WHO YOU ARE


Bayer seeks an incumbent who possesses the following:

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree;
  • Related work experience in sales and/or account management in the pharmaceutical industry;
  • Recent HP/PBM and Payer account management and leadership (required);
  • Experience in a supervisory or leadership position (required).
  • Valid driver’s license and clean driving record required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • MBA preferred;
  • 12+ years related work experience in sales and/or account management in the pharmaceutical industry;
  • 5+ years of recent HP/PBM and Payer account management and leadership;
  • 5+ years managed markets experience with demonstrated success (preferred);
  • 5+ years’ experience in a supervisory or leadership position;
  • Experience executing market access strategies for National PBM and Payer accounts, and exposure to contract development and negotiations for the same.

raw.description:
Company Overview:

At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world. As the leader in visual and audio-based learning, we empower organizations to share knowledge effortlessly in a capture and post-capture world. We don’t just build software; we obsess over our users’ goals to deliver solutions that truly matter. Our mission is simple: to attract the brightest talent, people like you, to Elevate the Craft and do the most impactful work of your career.

Position Summary

In this role, you will have the opportunity to do meaningful work in your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning.

As the Event Marketing Manager, you will drive top-line growth for Panopto by growing brand awareness and generating new leads through 3rd-party and own-hosted events. We need someone who can juggle multiple priorities, collaborate effectively across geographies and get the most out of our investment in events, be that spend or effort.

You'll also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and support you in elevating your craft.

How You’ll Contribute

In this role, you will…

  • Event Strategy: Develop and execute the Americas in-person and virtual event plan, partnering with the Senior Manager to align with global growth goals.

  • Event Management: Plan, manage and organize 3rd-party events, in-person and virtual, from start to finish.

  • Event Lead Management: Work with the sales team on the follow-up and processing of leads created through events, providing marketing support where needed.

  • Organize customer events and roadshows: Conceptualize, organize and manage own-hosted customer and prospect events.

  • Market Research: Stay up-to-date with the market, identify new event opportunities and implement them into the wider event strategy.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 3 Months: Establish operating rhythms with the Senior Manager, Event Marketing, your peer event marketing manager, the newly formed global product and content team, and the sales team for event lead follow-up and processing. Complete onboarding across Panopto’s CRM and event platforms, audit existing vendor and sponsorship spend, and deliver your first assigned 3rd-party and virtual events on schedule and within budget.

  • Within 6 Months: Assume autonomous end-to-end execution of the Americas calendar across 3rd-party events, virtual events, and own-hosted customer and prospect roadshows. Consistently hit quarterly MQL/SQL and influenced-pipeline targets through disciplined weekly and monthly progress tracking, proactive pre-event attendee acquisition, and strict sales SLA adherence on lead routing.

  • Within 1 Year: Achieve full-year pipeline and revenue attribution goals while using post-event ROI data to reallocate budget toward top-performing channels. Incorporate ongoing market research and new event opportunities into the broader Americas event strategy, and standardize repeatable playbooks for own-hosted customer events and roadshows that scale pipeline generation without adding headcount.

Values in Action

  • Customer First, Always: You proactively surface friction points in the customer experience before they are escalated — and propose solutions, not just reports.

  • Thrive Together: You share work-in-progress for early feedback, knowing that challenge improves the outcome. You separate critiques of ideas from critiques of people.

  • Elevate the Craft: You hold the bar high on your own work and invest in developing those around you. You treat every project as an opportunity to learn something new.

  • Act with Ownership: You define success by outcomes, not activity. You flag problems early and bring a proposed path forward, not just the problem.

  • Clarity Over Complexity: You default to the simpler solution. Your written communication — internal or external — is direct, specific, and free of filler.

How We Thrive

You’ll join a team that thrives on clarity, ownership, and continuous improvement.

We operate with a bias toward action—balancing strategic thinking with execution—and hold ourselves accountable to outcomes that drive the business forward. Collaboration is at the core of how we work, and we value diverse perspectives that strengthen our collective thinking.

The Foundation for Success

  • Experience: 3–5+ years of experience planning and executing B2B event marketing or field marketing programs, preferably within a B2B SaaS or high-growth technology environment.

  • Budget & Vendor Ownership: Demonstrated experience managing multi-event budgets, forecasting expenses, negotiating sponsorship packages, and managing external vendors/agencies (booths, AV, venues, shipping).

  • End-to-End Campaign & Demand Generation Execution: Proven ability to drive pre-event attendee acquisition (targeted email, social promotion, and sales outreach enablement) as well as post-event lead routing and nurture to maximize conversion.

  • Pipeline & ROI Attribution: Track record of measuring event performance against pipeline generation, MQL/SQL conversion, and ROI, and translating post-event data into future investment recommendations.

  • Specific MarTech & Event Tech Proficiency: Hands-on experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, or Marketo) and event/webinar management tools (e.g., Cvent, Splash, Goldcast, or Zoom Webinars), including lead capture and campaign attribution workflows.

  • Travel & On-Site Leadership: Ability and willingness to travel up to 25%–40% (primarily within North America) to lead on-site execution, manage booth operations, and support event staff.

What Sets You Apart

  • Vertical & Buyer Persona Familiarity: Experience marketing to Higher Education, Enterprise Learning & Development (L&D), or corporate IT/communications buyers (directly aligned with Panopto’s core markets).

  • Owned-Event & Executive Programming: Experience conceptualizing and running owned customer conferences, regional roadshows, executive dinners, or customer advisory boards (CABs).

  • Account-Based Marketing (ABM) & Partner Marketing: Experience collaborating with ABM teams (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase) to drive target-account attendance and co-marketing events with strategic channel/technology partners.

  • AI-Enabled Marketing Workflows: Familiarity using generative AI tools to accelerate event copywriting, speaker briefs, promotional sequences, and post-event reporting synthesis.

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or equivalent practical experience.

Join Us

Join Panopto and play a key role in driving top-line growth and brand awareness for a leader in visual and audio-based learning. If you love executing 3rd-party and virtual events, building own-hosted customer roadshows, partnering with sales on lead follow-up, and turning metrics and event spend into measurable, repeatable results, you’ll feel right at home here.

Total Rewards

The salary range for this position is $77,500 - $87,500 USD per year. This position is also eligible for a bonus as part of the compensation package.

Base pay offered may vary depending on various factors, including, but not limited to: job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other eligibility factors such as geographic location. The Total Rewards package includes competitive base pay and an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs such as health insurance, flexible spending accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. At Panopto, we know that great people make an organization great. We value our people and offer employees benefits that are market competitive for our industry. Learn more about what working at Panopto can mean for you.

At Panopto, our commitment to pay equity and transparency is unwavering. We do not engage in salary negotiations beyond the established range to maintain fairness and prevent potential pay disparities among team members based on negotiation strategies.

Beyond the Requirements: At this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job description you’re reading. Even if you don't feel that you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We're eager to meet people that believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways - not just candidates who check all the boxes. We want people to feel comfortable expressing their true selves and to come, stay, and do their best work here.

Recruiting Tips: From crafting an impressive resume to presenting your best self during our interviews, we're dedicated to ensuring you feel well-prepared and self-assured as you embark on opportunities at Panopto. Discover some valuableRecruiting Tipsfrom our team.

The standard interview process at Panopto involves several steps, outlined below, to ensure we approach the process thoughtfully and consistently:

Application Review -> Recruiter Call -> Video Interview & Assessment -> Hiring Manager Call -> Interview Loop -> Debrief -> Offer

Our people and culture

Panopto’s mission is to be the leader in visual and audio-based learning in a capture and post-capture world. Our user base is as diverse as the world’s universities and businesses. Panopto’s commitment to fostering a fair, equitable, and inclusive culture empowers each member of our team to express their authentic selves, contribute their distinct perspectives and make a meaningful impact both individually and collectively. This inclusive environment not only encourages creativity and the free exchange of ideas but also harnesses the power of varied viewpoints. As a result, we are better equipped to tackle our most intricate challenges, leveraging the wealth of different experiences and backgrounds within our team. This collaborative spirit empowers us to challenge ideas (not people) recognizing that our shared success relies on collective wisdom. It drives us to continuously improve and innovate, ultimately elevating the quality of our products and services. It’s what sets Panopto apart as a unique and rewarding place to work.

Our purpose

We believe that video can have a transformative effect on learning. So we built a video knowledge management platform that helps businesses and universities improve the way that they train, teach, and share knowledge. Since 2007, we have been a pioneer in video capture software, video management, and inside-video-search technology. Panopto has been adopted by more than 1,600 companies and universities worldwide with over 11 million end users. Today, Panopto’s knowledge management platform is the largest repository of expert learning videos in the world. A proud remote-first company, Panopto is headquartered in Pittsburgh, with offices in London, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Sydney, and has received industry recognition for its innovation, rapid growth, and company culture.

Panopto is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified individuals which will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected criteria, in accordance with applicable law. Panopto is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodation for interviewing or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please provide more detail on how we can further support you by reaching out to the Employee Experience department.

Remote, US: Candidates looking for flexible or remote-friendly positions are encouraged to apply. Panopto is proud to be a remote-first company. Employees in this position are eligible to work remotely.

Remote, International: Candidates looking for flexible or remote-friendly positions are encouraged to apply. Panopto is proud to be a remote-first company. Employees in this position are eligible to work remotely. Still, they may make regular trips to the local international office from time to time, where applicable.

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Panopto AI Use Policy:

Panopto’s AI Use Policy is committed to a hiring process that is thoughtful, fair, and centered on human connection. As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes more prevalent in the workplace, we believe that it is important to describe our use of AI in the hiring process, as well as outline to candidates what use of AI is and is not allowed. While AI can be a valuable tool, it cannot replace genuine human interaction or an individual’s unique perspective, experience, and voice.

Company Use of AI:

Panopto may utilize tools to enhance the efficiency, objectivity, and quality of our recruitment and evaluation process. These tools assist our team throughout the hiring lifecycle by focusing on four key areas:

  • Content Creation: Providing a starting point for crafting job descriptions and assisting in building tailored interview questions.

  • Resume Parsing: Analyzing candidate skillsets and resume alignment to efficiently identify qualified candidates.

  • Interview & Assessment Insights: Providing interview transcription, summarization, and identifying key insights from candidate assessments in relation to specific role requirements.

  • Data Organization: Organizing and storing information gathered during assessments to help our team make informed, data-driven decisions.

Ultimately, these tools are used to support—not replace—our team in assessing skills, generating insights, and identifying the best talent for Panopto.

To ensure fairness and transparency:

Human-Centric Decisions: Please be assured that AI tools are used to support our team, and all final hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. Panopto hiring teams will thoroughly review your application and assessment results. AI is not used to make final decisions regarding your candidacy.

Bias Mitigation: We are committed to algorithmic fairness. Our AI-assisted tools undergo regular independent audits to detect and mitigate bias, with the goal of keeping our processes equitable and inclusive. Our methodology aligns with global best practices and regional digital ethics standards to provide every candidate with a fair and merit-based evaluation.

Your Rights & Accommodations: We provide inclusive access for all applicants. If you require a reasonable adjustment due to a disability, or if you prefer a non-automated review of your application, please contact Panopto Talent Attraction. We respect your right to request human intervention; please note that opting for a manual review may impact the standard processing timeline.

Data Privacy and Security:

Your personal data and recordings are processed securely in compliance with global privacy and employment regulations (including EEOC, GDPR, and other local or regional privacy laws, as applicable).

To facilitate our recruitment and evaluation process, limited candidate data may be shared securely with trusted third-party vendors and service providers acting on our behalf. We retain candidate data only as long as necessary to fulfill the recruitment purpose or as required by applicable statutory retention periods. Once this purpose is met, or the retention period expires, your data is securely deleted or anonymized in accordance with our data governance policy.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

Use of AI:

Statement of Transparency:

At Panopto, we embrace the transformative power of AI to enhance productivity and learning. We believe in providing a level playing field where candidates can use modern tools to put their best foot forward, provided those tools support, rather than replace, their authentic voice and expertise. While we encourage the use of AI as a tool for growth and preparation, we require transparency and authenticity to ensure a fair evaluation for all.

Acceptable Use:

  • AI-Assisted Preparation: You are encouraged to use Generative AI (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini) as a mock interviewer or coach to refine your speaking points.

  • Research & Knowledge Gathering: Using AI to synthesize industry trends or company background is permitted and viewed as proactive preparation.

  • Career Guidance Tools: Simulation tools that help you practice the STAR method or identify skill gaps are acceptable.

Prohibited Use:

  • Live Interview Assistance: The use of real-time AI "teleprompters," live answer-generators, or deepfake audio/video during Panopto recordings or live sessions is strictly prohibited.

  • Plagiarized Work Samples: Any take-home assignments or portfolios must be your original work. While AI can assist in formatting or brainstorming, the core logic and execution must be yours.

Panopto has a zero-tolerance policy toward the misrepresentation of job-related skills. Consequences of using prohibited tools may result in my immediate disqualification from the hiring process, the withdrawal of any pending offer, or termination of employment if discovered after hire.

Verification of Experience:

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and validate the skills demonstrated during your Panopto submission, Panopto may require the following "Proof of Experience":

  • Work Samples & Portfolios: Candidates may be asked to provide original work samples (e.g., code repositories, design portfolios, case studies) that pre-date the current application.

  • Digital Footprint & Professional Links: We may request links to professional profiles (e.g., LinkedIn, GitHub, Behance) to verify career trajectory and industry contributions.

Disclosures:

  • Live Validation: Any technical skill demonstrated in an asynchronous Panopto recording is subject to a live, "Human-in-the-Loop" technical assessment or deep-dive discussion.

  • Fraud Detection: Please be aware that we utilize metadata analysis and fraud detection tools to ensure the authenticity of all video submissions.

By submitting your application and participating in the recruitment process, you acknowledge and consent to Panopto's use of AI, as well as the acceptable and prohibited uses of AI as a candidate, as described above.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

Alkami is the digital sales and service platform provider for U.S. banks and credit unions. Our unified Platform integrates onboarding, digital banking, and data and marketing—each solution can stand alone, but together they deliver more—to help institutions onboard, engage, and grow relationships. As the future shifts toward Anticipatory Banking, we help data-informed bankers meet the moment with technology that drives action.

Founded in 2009, we continue to be recognized for our intentional culture and tremendous growth (Best Place to Work in Fintech; Best & Brightest to Work For Nationally; and Comparably’s Best Company Culture, Best Career Growth, Best Engineering Team, and Best Places to Work in Dallas, among others). We’re building a culture where each Alkamist can perform to their highest potential, and we’re always on the lookout for the best and brightest minds. If you’re ready to experience the power of alchemy - transforming the ordinary into the extraordinary - come join one of the fastest growing SaaS companies in the U.S.

As a remote-first company, most of our positions can be remote in the US, except for key roles, which will be indicated in the Job Title.

Follow us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn!

The Staff AI Platform Engineer builds and operates the infrastructure that enables Alkami’s Elixir agent platform to run safely in Alkami’s cloud environment and prepare for future customer-approved deployments. The role owns cloud environments, networking, identity, and deployment patterns for the platform, including agent execution environments and connectivity to internal systems. Working with the Principal AI Platform Engineer, InfoSec, and SRE, this engineer turns security and reliability requirements into practical controls. The role leads infrastructure work hands-on and helps other engineers apply consistent cloud platform standards.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities


  • Build and operate the cloud infrastructure for Elixir, including its application backend, agent execution sandboxes, and network paths to internal systems.
  • Create private, inspected connectivity that lets agents reach internal operational services without exposing those services or the platform to the public internet.
  • Develop isolated, temporary environments for agents to build services, run tests, and execute code, including provisioning, lifecycle management, and teardown.

  • Monitor capacity, performance, and cost for agent workloads, including model and sandbox usage, and implement backup, disaster recovery, and continuity plans.
  • Respond to infrastructure incidents, coordinate resolution with partner teams, and document follow-up fixes that reduce recurrence.
  • Review infrastructure designs and code, share cloud platform practices, and support the development of other engineers.

5–7 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or site reliability engineering, including operating production systems used by other teams.

Education Level

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.




Knowledge, Skills, & Qualifications


Required


  • Experience building and operating production cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or site reliability systems used by other teams.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS networking, including VPCs, transit gateways, and private connectivity, as well as IAM, compute, storage, and managed services.

  • Experience implementing cloud security controls such as single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, least privilege, secrets management, encryption, network protections, and audit logging.
  • Experience translating security or compliance requirements into practical technical controls.

Preferred
