raw.excerpt: Mylan Inc. Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally.
raw.description:
Mylan Inc.

Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases.

We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making.

Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the Director, Global Transfer Pricing will make an impact:

The Director, Global Transfer Pricing serves as a leader within the Global Tax organization, responsible for the Company's global transfer pricing strategy, policy governance, compliance, controversy management, and planning activities. The role owns the global transfer pricing framework, including policy design, strategic direction, and risk oversight, while partnering closely with the Director of Global Transfer Pricing Operations to ensure effective implementation and ongoing monitoring.


This position collaborates extensively with Finance, Treasury, Legal, Controllers, Supply Chain, Operations, R&D Finance, Global Business Services, and regional leadership teams to align transfer pricing strategies with Viatris' operating model, value chain, and business objectives. The Director plays a key role in supporting growth initiatives, business transformations, supply chain changes, intellectual property planning, acquisitions, integrations, and enterprise risk management while ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements and OECD standards.

This is a U.S.-based remote position with occasional domestic and international travel.

Key responsibilities for this role include:

  • Transfer Pricing Strategy & Planning
  • Develop and execute the company's global transfer pricing strategy to support business growth, operational efficiency, and effective tax management.
  • Design, implement, and maintain global transfer pricing policies covering intercompany transactions involving tangible goods, services, intellectual property, financing arrangements, and other cross-border transactions.
  • Evaluate transfer pricing implications associated with acquisitions, divestitures, legal entity restructuring, supply chain transformations, product launches, and operating model changes.
  • Provide strategic guidance on intellectual property planning, principal structures, contract manufacturing arrangements, shared service centers, and other business initiatives.
  • Monitor global developments related to OECD guidelines, BEPS initiatives, Pillar Two developments, and country-specific transfer pricing regulations.
  • Documentation & Compliance
  • Lead the global transfer pricing documentation program, including Master File, Local File, benchmarking studies, intercompany agreements, and supporting documentation requirements.
  • Oversee transfer pricing compliance activities across more than 160 jurisdictions and coordinate with regional tax teams and external advisors.
  • Ensure transfer pricing positions are appropriately documented, supported, and aligned with OECD guidance and local regulatory requirements.
  • Establish governance processes and monitoring controls to support timely completion of transfer pricing deliverables.
  • Support Country-by-Country Reporting and related global transparency initiatives.
  • Transfer Pricing Controversy & Risk Management
  • Lead the company's global transfer pricing audit defense strategy.
  • Manage interactions with tax authorities related to transfer pricing examinations, information requests, and controversy matters.
  • Coordinate responses to transfer pricing audits in partnership with regional tax teams, external advisors, and legal counsel.
  • Assess opportunities for dispute prevention and dispute resolution mechanisms, including Advance Pricing Agreements (APAs) and Mutual Agreement Procedures (MAPs).
  • Identify emerging transfer pricing risks and develop proactive mitigation strategies to support enterprise risk management objectives.
  • Financial Reporting & Cross-Functional Support
  • Partner with Tax Operations and Direct Tax CoE teams to assess transfer pricing impacts on accounting for income taxes, uncertain tax positions, and financial statement disclosures.
  • Support forecasting efforts related to effective tax rate, cash tax, and business planning initiatives.
  • Assist internal and external auditors on matters related to transfer pricing and intercompany transactions.
  • Provide transfer pricing support for strategic business initiatives, including acquisitions, integrations, and organizational restructurings.
  • Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  • In conjunction with operational transfer pricing, this position will serve as a subject matter expert on transfer pricing.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing global transfer pricing team.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across Tax, Finance, Supply Chain, Treasury, Legal, Operations, and business leadership.
  • Manage relationships with external advisors, economists, and benchmarking providers.
  • Effectively communicate transfer pricing strategies, risks, and opportunities to senior leaders across the organization.

The minimum qualifications for this role are:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Tax, Business, or a related field.
  • 8-10 years of progressive transfer pricing experience within a multinational corporation, Big Four accounting firm, economic consulting firm. Preference will be given to a combination thereof.
  • Deep expertise in OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines, BEPS initiatives, and global transfer pricing regulations.
  • Experience designing and implementing transfer pricing policies across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Demonstrated experience leading global transfer pricing documentation programs, service fee analysis, and supporting global tax audits.
  • Strong understanding of international tax concepts and global business operations.
  • Strong analytical, economic, financial modeling, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities, including the ability to communicate complex technical topics to senior leadership.
  • Experience managing and developing high-performing teams.
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, Master's degree, JD, LL.M., or other advanced professional credential.
  • Experience supporting public company tax accounting and financial reporting requirements.
  • Experience supporting significant business transformations, acquisitions, divestitures, and supply chain restructuring initiatives.
  • Experience with APAs, MAPs, and large-scale transfer pricing controversy matters.
  • Proficiency with tax technology, ERP systems, data analytics, and automation tools, including Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Alteryx, and related technologies.
  • Previous pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare, or medical device experience.
  • This is a U.S.-based remote position with occasional domestic and international travel.

Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. The salary range for this position is: $112,000-$236,000.

At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others.

Viatris is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

raw.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
raw.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior Security Engineer, Security Automation on Twilio’s Information Security Team.

About the job

This position is needed to assist Twilio’s Information Security Team operate more efficiently by improving and automating our critical security workflows.

As a Senior Engineer, Security Automation on this team, you will participate in all phases of the software development life cycle which includes requirements gathering with security teams, technical design, estimations, sprint planning, coding, testing, deployments and on-call support. You will own, operate and maintain automated workflows that support various security programs including but not limited to cloud security, product security, Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) and enterprise security, employing Agile methodologies to continuously deliver value to our partners.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Develop and implement automated and AI-powered security solutions to protect Twilio's Cloud and Enterprise infrastructure, leveraging data orchestration frameworks and LLM-based approaches.
  • Build workflows that integrate structured and unstructured data sources into orchestrated pipelines, enabling intelligent decision-making and risk reduction at scale.
  • Design and prototype LLM-driven applications to automate security analysis, incident response, and governance tasks, while ensuring explainability and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify security needs and deliver advanced AI-enabled solutions that address those needs effectively.
  • Contribute significantly to defining our security automation and AI roadmap, balancing near-term and long-term business impact with technical feasibility and scalability.
  • Own and maintain the operational health of automation and AI-driven systems, ensuring they continue to meet reliability and performance requirements (SLOs and KPIs).
  • Support on-call operations for tools, pipelines, and AI models owned by the team.
  • Document and share knowledge through clear technical documentation of processes, procedures, AI models, and orchestration systems.
  • Stay up-to-date on emerging trends in security automation, data orchestration, and AI/LLMs—and apply them to Twilio’s security operations for continuous innovation.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience as a software engineer developing internal tools and automating workflows at scale
  • Proficiency in Python (or another scripting language) for development, testing, and automation of security and infrastructure workflows
  • Hands-on experience applying AI/ML models, including LLMs, to automate complex business or security processes and build intelligent solutions
  • Solid understanding of software security principles, secure coding practices, and security automation
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks (e.g., Airflow, Dagster, Prefect) to manage and scale automation pipelines
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), CI/CD systems (BuildKite or similar), and container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes, Docker)
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to iterate quickly on feedback and work across security and engineering teams

Desired:

  • Experience with Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) technologies and practices, with a focus on scaling automated incident response
  • Experience automating and scaling Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) workflows, with a focus on identifying and sizing security risks for the business
  • Proven ability to design and implement security automation frameworks that enable rapid delivery of reliable, reusable, and scalable automated solutions
  • Strong interest in or hands-on experience with building and applying AI/ML models (including LLMs) to automate complex workflows in cybersecurity, compliance, or infrastructure operations
  • Ability to bridge AI/automation capabilities with security strategy, driving adoption of next-generation solutions across cloud and enterprise environments
  • Passion for continuous innovation in leveraging orchestration, automation, and AI to solve real-world security challenges

Location

This role will be remote,but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA, Washington D.C. area.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland (outside of the DC area), Massachusetts, Minnesota, or Vermont: $144,800 – $181,000
  • Based in New York (outside of the NYC area), New Jersey (outside of the NYC area), Washington State (outside of the Seattle area), Washington D.C., Washington D.C. area, Maryland, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $153,280 - $191,600.
  • Based in California (within the San Francisco Bay area), New York (within the NYC area), New Jersey (within the NYC area), or Washington State (within the Seattle area): $170,320 - $212,900.
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location within the state.

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until December 21st, but may change based on business needs.

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is hiring a Cobol Software Developer for a remote role supporting our CMS program.

The Peraton Health, State and Local Sector is seeking Cobol Software Developer to join us in supporting and maintaining the Medicare Fee For Service claims processing system. In this role, you will serve as a principal technical contributor on an Agile team providing maintenance and operations support for the Medicare Durable Medical Equipment (DME) contract.

As a Cobol Software Developer, you will help plan, direct, and coordinate software development across multiple functional areas of the DME system. This role will operate in a highly structured, rigorous development environment, spanning high-level technical design, hands-on coding, unit testing, and defect resolution. At this level, the candidate is expected to exercise a high degree of independent judgement, serve as a technical authority within the team, and provide leadership and mentorship to developers at all levels.

You will design, develop, and enhance core software programs while adhering to strict coding standards. Quality is vital to this mission, this role must build and execute your own unit test plans, test cases, and test data. Additionally, the Senior Advisor role is responsible for installing changes into internal testing regions, troubleshooting and resolving defects, and keeping technical documentation current.

What you'll do:

  • Designs, codes, unit tests, and debugs complex enhancements and fixes to the Medicare health claims processing system while adhering to strict coding standards.
  • Leads technical design sessions and drives implementation of complex software components.
  • Applies deep technical expertise to deliver reliable, high-quality maintenance and development solutions.
  • Integrate technical knowledge and business understanding to implement end-user and enterprise solutions of high complexity with minimal direction.
  • Serves as a principal technical contributor on a persistent Agile development team supporting maintenance and operations.
  • Demonstrates advanced, practical mastery of mainframe development concepts, practices, and engineering techniques.
  • Consult with team members, cross-functional organizations, clients, and vendors to resolve complex technical issues.
  • Serves as a mentor and technical resource to developers, actively supporting team growth and knowledge transfer.
  • Represents the team during client-facing technical discussions, communicating complex issues clearly and effectively.
  • Provide reliable time and resources estimates for your assigned tasks and projects to ensure sprint predictability.
  • Troubleshoot problems independently and deliver effective, well-reasoned solutions.
  • Contributes to the strategic technical direction of the development team and assists in developing solutions to complex business and technology problems.

Qualifications

What you'll need:

  • Education & Experience: BS/BA degree with 8 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree with 6 years of relevant experience; or HS diploma with 12 years of relevant experience.
  • Experience withmainframe development experience in production or maintenance environment.
  • U.S. Citizenship
  • Ability to obtain Public Trust clearance

  • Knowledge of health care claims processing, particularly Medicare Fee For Service.
  • Ability to perform well in a highly rigorous, structured development environment.
  • Demonstrated experience as a senior or principal software developer in a mainframe environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to determine and decompose business and technical requirements.
  • Application lifecycle methodology experience, specifically Agile/SCRUM.

  • Exposure to modern languages such as Java or Python.
  • SAFe experience and/or certification.

Target Salary Range

raw.description:
Job Title: Technical Support Specialist

Employment Type: Regular, Full-time

Team: Customer Success

Reports to: Senior Manager, Customer Success

Location: US – Remote

About Us:

SimpliGovis a leading government workflow automation platform that helps state and local agencies digitize and streamline mission-critical processes. Its form-building, workflow-routing, document-management, and digital-signature capabilities replace manual work with secure, auditable digital workflows. Trusted by hundreds of U.S. government agencies,SimpliGovdelivers secure, dependable SaaS technology and an exceptional customer experience.

We are growing rapidly and looking for talented, high-impact players to join our team!

Role Overview:

The Technical Support Specialist supports SimpliGov’s SaaS platform while protecting the reliability, security, and integrity of customer environments. This role investigates complex technical issues, communicates clearly with customers and internal teams, and drives incidents through diagnosis, resolution, and root-cause documentation. Leveraging AI tools, this position continuously maximizes efficiency and effectiveness in operations and reporting.

The ideal candidate is customer-focused, technically curious, and security-minded, with the ability to partner across Support, Engineering, Product, Professional Services, and Customer Success to resolve issues, validate fixes, improve operations, and strengthen the customer experience.

Responsibilities:

Technical Support

  • Own escalated customer issues involving application behavior, data, workflows, integrations, authentication, connectivity, and performance
  • Proficiency using generative AI tools to accelerate technical research, troubleshooting, case analysis, and documentation.
  • Ability to create clear, structured prompts that provide appropriate context, constraints, examples, and desired output formats.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants to develop, explain, review, and troubleshoot SQL queries, PowerShell scripts, API requests, JSON, and XML.
  • Ability to use AI to summarize logs, identify patterns, generate diagnostic hypotheses, and recommend investigation steps.
  • Strong judgment in independently validating AI-generated queries, scripts, technical conclusions, and customer communications before use.
  • Knowledge of secure and responsible AI practices, including protecting customer data, credentials, personally identifiable information, confidential information, and proprietary code.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted knowledge management, including drafting knowledge-base articles, incident summaries, root-cause analyses, and troubleshooting runbooks.
  • Ability to evaluate new AI tools and identify responsible opportunities to improve support quality, response time, and operational efficiency.
  • Understanding of prompt-injection risks and the need to treat untrusted customer content, documents, logs, and websites cautiously when using AI-enabled tools.
  • Ability to explain AI-assisted findings clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences without overstating certainty.
  • Use diagnostics, logs, and approved tools to investigate issues and execute support procedures
  • Reproduce issues, isolate causes, document findings, and determine resolution or escalation paths
  • Communicate timely, accurate updates to customers and internal stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle
  • Maintain complete and actionable case documentation in Jira Service Management and related support systems
  • Troubleshoot customer identity and access configurations
  • Diagnose certificate, networking, and web application connectivity issues across customer and SimpliGov environments

Integrations, APIs & Cloud Operations

  • Troubleshoot APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations using standard support tools
  • Supportcloud services related to identity, networking, monitoring, and application hosting
  • Analyze telemetry using available monitoring and diagnostics tools, including Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics
  • Research and resolve issues involving Microsoft 365, Microsoft Graph API, and other connected business applications
  • Maintain safe, repeatable queries, scripts, and runbooks

Product Quality & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Engineering and Product to validate defects, assess customer impact, and track resolution
  • Test bug fixes and release candidates, confirm production outcomes, and communicate relevant changes to Support and customer-facing teams
  • Collaborate with Professional Services and Customer Success on complex implementations, integrations, and customer environment issues
  • Contribute to documentation, troubleshooting playbooks, and training
  • Identifyrecurring support trends and recommend product or process improvements
  • Produce reporting dashboards, trend analysis and executive reporting packages

Qualifications:

  • 3-5+ years of progressive technical experience in a software company
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field—or equivalent combination of relevant education, certifications, and professional experience.
  • Demonstrated track record of troubleshooting technical issues and explaining complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, internally and externally
  • Ability to independently learn unfamiliar software platforms and business systems, and interpret technical documentation, system logs, API documentation, and vendor resources.
  • Advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis across SaaS applications, integrations, databases, cloud services, and logs
  • Proficiency using approved generative AI and AI-assisted development tools to support technical research, log analysis, SQL and PowerShell development, API troubleshooting, case documentation, and knowledge creation.
  • Ability to critically evaluate and independently validate AI-generated technical recommendations, queries, scripts, and conclusions before applying them in customer or production environments.
  • Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data privacy, information security, appropriate handling of customer information, and compliance with organizational AI-use policies.
  • Working knowledge of Azure, identity protocols, DNS, SSL/TLS, networking, and web application connectivity
  • Familiarity with APIs, data formats, Postman, Jira Service Management, service desk operations, and enterprise software platforms
  • Clear technical communication for case notes, customer updates, documentation, and internal guidance
  • Strong customer focus, prioritization, cross-functional collaboration, and continuous improvement mindset

What We Offer:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, with significant employer contributions for employees AND dependents (contributions based on base-level plan; buyup plans available at additional costs)
  • Company-sponsored life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance
  • 11 Paid holidays
  • Flexible time off
  • 401k plan with 4% employer match
  • Monthly home office stipend
  • Monthly wellness stipend

Why Join SimpliGov?

At SimpliGov, you’ll be part of a mission‑driven team transforming how government works. We help state and local agencies modernize their processes and deliver better services to their communities. As a Customer Success Manager, you will gain hands‑on experience working with customers, technology teams, and real public‑impact projects—while developing the skills and experience needed to advance your career.

SimpliGov is an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse, inclusive team.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Legal Disclaimers:

SimpliGov does not currently sponsor applicants for work visas.

The US base salary range for this full-time position begins at $85,000 + bonus and benefits. Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

SimpliGov participates in the federal government's E-Verify program, which confirms employment authorization of all newly hired employees and most existing employees through an electronic database maintained by the Social Security Administration and Department of Homeland Security. For new hires, the E-Verify process is completed in conjunction with the Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification on or before the first day of work. E-Verify is not used as a tool to pre-screen candidates.

raw.excerpt: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps.
raw.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Revenue Technology Manager at GitLab, you'll lead how the tools we build and buy work together as we grow our consumption-based business. You'll own the vision, roadmap, and requirements for internal go-to-market applications, starting with Command Center, which helps field teams act on product usage and consumption data. You'll decide what those applications need to do and how they should fit with the rest of the stack. Engineering will own their technical architecture, code, and infrastructure. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, reporting to the Director, Revenue Technology, within Revenue Operations.

What you’ll do

  • Define how internal and third-party tools fit together, including integrations, data flows, and governance, in partnership with the people who manage each tool.
  • Recommend when to build, buy, or consolidate tools based on cost, return on investment, and how well each option meets the needs of go-to-market teams.
  • Own the roadmap for Command Center and other internal applications. Turn requests from Sales, Solutions Architecture, Customer Experience, Product, and Ecosystem into clear requirements, and explain what you won't prioritize and why.
  • Partner with Engineering to deliver applications that fit the existing stack and limit technical debt. Lead user acceptance testing, launch, documentation, and enablement, then use adoption data to decide what to improve, expand, or retire.
  • Set the long-term direction of the revenue technology stack with Revenue Strategy, Revenue Operations, and field leaders as the business and artificial intelligence capabilities evolve.
  • Build artificial intelligence and automation workflows that save time for Revenue Technology and go-to-market teams, and help the team decide when to use them.
  • Bring consumption metrics into the tools and workflows field teams rely on, and adapt them as GitLab's consumption model matures.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in Revenue Operations, Sales or Customer Success Operations, business systems, or a related role, with ownership of tools from defining the use case and choosing a solution through launch.
  • Experience designing or guiding a go-to-market technology stack, including how tools connect and share data through application programming interfaces, integrations, data models, and permissions. Working knowledge of Salesforce, product usage data, and revenue tools such as Gainsight, Clari, Gong, or Outreach.
  • Hands-on experience with a consumption- or usage-based business model, including how teams use consumption metrics across the customer lifecycle.
  • Experience delivering internal tools with engineering teams, including writing scoped requirements and acceptance criteria and running user acceptance testing before release.
  • Experience making build-versus-buy or consolidation decisions based on cost, return on investment, and business fit. You can reconcile competing requests from senior stakeholders and explain your decisions clearly.
  • Experience shipping artificial intelligence agents or workflows people rely on, with the judgment to know where automation helps and where it adds complexity.
  • Strong written communication in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. You can prioritize your work, keep teammates informed, and collaborate through issues, documents, and merge requests.

Experience querying data directly with Structured Query Language (SQL) or a comparable tool, working with go-to-market analytics, or supporting field enablement is helpful, not required. We welcome transferable skills from related roles.

About the team

Revenue Technology owns the tools GitLab's go-to-market teams use, whether we build them or buy them. We're a globally distributed team that works asynchronously and partners with Revenue Operations, Revenue Strategy, Enablement, IT, and Engineering to support Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Ecosystem teams. We put decisions in writing and focus on making the tools easier for field teams to use.

Remote-Global

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range
$115,200—$194,400 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

raw.description:
Ready to be a Titan?

ServiceTitan is looking for an exceptional Senior Director of Product to lead our Enterprise product organization. Our largest customers are multi-brand, multi-location operators running complex organizations on ServiceTitan. This is a senior product leadership role. You will set the multi-year strategy, lead a team of product leaders and PMs, and make ServiceTitan the platform that the largest and most complex businesses in the trades can model, secure, and govern on their own terms. Just as important, you will rally product teams across the company to build enterprise-ready, organization-aware experiences. You will be expected to operate with a high degree of ownership, bring clarity to complex problems that span the company, and lead through influence well beyond your own team. The work directly drives new-logo growth, renewals, and expansion across our enterprise segment.


What you'll do:

  • Own the multi-year product strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for ServiceTitan's Enterprise pillar, including accountability for enterprise new-logo, retention, and expansion goals.
  • Lead and develop a team of product leaders and PMs, setting a high bar for product thinking, execution, and customer impact, and building the next layer of product leadership.
  • Develop a clear point of view on how ServiceTitan should serve multi- brand, multi-location operators, where to invest, and how organization modeling and security and compliance capabilities should evolve over the next several years. Bring that point of view to the Executive Team and use it to shape company-level investment decisions.
  • Rally product and engineering leaders across ServiceTitan to make their areas enterprise-ready.
  • Set clear expectations, make adoption easy, track progress across domains, and escalate tradeoffs early and constructively.
  • Turn strategy into a focused set of priorities and ensure strong execution against them, sequencing platform foundations, domain adoption, and customer rollout.
  • Work closely with Engineering, Design, Security, Legal, Go-to-Market, Customer Success,
  • Onboarding, and other product leaders to deliver cohesive enterprise experiences across ServiceTitan.
  • Navigate complex dependencies and product boundaries, making sure the Enterprise pillar works as part of the broader platform rather than as an isolated product.
  • Act as the senior product voice with our largest customers and their executive, IT, security, and audit stakeholders. Represent the Enterprise pillar with the Executive Team, customers, and partners.
  • Build strong operating mechanisms that let the organization scale, make good decisions, and execute with increasing autonomy.
  • Develop talent, give clear feedback, and create growth opportunities for the leaders and PMs in your organization.
  • Identify opportunities beyond your immediate area and contribute to the broader product and platform strategy.

What you'll bring:

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including leading product teams and owning large product areas at scale.
  • Preferred: a track record of building and scaling multi-entity B2B SaaS products for large, complex customers, such as multi-location or multi-brand organizations, franchise or national-account models, or similar.
  • Preferred: deep experience with security and compliance products: identity and access management (SSO, provisioning, roles and permissions), access governance, auditing, and compliance frameworks such as SOX or SOC 2.
  • A proven ability to drive adoption of a shared platform capability across many product teams you don't directly lead, through clear standards, strong relationships, and cross-org influence.
  • A track record of setting multi-year product strategy and turning it into measurable customer and business outcomes, including accountability for revenue, retention, or other business results.
  • Deep customer obsession paired with strong market awareness. You understand customer needs, workflows, and pain points, and you also track competitive dynamics, industry trends, and emerging technologies. You use both to inform strategy and investment decisions.
  • Exceptional product judgment and the ability to make high-quality decisions in complex and ambiguous environments.
  • Strong systems thinking and an understanding of how products, platforms, workflows, and organizational boundaries interact.
  • The ability to operate at multiple altitudes, from long-term strategy and product architecture to detailed execution and product decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and develop strong product teams and product leaders.
  • Strong executive presence, cross-functional leadership, and influence, including the ability to align Executive Team members and senior stakeholders with different perspectives.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to create clarity around complex topics for both internal and customer executive audiences.
  • A high degree of ownership and accountability, with a willingness to step beyond organizational boundaries when needed to deliver the right outcome.
  • A low-ego, enterprise-first mindset and a strong instinct for what will create the most leverage for the broader organization.

Be Human With Us:
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.


Use of AI Technology:

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.


What We Offer:

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

  • Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer-nominated awards, and more.
  • Holistic health and wellness benefits: Company-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical.
  • Support for Titans at all stages of life: Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more.

At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. For candidates in the United States, the good faith salary ranges estimate for this role isZone 1: $290,800 USD - $436,200 USD Applicable for: CA, CT, DC, MD, MA, NJ, NY, VA, and WAZone 2: $271,800 USD - $407,600 USD Applicable for: All other US locations.International Compensation for candidates residing outside the United States will vary by location and will be discussed during the hiring process. raw.description:
As a Senior Consultant, you will be responsible for leading multiple simultaneous Unanet implementations of varying complexity, while ensuring client satisfaction and successserving as both a strategic advisor and a hands-on solution expert. You will guide customers through the full implementation lifecycle, from Discovery to Go-Live, ensuring Unanet is implemented not only to meet current operational and accounting needs, but also to scale effectively with their evolving business growth

What You'll Do

  • Leverage AI-powered tools and internal automations to drive efficiency in data migration, configuration, and client onboarding
  • Understand and interpret client's business and accounting policy requirements to configure Unanet to meet their needs, including invoicing requirements, revenue recognition, labor costing, cost accounting (i.e., cost pools and overhead allocations), etc.
  • Assist clients with their first month-end close and reconciliation cycle (e.g., A/R aging, A/P aging, WIP, unbilled, bank reconciliations)
  • Initiate, execute, and support the customer throughout the implementation process to aid in their successful adoption of Unanet ERP
  • Coordinate and complete requirements gathering and configuration activities (e.g., core data load for projects, tasks, customers, employees, subcontractors, etc.)
  • Mentor less experienced consultants on supporting activities, especially with respect to multi-resource implementations
  • Lead customer training during Unanet engagements as directed
  • Adhere to standard Unanet milestone-based implementation process
  • Coordinate with the project manager to ensure projects remain on schedule and within budget
  • Maintain target utilization as determined by supervisor
  • Collaborate with supervisor to organize workload to support multiple, simultaneous implementations
  • Support efforts to continuously improve Professional Services processes and procedures
  • Participate in group meetings and training sessions to gain experience and knowledge about Unanet's product offering
  • Stay up-to-date on new product feature functionality
  • Drive adoption of Unanet’s broader solution suite (CRM, Analytics, etc.) through consultative cross-functional collaboration
  • Serve as a senior voice in client conversations, escalations, and enterprise rollouts

Your First 90 Days

In your First 30 Days:

  • Attend orientation and meet our team!
  • Review all pre-recorded videos of Unanet features available on our HelpCenter and Learning Management System (LMS)
  • Attend all available training sessions and webinars
  • Shadow an implementation consultant on at least two (2) engagements
  • Develop a detailed training plan with your manager

In your First 60 Days:

  • Continue shadowing implementations and working through your defined training plan
  • Attend all available training sessions and webinars
  • Using recorded resources and a demo database, become proficient in Time & Expense Tracking

In your First 90 Days:

  • Continue shadowing implementations and working through your defined training plan
  • Using recorded resources and a demo database, become proficient in Unanet Financials
  • Lead all or some portions of real-world client implementations
  • Achieve 15% billable utilization target

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of ERP implementation experience
  • Strong accounting foundation with practical experience in areas such as general ledger, revenue recognition, cost accounting, and project accounting
  • Experience with various accounting systems, project management, and/or practical accounting experience
  • Proficient working with and manipulating large data sets using Excel
  • Proficient at understanding and documenting complex business requirements and translating those into an actionable recommendation
  • Experience leading large and complex projects, serving as a client advocate and champion of implementation best practices
  • Familiarity with AI-enhanced productivity tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Unanet analytics automation, dashboarding accelerators) preferred

Your Differentiators

  • Prior business consulting experience
  • Experience in the GovCon industry
  • Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • CPA or equivalent accounting certification strongly preferred

Our Values

  • We are a Team. Employees, customers, and partners working together.
  • We are Customer-Focused. Customers are the heart of everything we do.
  • We are Driven. Seeking exceptional outcomes.
  • We Own our Success. Every employee has a stake in our company.
  • We do the right thing and have fun in the process.

The salary range for this opportunity is $107,200 - $126,200 per year. You will be eligible for employee equity as well as discretionary bonus compensation, subject to plans that may be in effect from time to time. You will further be eligible to participate in Unanet's employee benefits plans and programs. For more details on Unanet's benefits offerings, please visit .

Unanet is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants will be considered for positions without regard to race, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws.

raw.description:
LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Gujarati -English Phone Interpreter


Job Title: Gujarati Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $0.55 - $0.70 per minute


We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:


The Gujarati Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Gujaratiand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**


Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inGujarati and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**


Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer the majority of the workday.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

Applications will be accepted for One Hundred Eighty (180) days from the posting date of November 17, 2026.


EEO/AA

LLS is an equal opportunity employer, meaning that employment opportunities are made and offered to individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, or any other characteristic protected by federal or state law or local ordinance. LLS will reasonably accommodate employees and applicants with disabilities if the person is otherwise qualified to safely perform all of the essential functions of the position. Should you require accommodations to complete this application and/or the interview process, please let us know immediately.

Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race. color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, pregnancy, genetic information or any other consideration prohibited by law or contract.

VEVRAA Federal Contractor requesting appropriate employment service delivery systems, such as state workforce agencies and local employment delivery systems, to provide priority referrals of protected veterans.

PAY TRANSPARENCY NONDISCRIMINATION PROVISION
The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60-I.35(c)

Elite is the trusted automation platform for law firm operations across most of the world’s largest and most successful law firms. Elite has guided firms through every technology shift and today delivers the only cloud-native SaaS platform that unifies financial, invoice, time, and data management into a single system of action. With embedded AI, predictive analytics, and integrated payments, Elite’s products enable firms to shorten billing cycles, reduce write-offs, and unlock firm-wide insights, making financial operations the foundation for law firm innovation and growth. Learn more at elite.com.

Position Overview

We’re building a next-generation support organization for the future of our SaaS platform, and we’re looking for a Principal Technical Support Analyst to help lead the way. 

In this role, you’ll be part of our Tier 2 technical support function, responsible for diagnosing and resolving complex cloud, API, and platform issues. You’ll guide a team of technical experts, partner closely with Engineering and Product, and ensure our customers receive fast, accurate, and high‑quality technical resolutions. 

This role is customer-facing when needed and requires someone who can speak confidently with senior business and technical leaders during high‑visibility incidents and escalations. 

Work Arrangement:​Remote- US (Preference for NY or Florida)

Responsibilities

  • Lead and grow a high‑performing team of Tier 2 technical support engineers. 
  • Own end‑to‑end resolution of technical incidents across cloud services, APIs, and customizations. 
  • Communicate clearly and confidently with executive‑level customer stakeholders during escalations. 
  • Partner with our Technical Product Manager to prioritize issues, improve triage, and reduce engineering interruptions. 
  • Drive problem management by identifying root causes and recurring incident patterns. 
  • Help implement AI‑powered triage and deflection to improve speed and scale. 
  • Build playbooks, runbooks, and processes that elevate our support quality. 
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support departmental and company objectives.​

Qualifications

  • ​​Bachelor's Degree​ in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent education and practical experience.
  • 5+ years in SaaS technical support, operations, or escalations engineering. 
  • 2+ years managing technical support or incident‑response teams. 
  • Extensive experience speaking directly with CIOs, CTOs, senior business leaders, and enterprise architects. 
  • Strong technical troubleshooting skills across cloud platforms, APIs, and observability tools. 
  • Experience guiding customers through incidents with empathy, clarity, and confidence. 
  • Excellent communication skills—able to simplify complex technical issues for any audience.
  • Ability to travel up ​<10%​as business needs require
  • Role requires the following physical capacity:​​Light: up to 20 lbs – occasional lifting or movement of light objects​
  • Must be legally authorized to work in​​United States​; ​Elite does not provide employment sponsorship for this position​

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation Package ($144,000 - $160,000 base salary + variable Component)
  • Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage (Health, Dental, Vision)
  • Retirement Savings Plan with an Employer Contribution
  • Professional Development Opportunities
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Parental Leave
  • Time Off
  • Wellness Initiatives
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Generous Global Parental Leave
  • Calm, free premium subscription
  • Employee Discount Program

Please note that we do not offer sponsorship for this position.

Additional Information

At Elite Technology, we embrace an employee-centric, flexible work model that empowers you to do your best work in the environment that suits you. However, we also recognize the importance of in-person collaboration for key moments that truly matter.

In our flexible remote approach, you have the freedom to choose a workspace within your home country that best fits your needs. Our corporate offices are located in New York City, Los Angeles, Costa Rica, and the Philippines, providing additional options for those who prefer or need a hybrid work environment.

Our diverse global team spans the U.S., Canada, U.K., Costa Rica, the Philippines, and Australia. Please note that at this time, we are unable to hire employees located in Quebec or Ontario Provinces, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Louisiana, and Oklahoma.

As a global business, we rely on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

We also provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law.

raw.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

The Demand Generation team brings Tailscale to the people who need it, wherever they already spend their time. For many technical folks, that's a favorite YouTube channel, podcast, newsletter, or stream. As our Demand Gen Coordinator, you'll help us show up in those places in a way that feels genuine and earns trust.

You'll find creators and outlets who share our values, build real relationships with them, and guide partnerships from first hello to final deliverable. Along the way, you'll write briefs, review content, keep projects on track, and help us learn what actually works. This role is a great fit for someone early in their career who loves both technology and the people who make content about it, and who wants room to grow.

Key Responsibilities

Creator Research & Discovery

  • Research and identify creators across YouTube, podcasts, newsletters, streaming, and social media who cover self-hosting, networking, security, and developer tools.
  • Evaluate creators on audience fit, content quality, technical accuracy, values alignment, and brand safety.
  • Build and maintain a creator pipeline that tracks prospects, past partners, and performance history.

Outreach & Relationship Management

  • Own outreach to new creators and act as their day-to-day point of contact.
  • Maintain strong, long-term relationships across partnerships that often span one to two quarters with multiple deliverables.
  • Partner with your manager on proposals, negotiations, and budget by preparing recommendations on rates, deliverables, and timelines.

Contracts & Partnership Operations

  • Navigate internal processes for contracts, legal review, vendor setup, and payments in partnership with Legal and Finance.
  • Track deliverables, deadlines, payments, and usage rights across all active partnerships.
  • Keep internal stakeholders informed on partnership status, upcoming content, and blockers.

Briefs, Content Review & Facilitation

  • Write clear creative briefs that turn product launches, features, and key messages into guidance creators can run with.
  • Review content drafts for technical accuracy, messaging, brand guidelines, and disclosure requirements.
  • Facilitate feedback between creators and internal teams, including Product Marketing, Developer Relations, Engineering, and Legal, when needed.
  • QA tracking links, UTMs, and promo codes before content goes live.

Performance & Reporting

  • Track and report on partnership performance, including reach, engagement, signups, and pipeline influence.
  • Share learnings and recommend where to invest next based on what's working.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with Community Programs, Developer Relations, Social, and Lifecycle Marketing to amplify creator content and connect creators with launches, events, and campaigns.

What We Are Looking For

  • 1-3 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, sponsorships, partner marketing, demand generation, or adjacent fields.
  • Hands-on technical experience, such as running a homelab, self-hosting services, or tinkering with networking, so you can follow technical content and spot inaccuracies.
  • Experience reaching out to and building relationships with external partners, creators, or vendors.
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to write briefs that are clear, concise, and easy to act on.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a quality-assurance mindset; you catch broken links, missing tracking, or off-brand messaging before anything ships.
  • Ability to manage several partnerships at once with high reliability and end-to-end ownership.
  • Comfortable collaborating across Marketing, Legal, Finance, and Product to move multi-stakeholder projects forward.
  • Experience using LLMs and AI tools to speed up research and routine operational work.
  • Genuine curiosity about the people who create technical content and the communities that watch, read, and listen.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a developer-focused, infrastructure, security, or B2B SaaS company.
  • Active presence in technical communities such as r/homelab, r/selfhosted, Discord servers, or similar.
  • An existing network of technical creators or familiarity with the technical creator landscape.
  • Experience with influencer discovery tools or creator databases.
  • Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay, or Jira.
  • Familiarity with FTC disclosure guidelines and content usage rights.
  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally to support events and creator meetups.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

US Pay Range
$76,000—$92,000 USD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit .
