raw.description:
At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

LifeStance Health Values

  • Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.

  • Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.

  • Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.

  • One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

Benefits
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.


ROLE OVERVIEW
The Intake Coordinator plays a vital role in assisting new patients to establish care with a LifeStance provider. This position is responsible for scheduling initial assessments, collecting necessary demographic, verifying insurance eligibility, and managing referrals and clinical history to appropriately match patients with the most suitable providers. The Intake Coordinator facilitates the initial stages of client engagement and must possess excellent interpersonal skills.


Hours: Between the hours of operation of 8:00 am - 5:30 pm EST, CST, MST, and PST Monday - Friday

Compensation: $20/hour with quarterly bonus potential

RESPONSIBILITIES
Intake Department Interactions:

  • Efficiently handle communications via phone (inbound and outbound), email, voicemail, faxes, and chat.
  • Identify and communicate patient trends and feedback, including scheduling barriers to Intake.
  • Interact with Practice Operations team as necessary to ensure proper patient matching.

New Patient Assistance:

  • Conduct thorough intake assessments to understand patient needs and match them with the most appropriate provider.
  • Schedule initial appointments promptly and accurately with detail outlining patients’ needs including talk therapy and/or medication management.
  • Collect patient insurance information and run eligibility ensuring in-network benefits for matched provider.
  • Obtain and verify patient clinical history, demographic details, insurance information, and eligibility.
  • Collect credit card for file and maintain compliance.
  • Assist new patients with portal setup and new patient paperwork.
  • Process and manage referral paperwork efficiently.

Other:

  • Ensure all patient interactions and transactions are accurately documented in the Electronic Health Record (EHR) system.
  • Proactively contact referral source, patient, and/or provider office to obtain additional information that is required to complete verification of benefits and/or prior authorizations.
  • Contact existing patients to initiate new services based on internal and external referrals.
  • Assist new patient with any questions regarding new patient appointments or referrals.
  • Professionally and calmly assist with incoming emergency calls as appropriate and follow crisis call protocols.
  • Perform additional tasks and responsibilities as assigned by management to support the overall efficiency of the intake department.
  • Adhere to all relevant policies, regulations, and compliance standards throughout the intake process including HIPAA and PCI.

COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

  • Adaptability: Quickly learn and adapt to the intake department’s processes and technology, including Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems, appointment scheduling tools, and contact center systems.
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with patients, providers, and referral sources.
  • Organizational Skills: Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
  • Customer Service: A patient-centric approach with a strong commitment to providing exceptional customer service. empathy and compassion.
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to handle complex situations and make informed decisions to resolve issues efficiently.
  • Detailed Oriented: Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and completeness in all tasks.
  • Team Player: Collaborative attitude with the ability to work well in a team-oriented environment.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • 2+ years of experience in a contact center environment and/or healthcare environment.
  • Strong computer proficiency with knowledge of Microsoft Office, Internet, and Email.
  • Prior experience working with Electronic Health Record systems (EHRs), preferred.
  • Clear understanding of insurance-related terminology.
  • Fluency in English is required; fluency in Spanish preferred.
  • Quiet, distraction free, dedicated HIPAA compliant workspace in your remote office with high-speed hard-wired internet access.
  • Must be able to multi-task and prioritize work in a fast-paced work environment.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, bend, talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee must be able to lift and/or move objects up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

We’re looking for our next Channel Champion to join the team as our Technical Account Manager!

About Channelscaler

Channelscaler is transforming how companies scale through their partners. Our AI-powered platform automates and simplifies partner engagement — from onboarding and incentives to performance tracking — helping vendors and partners grow faster together.

With one unified system, companies manage their entire partner lifecycle with ease and clarity. We’re building a category-defining company rooted in expertise, empathy, and innovation — and we’re just getting started.

About the Role

As the Technical Account Manager, you’ll serve as the primary technical owner and trusted advisor for an assigned portfolio of Channelscaler customers, helping them successfully implement, operate, and optimize the platform.

You’ll develop a deep understanding of each customer’s business processes, configuration, integrations, data flows, and technical objectives, working closely with Customer Success, Implementation, Support, Product, Engineering, and Integration teams to drive successful outcomes.

This role does not carry a sales quota or direct commercial target, and is critical to strong customer technical health and long-term platform adoption.

Key Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll focus on delivering results that move both the team and company forward by:

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for assigned customers, understanding their platform configuration, integrations, data flows, and technical objectives.
  • Guide customers through technical discovery, configuration, testing, launch, and ongoing optimization, translating requirements into scalable, supportable solutions.
  • Provide expert guidance across APIs, SSO, CRM connections, data mapping, file exchanges, and other integrations.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate configuration, integration, data-quality, scalability, and operational risks.
  • Coordinate complex technical escalations across Support, Product, Engineering, and Integration teams, ensuring clear technical context, business impact, and next steps.
  • Enable customer administrators through technical workshops, configuration reviews, documentation, and knowledge transfer.
  • Partner with the Customer Success Manager on account planning, adoption, customer health, risk management, executive reviews, renewal readiness, and the joint technical roadmap.
  • Represent customer technical needs internally while communicating product capabilities, limitations, and alternatives; support technical evaluation of new capabilities and contribute to internal best practices.

What Success Looks Like

  • Strong technical health and self-sufficiency across the assigned customer portfolio.
  • Successful, on-time implementations, launches, and integrations.
  • Proactive identification and mitigation of technical and operational risks.
  • Improved integration reliability and a reduction in recurring issues.
  • Effective escalation management and high customer technical stakeholder satisfaction.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Experience in technical account management, implementation consulting, solutions consulting, technical customer success, or enterprise SaaS.
  • Strong customer-facing communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with SaaS configuration, APIs, integrations, SSO, CRM systems, data mapping, or file-based data exchange.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues, document findings, and coordinate cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organization, prioritization, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to translate customer business processes into scalable technical solutions.

Preferred (nice to have):

  • Experience with partner relationship management, channel technology, MDF, incentives, rebates, deal registration, or partner portals.
  • Experience with Salesforce or another enterprise CRM.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, middleware, logs, and integration mappings.
  • Experience supporting enterprise implementations, migrations, or technically complex customer programs.

Location & Work Environment

Channelscaler is a remote-first company with team members across the U.S., Ireland, India, and the U.K. For this role, we prefer candidates based in the U.S., with flexibility for overlap across the assigned customer portfolio's time zones. Minimal travel expected.

What We Offer

We thrive in a collaborative, growth-oriented environment that values curiosity and ownership.

Overview

Global Travel Collection (GTC), part of Internova Travel Group, is the most influential collection of international luxury travel agencies. More than 1,500 GTC advisors are industry leaders in providing premium travel services to leisure travelers, corporate executives and the entertainment industry. GTC’s combined global reach and leverage translate into value, recognition and preferential treatment for its world traveler clients.

Responsibilities

The Luxury Air Specialist manages and fulfills air travel requests on behalf of GTC Independent Advisors and their clients. Using the Sabre GDS, this role delivers exceptional, personalized air solutions to the luxury leisure traveler with the highest level of care.

As an extension of our valued Independent Advisors, this role requires a high degree of professionalism, creativity, and excellent service. The Air Specialist curates seamless air itineraries for discerning travelers, ensuring every booking reflects meticulous attention to detail, genuine care, and bespoke service. This includes proactive communication, expert handling of complex itineraries, and a deep understanding of airline products, fare structures, and operational procedures.

This role has a schedule of Monday-Friday from 9:00-5:30pm PT.

  • Service inbound air requests from Independent Advisors and their clients in a virtual environment, completing all reservations accurately and on time using the Sabre GDS.
  • Provide consultative service to Independent Advisors, travelers, and travel arrangers throughout the booking process, offering personalized air recommendations that align with traveler preferences, schedules, and budgets.
  • Apply creativity and resourcefulness in crafting itineraries, including complex routings, fare optimization, and ticketing strategies.
  • Deliver a high-touch luxury service experience through proactive communication, attentiveness, and professionalism.
  • Greet every advisor and traveler warmly and with enthusiasm and always maintain an impeccable professional demeanor.
  • Retain and proactively obtain traveler preferences, ensuring they are reflected in every itinerary.
  • Manage air bookings from reservation through post-travel follow-up, including exchanges, reissues, and schedule changes.
  • Support Independent Advisors with changes and exchanges they initiate.
  • Monitor the failed ticketing queue for bookings made by Advisors in the online booking tool.
  • Assist with Sabre reservations made in the online booking tool.
  • Liaise with airlines to resolve operational issues, secure waivers, and deliver timely solutions during disruptions.
  • Maintain detailed records of all client interactions, bookings, and correspondence in accordance with company and customer service standards.
  • Cross-sell and upsell relevant air products and services that enhance the client’s travel experience.
  • Collaborate closely with the Advisor to ensure a seamless and unified client experience.
  • Stay informed of airline policies, luxury cabin products, loyalty programs, and industry trends relevant to high-end leisure travelers.
  • Uphold professionalism in every client interaction, handling unique requests with discretion, accuracy, and care.

Qualifications

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in air travel reservations, ticketing, and customer service, preferably within a luxury leisure environment.
  • Mastery of Sabre GDS, including formats, shortcuts, enhancements, pricing, ticketing, exchanges, fare construction, and queue management; must pass a Sabre GDS assessment.
  • Expert knowledge of international travel bookings and processes, including airline fare rules, international routing, and premium cabin products.
  • Excellent travel industry knowledge and proficiency in both international and domestic destination geography.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a professional, service-oriented demeanor.
  • Proven ability to anticipate client needs and deliver proactive, white-glove service that consistently goes above and beyond.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex requests simultaneously and seamlessly while maintaining composure and precision under pressure.
  • Outstanding attention to detail and accuracy in all aspects of booking and documentation.
  • Creative problem-solving skills and a solutions-focused approach to travel challenges and schedule changes.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with both clients and internal partners.
  • Typing speed of at least 50 WPM.
  • Fluency with Microsoft Office 365, including Excel and Outlook, and familiarity with CRM or workflow management tools.
  • Schedule flexibility to support standard Air Desk coverage until 8:30 PM ET

Performance Goals:

  • Productivity – measured by transactions per month.
  • Quality – minimal customer service issues.
  • Customer Experience – measured through call monitoring performance.

Leadership Abilities:

  • Demonstrates a strong understanding of personal strengths and development opportunities.
    • Accepts direction, offers suggestions, and seeks appropriate guidance when needed.
  • Demonstrates exceptional teamwork.
    • Proactively offers support when abilities match the need.
    • Acts as a leader among peers.
    • Acknowledges and thanks peers for the support they provide.
  • Consistently demonstrates mastery of the guiding principles in daily work habits.
  • Provides constructive feedback to peers and leaders when appropriate.
  • Handles the most difficult situations with confidence.
    • Seeks minimal guidance and generally arrives with a solution in hand.
    • Supports peers in decision-making.
    • Knows when to escalate to a leader.

PAY AND BENEFITS

Our benefit offerings include choice of two medical plans and two dental plans, vision insurance, flexible spending accounts (FSAs), company-paid life insurance and AD&D, optional additional life insurance and AD&D, disability insurance, paid parental leave, paid time off, 401k Plan with company match, discounted employee travel options, access to LinkedIn Learning webinars and courses. Discounted pet insurance and auto, home, & renters insurance.

Many factors, such as years of experience, geographical location, budget etc. are considered when determining the starting rate of pay. The salary range posted represents the pay range for U.S. candidates. If the job posting indicates that the role is available for international candidate consideration, the salary range will be based on the local market for the country where the candidate would be working.

This role may be eligible for an incentive, commission, bonus, or a discretionary bonus program based on the company’s financial goal achievement and individual performance.

raw.description:
Talent Acquisition Sourcer

Location: Remote (Canada-wide)

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Category: Corporate & Support Team / Talent Acquisition

About VetCare

VetCare is a proud Canadian community of veterinary practices committed to offering exceptional patient care and client experiences. We combine the personal touch, local culture, and clinical autonomy of independent practices with the robust support, resources, and connection of a nationwide network.

At VetCare, our values guide everything we do:

  • Come together as one: We support each other as one team.

  • Always focus on the patient: We prioritize clinical excellence, patient care, and client connection.

  • Raise the bar: We pursue continuous improvement, personal development, and positive change.

  • Engage with empathy: We seek understanding and lead with compassion in every interaction.

Position Purpose

The Talent Acquisition Sourcer / Junior Recruiter is the core outbound pipeline engine for VetCare’s national talent team. This role is built specifically for a true hunter—someone energized by proactive search, direct headhunting, and tracking down passive clinical professionals across Canada, with an acute focus on rural, northern, and hard-to-fill markets.

We already have great recruiters managing relationship stewardship and process management; what we need now is an outbound specialist who thrives on uncovering hidden talent and feeding qualified Doctors of Veterinary Medicine (DVMs) and Registered Veterinary Technologists/Technicians (RVTs) to our senior recruiters. You will partner closely with our internal recruiting team as your primary stakeholders, handling screening and interview handoffs while providing the administrative velocity that keeps pipelines moving. Direct exposure to multi-site practice managers and regional leadership will serve as a natural operational growth path as your role evolves.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

Passive Sourcing & Pipeline Hunting (50%)

  • Execute aggressive outbound headhunting strategies across specialized platforms, including LinkedIn Recruiter, provincial veterinary licensing registries, university faculties, associations (CVMA), and clinical networks.

  • Target, map, and nurture talent communities in persistent, hard-to-fill markets (e.g., Northern Ontario, rural Alberta, interior British Columbia, and rural Atlantic Canada).

  • Craft highly customized, compelling cold-outreach messaging that cuts through the noise, articulating VetCare’s clinical autonomy, practice culture, and sustainable workload model.

  • Conduct initial phone screens to evaluate clinical interests, licensing eligibility, relocation appetite, and mutual culture fit before handing warm leads off to our senior recruiters.

Recruitment Coordination & Team Support (30%)

  • Partner side-by-side with our senior recruiters to manage candidate logistics, schedule seamless recruiter interview handoffs, and ensure candidate momentum across multiple Canadian time zones.

  • Maintain rigorous ATS hygiene—tracking lead statuses, pipeline movement, and sourcing channel metrics to keep team dashboards accurate and actionable.

  • Support pre-employment administration, including professional clinical reference checks, regulatory credential verifications with provincial colleges, and offer package documentation.

  • Maintain job board postings across regional and academic platforms, ensuring alignment with provincial standards and pay transparency legislation.

Market Intelligence & Candidate Engagement (20%)

  • Serve as an engaging, authentic first contact for clinicians, navigating sensitive discussions around burnout, relocation barriers, and scheduling needs with high empathy.

  • Keep a pulse on competitor offerings, compensation trends, and provincial licensing shifts, sharing real-time market insights with the talent acquisition team.

  • Support early-career student outreach, campus career events, and RVT externship pipelines alongside the senior recruiters.

What You Bring (Qualifications & Competencies)

  • Hunter Mindset (Essential): You are a relentless outbound sourcer who enjoys the thrill of the chase. You prefer prospecting, direct outreach, and cold pipeline creation over administrative "farming" or waiting for applications to arrive.

  • Experience: 1–3 years of hands-on recruitment sourcing or coordination experience within an agency or in-house talent team. Prior experience in healthcare, locum staffing, or niche/scarce-talent industries is a strong asset.

  • Education: Post-secondary diploma or degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical work experience).

  • Sourcing & Digital Tools: Strong working command of Boolean logic, LinkedIn Recruiter workflows, and modern ATS/CRM systems. Proficient with Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace.

  • Canadian Regulatory Landscape: Foundational understanding of Canadian employment standards; exposure to provincial veterinary colleges (e.g., CVO, ABVMA, BCVMA) is considered an asset.

  • Bilingualism: Fluency in French is considered an asset.

  • Resilience & EQ: High emotional intelligence to build instant rapport with guarded medical professionals, combined with the persistence needed to thrive in tight candidate pools.

Key Success Measures (KPIs)

  • Outbound Pipeline Delivery: Volume of vetted, qualified DVM and RVT candidates passed along to internal recruiters monthly.

  • Sourcing Velocity: Conversion rates from initial cold outreach to completed preliminary screen.

  • Hard-to-Hire Impact: Consistent candidate discovery and engagement in remote, rural, and high-vacancy clinical regions.

  • Coordination Efficiency: Smooth handoffs to internal recruiters with minimal turnaround delay or candidate drop-off.

  • ATS Integrity: Pristine candidate records, updated stage tracking, and clear communication notes.

What We Offer (Compensation & Benefits)

  • Competitive Compensation: Base salary range of $65,000 – $75,000 CAD per year, commensurate with sourcing depth and industry background.

  • Incentive Potential: Eligible for an annual performance bonus (5%–10%) plus placement-based milestone bonuses per DVM hire retained past 6 months.

  • Work Arrangement: 100% remote work flexibility from anywhere in Canada.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Group coverage including extended health, dental, vision care, life insurance, and disability.

  • Professional Growth: Clear advancement path into full-cycle recruiting and regional operations, supported by an annual professional development budget for recruitment training, certifications, and HR memberships.

  • Collaborative Culture: A supportive internal team where your sourcing impact directly shapes clinic success and community pet care.

VetCare is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion across all our practices and corporate teams. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We're looking for a Product Designer with experience designing for technical documentation to join the Tailscale product design team. You will work as a designer dedicated to the Docs team focusing on information architecture of the site, presentation of content, and educational support materials.

At Tailscale, we don’t see Documentation as an afterthought; it’s how users learn, deploy, troubleshoot, and fall in love with Tailscale. It’s both a discovery surface and a place where users look to find answers in stressful situations.

This designer will work closely with dedicated engineers on the Docs site to ensure the quality and delivery of content meets the needs of all users. They will collaborate with technical writers, product designers, engineers, PMs, and customer-facing colleagues to ensure documentation is intuitive, visually compelling, and deeply user centric.

Key Responsibilities

Some examples of projects we anticipate in the near term:

  • Support a transition from our current docs platform to a new one, including appropriate IA changes for a large docs corpus.
  • Establish a brand-appropriate style guide for the new docs site that optimizes for readability.
  • Draft and maintain a library of diagrams to be used as assets within the docs site and educational content.
  • Enable experimentation on docs surfaces through collaboration with the growth team and test-related tooling.
  • Design educational content for LMS materials with attention to classroom usability.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of product design experience, including complex work you've owned end-to-end (portfolio required)
  • Experience with technically sophisticated B2B or infrastructure applications
  • A portfolio that shows how you've made technical content clear, usable, and visually engaging
  • Experience adapting brand guidelines to documentation and educational content
  • Proven success working in a distributed, async environment

Mindset and Approach

  • You think of documentation as a product, not a deliverable: you ask what users need, test your assumptions, and iterate
  • You're comfortable with technical subject matter—networking, infrastructure, security. You don't need to be an expert, but you're curious and willing to learn
  • You communicate complex ideas clearly through layout, diagram, example, and plain language
  • You're collaborative and low-ego, working directly with engineers and technical writers who bring their own approaches
  • You use data and feedback to guide decisions, and you hold strong opinions about what makes documentation work
  • You run your own workload, shift between projects as priorities change, and don't need someone else to tell you what matters
  • You have a confident point of view on users and product quality—and the initiative to act on it

Nice to Have

  • Front-end literacy (HTML/CSS) to collaborate effectively on implementation
  • Experience with static site generators (we use a custom Markdown setup)
  • Familiarity with networking or infrastructure concepts (VPNs, DNS, firewalls, routing)
  • Experience with AI-assisted design or content tools
  • Experience designing developer-facing documentation (technical guides, reference material, troubleshooting, tutorials)

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

US Pay Range
$146,000—$183,000 USD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Binnen de afdeling Dierenwelzijn krijgt een Senior AI Consultant de opdracht om de mogelijkheden van artificiële intelligentie binnen een case managementsysteem mee vorm te geven en technisch te realiseren. Het systeem wordt gebruikt voor het beheer van inspectiedossiers.

Een eerste concrete use case bestaat uit het automatisch analyseren en classificeren van binnenkomende meldingen. Daarbij kunnen beslissingsbomen, historische dossiers en beschikbare contextinformatie worden ingezet. Het doel is om meldingen sneller en consistenter te beoordelen en medewerkers gericht te ondersteunen bij de verdere behandeling van dossiers.

Daarnaast worden bijkomende AI-toepassingen geïdentificeerd en gerealiseerd. Die kunnen helpen om administratieve en repetitieve taken te vereenvoudigen, relevante informatie uit dossiers te ontsluiten en medewerkers te ondersteunen bij dossierbehandeling en besluitvorming.

Je neemt binnen dit traject een inhoudelijk en technisch leidende rol op. Je helpt de AI-aanpak en architectuur bepalen, beoordeelt use cases en technische oplossingsrichtingen, bewaakt kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid en uitlegbaarheid en ontwikkelt zelf de complexere onderdelen van de AI-oplossingen. Je werkt nauw samen met een AI Consultant Medior, bestaande ontwikkelaars, technische partners en de business.

De opdracht omvat onder meer

  • Analyseren van processen, gegevens, documenten, businessregels en andere informatiebronnen binnen het case managementsysteem.
  • Samen met de business geschikte AI-use-cases identificeren en prioriteren.
  • Per use case de meest geschikte technische oplossingsrichting bepalen, bijvoorbeeld machine learning, NLP, generatieve AI en LLM's, retrievaltechnieken, rule-based oplossingen of een combinatie daarvan.
  • De technische AI-architectuur en integratieprincipes uitwerken.
  • Complexere AI-componenten en prototypes technisch ontwerpen en zelf ontwikkelen.
  • De eerste concrete use case voor de analyse, classificatie en triage van meldingen technisch begeleiden.
  • Bepalen hoe historische dossiers, documenten, gestructureerde gegevens, contextinformatie en businessregels betrouwbaar kunnen worden gecombineerd.
  • Criteria en methodes definiëren om AI-oplossingen te evalueren op kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid, uitlegbaarheid en bruikbaarheid.

Bitwarden empowers enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely store and share sensitive data. With a transparent, open-source approach to password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations, Bitwarden makes it easy for users to extend robust security practices across all online activities. Founded in 2016 with headquarters in Santa Barbara, California, Bitwarden is supported by a passionate global community of security experts and enthusiasts.

As a Software Engineer on the Self-host Orchestration team at Bitwarden, you will directly contribute to projects that our customers use to deploy Bitwarden into their infrastructure. You’ll be a part of the team that builds and maintains the packaging, testing, and deployment for our self-host product, including our Helm chart project. This role also offers the opportunity to interact directly with our open source community through pull request and triaging community issues. This is an all remote team and we are looking for a US based engineer. We don not offer sponsorship at this time

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Be the expert and authority on our Self-host Helm charts and our wider self-host architecture including: backend infrastructure, APIs, database, web app, and how the mobile apps, browser extensions, desktop apps, interact with self-host

  • Build and maintain our Self-host Helm charts and self-host infrastructure, delivery pipeline, automation, SDLC and development practices.

  • Collaborate with the rest of the team on system design for our owned tools and codebase.

  • Collaborate closely with our Implementation Engineering and Customer Success teams to understand client needs and implement technical solutions to address them

  • Build and maintain tools that deploy & test our self-host stacks on diverse infrastructure setups

  • Participate in hands-on development of Bitwarden products

  • Use, maintain, and augment or AI skills and infrastructure as part of our AI-driven product delivery lifecycle.

  • Participate in code reviews, learning and spreading technical knowledge

  • Contribute bug fixes for issues submitted by the user community

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

  • High proficiency with containerization and container orchestrators, such as Kubernetes with experience with at least one cloud hosted Kubernetes service (EKS, AKS, GKE)

  • Proficiency creating and maintaining Helm charts

  • Experience with Argo CD, Fluxcd, or alternative GitOps delivery tools

  • Proficiency with at least one cloud platform, Azure preferred

  • Proficiency with Git and dependency management

  • Experience writing code in at least one programming language, .NET or Python preferred

  • Proficiency with Linux server administration including Nginx and Bash and/or PowerShell scripting

  • Excellent communication skills, collaborative mindset, and a zeal for learning — your first phase will be learning everything you can from other team members and documentation

NICE-TO-HAVES

  • User of Bitwarden

  • Startup experience

  • Open source experience

  • Remote work experience within an Agile sprint-based project management workflow

  • Experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions

  • Experience self-hosting; extra points for experience self-hosting Bitwarden and/or self-hosting on Windows

  • Experience with Ansible, Terraform, Packer, etc.

  • Experience with Kubernetes security

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

Selected candidates will be invited to schedule a 30-minute screening call and then progress through the following stages:

  • Interview with Hiring Manager

  • A take-home test where you can show off your skills

  • Interview with the Team

  • Additional Interviews as required

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

  • Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.

  • Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.

  • We are dedicated to building an incredible team. Work remotely with motivated and innovative team members and take part in productive and fun meetups.

  • Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team.

We recognize and understand that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence; therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. Please let us know if you require accommodations during the interview process.

raw.description:
Give hope. Give health. Make your mark in the fight against cancer.

At Accuray, we make a direct and powerful impact on the lives of cancer patients every day — helping them live longer, better lives. But our commitment to innovation offers a truly unique opportunity: the chance to change the fight against cancer — helping to develop, introduce and support new treatment delivery systems and software that will give new hope and new health to cancer patients and cancer survivors around the world.

Accuray develops, manufactures and sells radiotherapy systems for alternative cancer treatments. Our radiation therapy for cancer makes treatment shorter, safer, personalized and more effective, ultimately enabling patients to live longer, better lives.

Job Description

1. JOB SUMMARY

The Clinical Training Instructor is responsible for delivering high-quality in‑person and virtual clinical training to customers to support safe, effective, and confident use of Accuray treatment delivery systems. This remote-based role focuses on customer education, curriculum development, and ongoing clinical support to drive user adoption, clinical excellence, and customer success.

The position is approximately 80% customer training and curriculum development/refinement and 20% customer support activities (call support, onsite go-live support, virtual support), in addition to required travel for industry trade shows and key customer events.

2. REPORTING TO / DEPARTMENT

Reports to the Senior Manager, Global Clinical Training and Operations
Department: Clinical Training (Service Organization)

3. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Customer Training & Education

  • Deliver in‑person and virtual training on the safe and effective operation of Accuray treatment delivery and planning systems
  • Conduct multi-day customer training programs, including lectures, demonstrations, and hands-on exercises
  • Provide training at customer sites, Accuray Center for Education (Madison, Wisconsin), virtual platforms, and industry events
  • Adapt training delivery to meet varying customer experience levels, clinical workflows, and learning styles
  • Support customer education at tradeshows, user meetings, and other professional events

Curriculum Development & Continuous Improvement

  • Create, develop, review, and refine classroom and virtual training materials for new and existing users
  • Ensure training content reflects current clinical best practices, product updates, and customer feedback
  • Collaborate cross-functionally (Clinical Applications and Physics Support, Product Marketing, R&D, etc.) to provide clinical user insight that informs product development and commercialization

Customer Support & Professional Engagement

  • Leverage academic and clinical expertise to support customers in understanding advanced clinical and technical concepts related to Accuray technologies
  • Provide post-training support to reinforce learning and drive long-term clinical adoption
  • Participate in departmental and cross-functional projects to meet organizational objectives
  • Maintain professional engagement through attendance at professional meetings, tradeshows, and related activities

4. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

a. Preferred / Desired

  • Previous experience in Radiation Oncology; preferably as a Medical Dosimetrist
  • Accuray product experience preferred (training provided if needed)
  • 3–5 years of experience in clinical training, education, or instructional roles in industry or academic environments, or equivalent clinical experience
  • Associate’s degree or higher preferred; equivalent scientific or clinical experience acceptable
  • Cross-cultural communication skills a plus

raw.description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey.
  • We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
  • We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
  • We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.
And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

Bloomreach is building the future of commerce experiences, helping businesses create more relevant, intelligent, and measurable interactions with their customers. As AI reshapes how people discover, evaluate, and buy products, we are expanding our capabilities in Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) -helping brands become visible, credible, and preferred in the new generation of AI-driven search and answer experiences.

We are looking for a commercial leader to help turn a high-quality AEO product into a scaled, repeatable growth business inside Bloomreach.

The opportunity

The AEO product has strong product and engineering leadership along with proof points selling to large enterprises and SMBs. The next phase is to accelerate the business into the next phase of growth with B2C brands.

This is a build-and-scale role - not a traditional sales leadership position focused only on optimizing an established motion. You will own the commercial strategy, validate where the product wins, shape the sales and customer lifecycle around those insights, and create the operating model needed for sustainable growth.

You will lead the existing four-person AEO commercial team, while also building a strong partnership with Bloomreach’s broader sales organization. A central part of the role will be determining how AEO can be cross-sold into Bloomreach’s existing customer base or co-sold with existing Bloomreach products - and how our core sellers can confidently identify, position, and help sell the product as part of broader customer solutions.

What you will own

1. Establish product–market fit in B2C Enterprise Brands segment

  • Translate product strengths into a crisp commercial narrative that resonates with B2C Enterprise Brands.
  • Build a disciplined learning loop across prospects, customers, partners/broader ecosystem, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success.
  • Personal product mastery: Identify where the current product is strongest, where it needs to evolve, and which opportunities should be prioritized commercially.
  • Turn early wins and customer evidence into repeatable messaging, qualification criteria, sales plays, and proof points.
  • Help champions turn an emerging AEO mandate into a funded initiative: shape the business case with marketing leadership, secure executive sponsorship, and align relevant teams and budgets.

2. Scale to $10M ARR

  • Create and execute the commercial plan to grow the business to $10M ARR.
  • Establish the right balance of new-logo acquisition, expansion, renewal, and strategic account development.
  • Build a measurable operating cadence across pipeline creation, conversion, deal velocity, forecast accuracy, retention, expansion, and team productivity.
  • Set the right coverage model, territories, quotas, incentives, capacity plan, and hiring roadmap as the business scales.
  • Personally engage in strategic opportunities and executive-level customer relationships where they can materially accelerate growth.

3. Build a high-performing AEO commercial team

  • Lead, coach, and develop the current AEs and CSMs, creating clarity on roles, expectations, priorities, and measures of success.
  • Strengthen the end-to-end customer journey from qualification through implementation, adoption, renewal, and expansion.
  • Define the skills, profiles, and structure needed for the next stage of growth.
  • Hire selectively as evidence supports expansion of the team.
  • Create a culture of accountability, customer empathy, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

4. Create the cross-sell and partner motion with the core sales organization

  • Develop a clear strategy for introducing AEO into Bloomreach’s existing customer base and co-selling alongside existing Bloomreach sellers.
  • Identify the customer segments, account signals, trigger events, and use cases that indicate cross-sell potential.
  • Design a practical engagement model between the AEO team and Bloomreach’s main sales organization—including ownership, qualification, account planning, compensation, handoffs, and deal support.
  • Equip core sellers with the messaging, training, discovery questions, collateral, demos, and commercial plays needed to identify and open AEO opportunities.
  • Build trust and shared incentives so the AEO team is viewed as a growth partner—not a competing sales channel.
  • Establish a repeatable model for specialist-led, core-sales-assisted, and core-sales-led opportunities.

5. Partner cross-functionally to shape the business

  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to connect market feedback to roadmap priorities and commercial readiness.
  • Partner with Marketing on positioning, category creation, demand generation, customer proof, events, and thought leadership.
  • Collaborate with Finance and Revenue Operations on planning, forecasting, reporting, compensation, and business performance.
  • Bring customer and market insight to the broader Bloomreach leadership team and help shape the role of AEO in the company’s overall strategy.
  • AI operating skills. Use AI tooling like Codex and Claude Code to test hypotheses against company data, inspect deals, build forecasts, and build leverage into GTM

What success looks like

In the first 90 days

  • Establish Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) Repeatability - demonstrating that the team can win cleanly within a tightly defined target sandbox, rather than taking any random deal that comes along including
  • ICP Concentration:80%+ of closed-won deals match your designated Ideal Customer Profile firmographics and personas.
  • Consistent Positioning: Marketing and AEs use the exact same value proposition, resulting in a predictable cost-per-meeting and inbound conversion rate.
  • Customer Time-to-Value: A repeatable customer success framework ensures customers hit their "first value milestone" within a defined, predictable number of days post-sale.
  • Create and agree “rules of engagement” of selling AEO to Bloomreach prospects and customer base
  • A team and hiring plan aligned to the path toward $10M ARR.

In the first 6 months

  • Evidence-based refinement of the ICP, positioning, qualification process, and sales motion.
  • A repeatable set of winning use cases and referenceable customer outcomes.
  • A functioning cross-sell motion with clear account selection, roles, incentives, enablement, and handoffs.
  • Improved pipeline generation, conversion, forecast accuracy, and customer expansion.

Over time

  • AEO becomes a repeatable, scalable growth business within Bloomreach.
  • The business is on a credible path to $10M ARR.
  • Bloomreach’s core sales organization consistently identifies and helps create AEO opportunities.
  • Customers see AEO as a strategic capability in their AI-era growth agenda.
  • The commercial team operates with strong execution, clear accountability, and a culture of learning.

What we are looking for

  • Significant experience leading Sales, Business Development, or a full commercial function in a B2B SaaS, martech, ecommerce, data, or AI-related business
  • Growth mindset to be able to embrace and build AI native sales motion
  • A track record of taking a product or business from early commercial traction to meaningful scale ideally including hypergrowth or a step-change in ARR.
  • Experience establishing product–market fit or refining a GTM motion when the ICP, positioning, and sales process are still evolving.
  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to move between strategy and hands-on execution.
  • Demonstrated success selling to senior business and technology stakeholders, with a strong grasp of value-based and consultative selling.
  • Experience building repeatable enterprise sales motions, including pipeline generation, forecasting, deal inspection, and account expansion.
  • Experience designing or scaling cross-sell, partner-selling, overlay, or specialist-led sales motions within a broader sales organization.
  • Strong people leadership skills, including coaching sellers, developing customer success talent, and hiring for the next stage of growth.
  • Comfort working closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and Revenue Operations in a highly collaborative environment.
  • Exceptional communication skills, executive presence, and the ability to create alignment across teams with different goals and incentives.
  • A data-informed, experimental approach: you form hypotheses, test them with customers, learn quickly, and make clear decisions.

Particularly valuable experience

  • Commercial leadership at an AI-native company or a company undergoing a major shift in how customers discover, evaluate, or buy products.
  • Experience with AEO, AI search, generative AI, SEO, digital commerce, martech, customer data, or adjacent categories.
  • Experience selling an emerging category where the market narrative and buyer education still need to be created.
  • Experience taking a product to $10M+ ARR.
  • Experience building a productive partnership between a specialist product team and a larger, established sales organization.
  • Experience working with customers whose needs, buying process, and commercial profile differ from the product’s historical customer base.

How you lead

  • Customer-led: You seek evidence from customers and the market before locking in a strategy.
  • Builder-minded: You are energized by creating the motion, not just inheriting it.
  • Commercially rigorous: You connect activity to outcomes and make trade-offs explicit.
  • Collaborative: You know how to create leverage through a broader sales organization rather than building a silo.
  • Clear and decisive: You bring structure to ambiguity, communicate simply, and make decisions at the right pace.
  • Coaching-oriented: You raise the performance of the team through context, feedback, and high standards.

More things you'll like about Bloomreach:

Culture:

  • A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one.
  • We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.
  • We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.
  • We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.
  • We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.
  • We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*.
  • The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5

Personal Development:

  • We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions.
  • Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.*
  • Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins.
  • Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)*

Well-being:

  • The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.*
  • Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.*
  • We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones.
  • We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other.
  • Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.*

Compensation:

  • Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.*
  • Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.*
  • We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000!
  • We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!*

(*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.)

Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences!

If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful!

Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees.

Location: This role is remote in the United States, Canada, or some countries in South America.

Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.

At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

How you’ll make an impact

You will join the Data Services team - one of three teams in a data platform group of about ten engineers, alongside infrastructure and developer productivity.

  • Work closely with data analysts, data engineers, and machine learning engineers to understand their needs - and evolve the Doximity data stack to meet them.
  • Build the foundations that make client-facing data delivery safe and repeatable - per-client data isolation, access controls, and auditability.
  • Build and operate the MCP-based tooling and agentic workflows through which analysts and clients interact with the data platform - and the data it manifests - by conversation rather than tickets.
  • Work in a HIPAA-regulated environment where the right people and systems reach the data they need and nothing more - masking policies, scoped roles, audit trails, and approval gates that hold up to scrutiny from auditors and clients alike.
  • Understand what our data product teams are trying to achieve, and design solutions that maximize the time they spend on their goals and minimize the time lost to technical hurdles.
  • Help strengthen our software engineering culture within the data organization, leading by example.
  • Diagnose development, performance, and stability issues in our core data pipelines and Python libraries, and help product data teams resolve problems that need platform-level expertise.

What we’re looking for

  • We’re seeking a strong Python engineer who brings deep professional experience in data engineering and internal tooling, with a track record of supporting multiple product teams simultaneously.
  • Especially valuable experience:
    • Snowflake beyond querying - governance features, cloning, Time Travel and Fail-safe, hybrid tables, streams, and data lifecycle capabilities, Cortex suite of AI tools, Snowpark Container Services, or data sharing.
    • Kafka, change data capture (CDC) like Debezium, and database internals - a significant portion of our pipeline work lives here.
    • Operating under HIPAA, SOC 2, or similar - least-privilege design, masking and de-identification, audit logging.
    • Building or operating agentic and MCP-based tooling.
    • Apache Airflow and AWS.
    • Container-based development workflows (Kubernetes, Docker) - useful, but secondary to the above.
    • We don’t expect all of these. Depth in Python, SQL, and data engineering is the requirement; the rest tells us where you’ll ramp fastest.
  • The ideal candidate will demonstrate expert fluency in Python and an understanding of programming language internals.
  • Advanced knowledge of software engineering practices and testing methodologies is a must; you are foremost an engineer, making you passionate about high-quality code, automated testing, and software engineering best practices. You demonstrate this both within your own team and with colleagues beyond it.
  • You have deep fluency in SQL, using analytical databases, and are able to practically employ and orchestrate user defined functions, stored procedures, and other database-oriented solutions to deliver performant and cost-effective database-driven solutions.
  • You have worked with data that carries real handling obligations - PHI, PII, or client-confidential data - under a framework like HIPAA, SOC 2, or GDPR. You design for least-privilege access by default, you think in terms of blast radius and auditability, and you treat these as engineering problems rather than paperwork.
  • Your ability and drive to self-manage, prioritize tasks, and deliver functional solutions will be crucial to succeeding in this role.
  • You treat AI-driven engineering as part of the craft, not a novelty - agentic coding tools, MCP-based tooling, and automation that removes toil - and you invest in keeping your practice current as the tools evolve. You communicate clearly in writing and in person, and you keep your work legible through practices like clear change management and well-documented code. You see your teammates as your first customer.

About Us

  • Explore our stack
  • We have over 500 private repositories in Github containing our pipelines, our own internal multi-functional tools, and open-source projects
  • We have worked as a distributed team for a long time; we're currently about 65% distributed
  • Find out more information on theDoximity engineering blog
  • Our company core values
  • Our recruiting process
  • Our product development cycle
  • Our on-boarding & mentorship process

Compensation

The anticipated total compensation for this role is $165,000 - $227,000, depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

Our total compensation package may include:

  • Base salary
  • Equity (where applicable)

Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Flexible paid time off and company holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Professional development and learning opportunities
  • Wellness and mental health resources
  • Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable)

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.

  • Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.
  • Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.
  • Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.
  • Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.
  • Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.

Our Hiring Process & AI Tools

Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description:

We are looking for a skilled Senior threat actor communications and engagement professional to support GuidePoint’s Digital Forensics and Incident Response practice within the GuidePoint Research and Intelligence Team (GRIT). The primary function of this role will be threat actor communications (also known as threat actor engagement, or ransomware negotiations) for GuidePoint’s clients, collecting intelligence and advising digital extortion victims of appropriate courses of action aligned to their business needs. This is a client-facing role, requiring tact, professionalism, and a robust understanding of threat actor behavior and organization. The ideal candidate will also support GRIT’s intelligence research efforts, operationalizing threat intelligence data obtained through threat actor engagement and digital forensics efforts.

The Senior Threat Actor Engagement and Intelligence Consultant will be required to demonstrate strong client-facing consulting skills, calm under pressure, communications ability, and initiative under circumstances with unclear or incomplete guidance.

About the GuidePoint Research and Intelligence Team:

GRIT provides managed Threat Intelligence and Exposure Management services, Deep and Dark Web investigations, threat actor engagement, threat briefings, and advisory consulting in CTI operationalization, maturity, and program development. In each of these services, our goal is to better secure and prepare our clients to build, implement, and improve their security and CTI programs through advisory, instruction, assistance, or direct support.

Additionally, GRIT supports GuidePoint’s DFIR practice, providing Threat Intelligence support to active intrusion investigations and response efforts, or informing DFIR advisory efforts and tabletop exercises. GRIT performs independent threat research into Ransomware and the cybercrime threat landscape, contributing to quarterly and annual reports, as well as Requests For Information (RFIs) and media inquiries.

GuidePoint Security’s GRIT service offerings evolve in response to emerging threats and diverse client needs, and your creativity and expertise will assist the GRIT Practice with adapting to this rapidly changing environment.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Lead and conduct Threat Actor Communications engagements, advising clients, legal counsel, and insurance carriers on risks, benefits, and key considerations for communication with threat actors in ransomware and data extortion cases.
  • Operate as a technical resource within the Practice and actively participate in DFIR investigations to share and identify actionable intelligence.
  • Effective engagement communication, time management, and collaboration with peers and clients. Foster client relationships by providing support, information, and guidance
  • Author comprehensive engagement deliverables that are tailored to both technical and managerial audiences; fully detail the technical findings, recommendations, business impact, and realistic remediation strategies.
  • Utilize automation, orchestration, and scripting to reduce manual processes, improving overall efficiency while also enabling new capabilities to meet the rapidly changing needs of our clients.
  • Contribute to integration of existing and future open-source and commercial tools or automation to help improve GRIT processes and procedures.
  • Perpetually strengthen relevant skills, knowledge, and abilities to stay at the forefront of the information security industry.
  • Maintain a strong desire to learn, adapt, and improve along with a rapidly growing company.
  • Willingness and ability to support a rotating on-call schedule, including possible weekend work as needed to support emergency requirements.

Required Experience and Education:

  • 7+ years of experience performing Threat Intelligence analysis and/or collection or 3+ years of experience and a BS/BA
  • Prior experience in communicating with threat actors, such as through virtual persona operations, ransomware negotiations, or use of “sock puppet” accounts in Deep and Dark Web collection.
  • Prior experience in intelligence sharing relationships and partnerships within the private sector, ISACs, government, and/or private intelligence sharing groups.
  • Prior experience in building and developing persona operations, including familiarity with dark web forums and marketplaces, adversary behavior, and trust mechanisms.
  • Familiarity with digital forensics and incident response workflows, processes, and deliverables.
  • Experience in client-facing, professional services, or consulting roles.
  • Experience using emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes.

Preferred Experience and Education:

  • 6-10 years prior experience in communicating with threat actors, such as through virtual persona operations, ransomware negotiations, or use of “sock puppet” accounts in Deep and Dark Web collection.
  • Familiarity with cryptocurrency tracing and blockchain technology.
  • Experience implementing or improving operational processes or procedures in the intelligence lifecycle.
  • Proficiency hunting APT data using open source or commercial cyber threat analytic tools or data repositories such as VirusTotal, Passive Total, Threat Miner, or Maltego.
  • Experience in scoping and conducting threat research centered on cybercrime, ransomware, and/or nation-state cyber operation.

raw.description:
Enterprise Transformation Director – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Enterprise Transformation Director is responsible for defining, leading, and overseeing the organization's enterprise-wide transformation strategy to improve business performance, operational efficiency, financial sustainability, customer experience, and long-term competitiveness.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role drives large-scale transformation initiatives across business operations, technology, organizational structures, digital capabilities, governance, and customer-facing services.

The incumbent translates corporate strategy into an integrated transformation roadmap, oversees strategic programmes and transformation portfolios, and ensures initiatives deliver measurable business value. The role works closely with the CEO, executive leadership, business unit heads, and external partners to drive sustainable organizational change and achieve strategic objectives.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Enterprise Transformation Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and lead the organization's enterprise-wide transformation strategy, vision, and execution roadmap.
  • Translate corporate strategy into transformation priorities, strategic initiatives, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities for business model innovation, organizational improvement, operational modernization, and sustainable growth.
  • Align transformation initiatives with corporate objectives, market developments, customer expectations, and regulatory requirements.
  • Advise the CEO and executive leadership on transformation priorities, investment decisions, and strategic opportunities.

B. Business Model & Operating Model Transformation

  • Lead enterprise-wide operating model redesign and organizational transformation initiatives.
  • Evaluate existing business structures, processes, capabilities, and operating models to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Drive business process reengineering, simplification, standardization, and automation.
  • Oversee transformation of insurance operations, investment services, distribution channels, and customer service functions.
  • Improve organizational agility, productivity, cost efficiency, and service delivery.

C. Digital & Technology Transformation

  • Oversee enterprise-wide digital transformation and technology modernization initiatives.
  • Drive adoption of cloud platforms, artificial intelligence, automation, advanced analytics, and digital business solutions.
  • Lead modernization and integration of enterprise applications, core insurance systems, investment platforms, and customer management technologies.
  • Collaborate with technology leadership to ensure digital investments support business strategy.
  • Promote innovation, data-driven decision-making, and technology-enabled business growth.

D. Transformation Portfolio & Programme Governance

  • Oversee the organization's strategic transformation portfolio, programmes, and major initiatives.
  • Establish enterprise transformation governance frameworks, performance controls, and reporting mechanisms.
  • Monitor transformation milestones, budgets, resource requirements, risks, and dependencies.
  • Coordinate transformation directors, programme managers, project leaders, and cross-functional teams.
  • Ensure initiatives are delivered within approved timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

E. Financial Performance & Value Creation

  • Develop transformation business cases, investment proposals, and financial impact assessments.
  • Identify opportunities to improve profitability, reduce operating costs, and optimize capital and resource utilization.
  • Monitor transformation expenditure, financial performance, and expected return on investment.
  • Establish benefits realization frameworks to track financial and non-financial outcomes.
  • Ensure transformation investments generate measurable and sustainable business value.

F. Organizational Change & Cultural Transformation

  • Lead enterprise-wide change management and organizational development strategies.
  • Work with HR and business leaders to drive workforce transformation, leadership alignment, and cultural change.
  • Build organizational readiness and employee engagement for major transformation initiatives.
  • Oversee communication, training, capability development, and change adoption programmes.
  • Promote a culture of innovation, accountability, adaptability, and continuous improvement.

G. Risk, Compliance & Regulatory Transformation

  • Ensure enterprise transformation initiatives align with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee transformation-related strategic, operational, financial, technology, and compliance risks.
  • Collaborate with risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit teams to strengthen governance and controls.
  • Drive initiatives that improve operational resilience, data governance, cybersecurity, and regulatory readiness.
  • Ensure transformation programmes maintain appropriate oversight, accountability, and auditability.

H. Executive Stakeholder & Board Engagement

  • Build strong relationships with the CEO, board members, executive committees, and business unit leaders.
  • Present transformation strategies, performance reports, financial outcomes, and strategic recommendations.
  • Lead enterprise transformation steering committees and executive review meetings.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, strategic partners, technology providers, and regulators.
  • Ensure executive alignment and accountability for transformation outcomes.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree or MBA is strongly preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise transformation, corporate strategy, business transformation, management consulting, or executive programme leadership.
  • At least 5–7 years in a senior director-level or enterprise transformation leadership position.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale, enterprise-wide transformation initiatives within complex organizations.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong expertise in operating model redesign, business process reengineering, digital transformation, and organizational change.
  • Demonstrated experience managing large transformation portfolios, budgets, executive stakeholders, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong financial management, strategic planning, governance, and benefits realization capabilities.
  • Certifications such as PgMP, PMP, Prosci Change Management, Lean Six Sigma, TOGAF, or equivalent are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of enterprise transformation strategy and strategic milestones.
  • Percentage of transformation programmes delivered within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Financial benefits realized through cost savings, revenue growth, and productivity improvements.
  • Return on investment (ROI) from enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Improvement in operational efficiency and business performance.
  • Successful implementation of new operating models and business processes.
  • Digital adoption and technology modernization success rates.
  • Employee engagement, organizational readiness, and change adoption.
  • Customer experience and service delivery improvements.
  • Reduction in operational, technology, and regulatory risks.
  • Executive and board-level stakeholder satisfaction.
