From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Pricing at our company is evolving quickly, and sellers need to keep pace with each change. We are seeking a Senior Pricing Enablement Manager who can translate packaging, curve, consumption, and ELA updates into clear enablement that provides guidance, covering what changed, why it changed, what sellers can offer, and when approval is required. You will own the enablement timeline across Pricing, Product, Deal Desk, and Product Marketing, and you will use field feedback to help shape future pricing decisions.

This is a full-time remote position with a preference for candidates to be near one of our offices in New York, Austin, or Denver.

Technologies You’ll Use

Thought Industries, Salesforce, Gong, Notion, Claude

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Pricing and Product Operations to provide enablement around net-new packaging, curve, discounts, consumption, bundles, and ELA changes. Build compelling and thorough and multi-modal enablement that explains what changed, why it changed, how to price it in a live deal, and deliver them through live sessions, leader briefings, and LMS content so the message lands consistently across segments.
  • Translate approved pricing policies into clear, digestible enablement so sellers understand what they can offer, when approval is needed, and how to follow the process. Work with Strat Ops, Pricing, and Deal Desk to confirm that quoting, approval, and CPQ workflows match the policy, and train the field on system changes as they ship.
  • Support with post launch reinforcement byidentifying gaps in how the field is applying each pricing change, using deal reviews, Deal Desk escalations, call recordings, and sales input. Attend follow-up launches and pricing meetings to pull in sales feedback, and keep iterating on reinforcement until seller behavior changes.
  • Partner with Deal Desk, Pricing, Product, and Product Marketing to maintain a single enablement timeline for all pricing and product updates, from launch through follow-up. Run a regular cadence with these teams to surface upcoming changes early, agree on owners and dates, and prevent conflicting or late communications to the field.
  • Gather structured input from Sales, Customer Success, and field leaders on pricing effectiveness, customer sentiment, and operational challenges, through surveys, office hours, and deal-level conversations. Analyze recurring themes and pain points, and synthesize them into specific recommendations for pricing policy improvements.
  • Bring what you see in the field to Pricing Strategy, Product, and Sales leadership to inform future pricing and packaging decisions.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in sales enablement, product marketing, pricing, deal desk, or sales strategy at a B2B software company
  • Experience enabling sellers on complex pricing, packaging, and consumption-based or usage-based models
  • Understanding of how pricing and packaging decisions flow into GTM systems, such as CPQ and Salesforce, and the ability to write clear business requirements for systems teams
  • Ability to build trusted relationships across Deal Desk, Pricing, Product, and Product Marketing, and to coordinate their input into a clear training timeline
  • Skill designing and delivering learning across formats, including live sessions, LMS content, and follow-up coaching
  • An analytical approach to field feedback, with the ability to find recurring themes and turn them into clear recommendations for leadership
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the confidence to present to sellers and to Pricing Strategy, Product, and Sales leaders
  • Ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple priorities across a fast-moving launch cadence

raw.title: Recruiter
raw.excerpt: The Ward Law Group is a personal injury law firm headquartered in Miami Lakes, Florida, with offices in Orlando and New York City.
raw.description:
The Ward Law Group is a personal injury law firm headquartered in Miami Lakes, Florida, with offices in Orlando and New York City. We are growing quickly across all three markets and need dedicated recruiting support during the hours when candidates are actually available to talk.

This role exists because the best candidates are working during business hours. Evenings and weekends are when they answer the phone, return messages, and complete assessments. You'll own that window — sourcing, making first contact, screening, and keeping the pipeline moving so that Monday morning starts with a full calendar instead of an empty one.

You will work independently with limited real-time supervision.

What You'll Do

Sourcing and outreach

  • Source candidates for open roles across all three offices using job boards, LinkedIn, professional associations, alumni networks, and direct outreach
  • Build and run Boolean searches against defined role criteria
  • Conduct high-volume outbound contact — calls, texts, and email — to passive and applied candidates during evening and weekend hours
  • Re-engage prior applicants and dormant pipeline

Screening and coordination

  • Conduct initial phone screens against established qualification criteria
  • Administer prescreening questionnaires and record responses accurately
  • Send, track, and follow up on candidate assessments
  • Schedule interviews across hiring manager and candidate availability, including time zone coordination between Florida and New York
  • Send confirmations, reminders, and rescheduling communications

Pipeline and records

  • Maintain accurate, current candidate records in the applicant tracking system
  • Document screening notes in a consistent format usable by hiring managers who did not attend the call
  • Disposition candidates promptly and accurately with the correct reason codes
  • Provide an end-of-shift pipeline summary covering contacts made, screens completed, assessments sent, and interviews scheduled

Candidate experience

  • Serve as the first impression of the firm for most applicants
  • Respond to candidate inquiries within the shift window
  • Ensure every candidate receives a clear next step or a clear close

Required Qualifications

  • 2 or more years in recruiting coordination, sourcing, or high-volume talent acquisition support
  • Demonstrated experience conducting phone screens and scheduling interviews at volume
  • Proficiency with an applicant tracking system and standard productivity tools
  • Boolean search capability
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Consistent availability for the full Wednesday–Sunday, 2:30–11:00 PM ET
  • Reliable high-speed internet, a functioning computer, a quiet professional workspace, and a phone setup suitable for a continuous call volume
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and to self-report progress accurately

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bilingual English/Spanish — a substantial share of our candidate pool and client base is Spanish-speaking
  • Prior recruiting experience in a law firm, medical practice, or other high-volume professional services environment
  • Experience recruiting legal support staff, intake, or case management roles
  • Familiarity with Litify, Salesforce, or comparable platforms

Technical Requirements

Contractors supply their own equipment and workspace. Your setup must meet these minimums:

Computer — capable of running a browser-based ATS, video conferencing, and a softphone simultaneously without degradation:

  • Windows: Windows 11, Intel i5 (8th generation or newer) or equivalent, 16 GB RAM, 256 GB SSD
  • Mac: macOS 14 (Sonoma) or newer, Apple Silicon or Intel i5, 16 GB RAM, 256 GB SSD
  • The device must be used solely by you — not shared with family or household members

Internet — wired Ethernet preferred, 5 GHz Wi-Fi acceptable:

  • 30 Mbps download / 15 Mbps upload minimum
  • Latency under 100 ms
  • Private, password-protected network. Public Wi-Fi is not permitted for this work.

Peripherals:

  • USB noise-cancelling headset with microphone
  • Webcam capable of clear video for scheduled calls

Security — required for handling confidential applicant information:

  • Full-disk encryption enabled (BitLocker or FileVault)
  • Automatic security updates enabled for operating system and browser
  • Screen lock after no more than 10 minutes idle
  • Active endpoint protection software
  • Applicant data stored only in firm-designated systems — never on personal cloud storage or local drives

Contractor Terms

  • This is an independent contractor engagement, not employment.
  • No paid time off, healthcare, retirement, or other employee benefits are provided.
  • You will supply your own equipment, software, internet connection, and workspace.

The Ward Law Group does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

The Ward Law Group is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at The Ward Law Group via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written Statement of Work in place for this position from The Ward Law Group HR/Recruitment will be deemed the sole property of The Ward Law Group. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by The Ward Law Group as a result of the referral or through other means.

Join an Award-Winning Personal Injury Law Firm

At The Ward Law Group, our mission is simple:

Changing Lives. One Client at a Time

Recognized as one of the Best Places to Work for consecutive years, we are committed to delivering exceptional legal representation while creating an environment where talented professionals can grow, lead, and make a meaningful impact every day.

We believe our people are our greatest asset. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and high-accountability culture where every team member is empowered to make informed decisions, continuously improve, and deliver exceptional results for our clients. Every role contributes directly to helping injured individuals navigate one of the most challenging times in their lives while supporting the continued growth and success of our firm.

Our Core Values

Faith – We act with integrity, honesty, and purpose in everything we do.

Accountability – We take ownership of our work, our commitments, and the results we deliver.

Leadership – We lead by example, inspire others, embrace continuous improvement, and develop high-performing teams.

Loyalty – We build lasting relationships through trust, respect, and dedication to our clients, teammates, and community.

Service to Our Clients – We are committed to delivering compassionate, responsive, and exceptional service that maximizes every client's opportunity for success.

Service to Our Teammates – We foster a culture of collaboration, respect, support, and shared success where every team member has the opportunity to grow and thrive.

Service to Our Community – We believe in making a positive impact beyond the workplace by serving and strengthening the communities where we live and work.

If you are passionate about helping injured clients, thrive in a fast-paced, results-driven environment, and are committed to delivering exceptional client service while continuously growing your career, we invite you to join The Ward Law Group and help us change lives—one client at a time.

raw.description:
Arise is a globally active weight-loss app with over 10 million downloads and a 4.6 rating on the App Store. Our mission is simple but ambitious: empower millions of people to become healthier and happier.

We're looking for a CTO who is a true architect on both iOS and Android — someone deeply skilled in iOS who can take full ownership of our existing app and raise it further, and who can also build our Android app from scratch. You'll develop primarily through AI rather than by hand, and you'll thrive on ownership, precision, and long-term thinking. This role is for someone who ships high-quality code today while foreseeing how today's decisions shape the app for years ahead — technically, strategically, and financially.

Today Arise is iOS-only, so this is where you'll start and where you'll prove yourself: owning, deepening, and future-proofing a mature codebase used by millions. From there, you'll architect and build our Android app from the ground up.

If you excel at structured, autonomous work, build with AI as your default way of working, understand the importance of monetization, and want to own the technology behind a product used by millions, we'd love to hear from you.

Your Role

  • Own and architect the existing iOS app — maintain, optimize, deepen, and future-proof a codebase used by millions.
  • Build the Arise Android app from scratch — architecture, delivery, and long-term ownership.
  • Ensure cross-platform consistency and a coherent technical vision across both platforms.
  • Develop and test features that enhance the Arise experience.
  • Use AI agents and automated workflows as your primary means of building, testing, and shipping — not as an occasional helper.
  • Anticipate technical pitfalls and proactively design solutions.
  • Collaborate with design to refine usability for a smooth user experience.
  • Support monetization by integrating features with measurable business impact.

Requirements

  • Proven track record architecting and shipping production mobile apps, ideally as a senior engineer, lead, or technical founder.
  • Deep, architect-level iOS expertise — you can own a mature codebase end to end and make the hard structural calls with confidence.
  • Demonstrated ability to build an Android app from scratch to the same standard.
  • Hands-on fluency building through AI — agentic coding tools, LLM-driven workflows, automated testing and release. You've actually shipped this way, not just experimented.
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Comfortable working fully in English.

Technical Skills

  • Expert-level iOS/Swift — architecture, patterns, performance, and the judgment to keep a large app maintainable as it grows.
  • Strong Android development (Kotlin) with the ability to architect a new app end to end.
  • Familiarity with mobile build and release tooling (e.g. Fastlane).
  • Deep understanding of Apple and Android design principles, patterns, and best practices.
  • Ability to write clean, well-documented, maintainable code — and to direct AI to do the same.

Who You Are

  • A decisive builder who takes a problem and runs with it — you'd rather ship and iterate than wait for certainty.
  • Direct and results-driven, comfortable owning outcomes and making the call.
  • Energized by autonomy and full ownership of the technology.
  • Allergic to bureaucracy — "meetings that should have been emails" are your enemy.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

  • High autonomy: own the entire tech stack from idea to release.
  • Clear decision-making with minimal bureaucracy.
  • Work with the newest hardware and technologies.
  • Complimentary Claude Max subscription.
  • Flexible, remote-first role (full-time).
  • Paid annual leave.
  • Direct collaboration with the founder — your work will have visible impact from day one.

How to Apply

Send us your application including:

  • Your CV
  • A history of the mobile apps you've built (iOS and Android)
  • Salary expectations
  • (Optional) Code samples or GitHub repositories

Help us build and refine a product that runs like a well-oiled machine — and improves millions of lives in the process.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

Job Family Definition:

Serves as a trusted adviser to the Partner and develops a mutually beneficial relationship in alignment with HPE business priorities. Drives end-to-end revenue, HPE profitability, and pipeline through joint business plans and data-driven sales efforts. Articulates both HPE global and local business strategies to effectively “sell with”, “sell to”, and “sell through” the Partner, creating a scalable selling ecosystem. Develops knowledge of Partner priorities, industry trends, IT landscape, IT investment strategy, HPE priorities, and HPE Technology to differentiate HPE from competitors. Coordinates and executes HPE activities with the Partner, leveraging HPE specialists when needed. Aligns field sales to drive increased value to HPE for pipeline and revenue/profit growth while leveraging the collective strength of the partner ecosystem. Leads HPE strategy, programs, and systems with and on behalf of the Partner to assure accelerated financial outcomes and build partner loyalty to HPE. These jobs focus on selling to customers through the Partner as an extension of HPE's salesforce, typically through work that occurs outside HPE offices.

Management Level Definition:

Applies developed subject matter knowledge to solve common and complex business issues and recommends appropriate alternatives. Works on problems of diverse complexity and scope. May act as a team or project leader providing direction to team activities and facilitates information validation and team decision making process. Exercises independent judgment to identify and select a solution. Ability to handle most unique situations. May seek advice in order to make decisions on complex business issues.

Responsibilities:

  • Serves as a trusted advisor to the Partner (e.g. Value Added Reseller (VAR), Distributor, SI, ISV, Managed Service Provider) on where to play within emerging trends in Partner's ecosystem in alignment with HPE business priorities. Works with the Partner to create a mutually beneficial plan for the future.
  • Drives end-to end HPE revenue, profitability, and pipeline by creating joint business plans and leading data-driven sales efforts with the Partner.
  • Articulates both HPE global and local business strategies to effectively "sell with," "sell to," and "sell through" the Partner, creating a scalable selling ecosystem.
  • Develops solid knowledge of partner priorities, industry trends, IT landscape, IT investment strategy, HPE priorities, and HPE Technology and communicates value of the portfolios and solutions to better differentiate HPE from competitors.
  • Demonstrates business and sales leadership by building mutually beneficial relationships with one or many Partners to grow HPE market share.
  • Coordinates and executes HPE activities with the Partner, leveraging HPE specialists when needed, including sales cadence, education, marketing, executive briefings, proactive forecasting, business planning, and client engagements. Drives HPE marketing strategy through the customer.
  • Drives and implements HPE strategy, programs, and systems with and on behalf of the Partner to assure accelerated financial outcomes and build partner loyalty to HPE.
  • Tailors selling solutions to fit the needs of the partner's customer profile including HPE products, services and technology alliances to achieve assigned quota.
  • May recruit and develop business relationships with new partners, working to increase partner commitment to HPE.
  • May spend time monitoring Partner sales floor to help develop pipeline.
  • Works to ensure that partners are aware of, and compliant with, HPE's SBC requirements for Partners, including applicable legal obligations.

Education and Experience:

  • University or Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent experience.
  • Typically 4-8+ years of selling experience.
  • Solid experience in selling to partners desired.

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Technology Acumen: Solid awareness of current technology trends and related HPE strategy and ability to articulate same to Partner.
  • Sales Acumen: Able to influence the partner to take actions that create increased value to HPE. Effectively exercises selling skills such as identifying potential opportunities, utilizing appropriate sales platforms and resources, and formulating and proposing solutions with the goal of expanding HPE's business. Acts with a sense of urgency to build strong customer relationships and drive solutions for the partner.
  • Account Management: Solid understanding of business and financial fundamentals to develop strategic plans with the partner that are aligned to customer and HPE strategies, creating increased business opportunities and value for HPE.
  • Portfolio Knowledge: Solid understanding of HPE products and how they can deliver value to customers in contrast to HPE's competitors. Ability to select the best product for the customer's needs, maximizing value for both the customer and HPE.
  • Partner Industry Acumen: Solid understanding of Partner industry, trends, competitors, and the channel.
  • Partnering Acumen: Builds understanding of and relationships with partner and internal community among all types and levels of the business, integrating sales engagement efforts. Solid understanding of the Partner's relationships and needs.
  • Financial Acumen: Solid understanding of financial accounting concepts such as income statements, balance sheets, revenue projections, etc. to assess customer financial health, identify potential risks, and position value propositions of HPE solutions.
  • Sales Forecasting: Ability to look forward and anticipate partner needs, proactively forecasting sales quota and effectively bridging sales gaps.
  • Communication: Professional, clear, and effective verbal and written communication.
  • Time Management: Ability to prioritize and effectively meet deadlines.
  • Creativity and Entrepreneurship: Ability to innovate, think beyond proscribed solutions, and take proactive steps to advance HPE sales efforts.

Impact/Scope:

  • Responsible for accounts with a mid-level range of annual revenue
  • Assigned average or higher size quota.

Complexity:

  • Primary focus for partner sales on SMB segment.
  • Focus on partners with mid-level HPE specialization and commitment.

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

raw.description:
Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients’ success.

Role overview

We’re looking for an IT Systems Engineer to own the administration and security of our core tools, from Okta and Google Workspace to Slack, ClickUp and the AI tools our teams use every day. Our team is fully remote and works with a Bring Your Own Device policy, which makes for some interesting security challenges.

In your first months, you’ll take part in the rollout of Okta, 1Password and an endpoint security solution across the company. You’ll then help us harden our infrastructure, automate onboarding and offboarding, and keep a close eye on security as we scale.

You’ll have opportunity to drive your own initiatives, and you’ll also be the first point of contact when colleagues need help with access or tools. If you have strong foundations in at least one area and enjoy learning the rest, you’ll have a lot of independence, a budget for state-of-the-art tooling, and room to grow into a team lead role as the team scales.

Responsibilities

raw.description:
Parachute Health is transforming post-acute care as the leading digital ordering platform for medical equipment and supplies. We connect major health systems, health plans, and suppliers to help patients get the life-saving products they need at home. Since launching, we've connected 300,000+ clinicians and 3,000+ supplier locations across all 50 states and helped 15M+ patients. What started as a DME ePrescribing tool has become the order management platform of choice for home medical equipment.

Join our team and make a difference in patient care.

About the Role

Parachute Health sells its order management platform to HME/DME suppliers, and our Supplier BDR team sources the first meeting for a significant share of the new opportunities our Account Executives pursue. The team has established strong activity volume. The next priority is meeting quality: improving show rates, engaging more owners and budget holders, and focusing on suppliers with the scale to buy. The goal is pipeline that converts to signed revenue rather than stalling in early stages.

The BDR team does not currently have a dedicated leader. In this role, you will lead the team full time as its manager and coach, allowing our Account Executives to focus fully on selling. You will not carry a personal closing quota. Your success will be measured by the team’s results: held meetings, meeting quality, and the pipeline and revenue generated from those meetings.

Key Responsibilities

Leading and developing the team

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s, Gong call reviews, and live call coaching with each BDR.
  • Lead hiring, onboarding, and ramp for new BDRs. We plan to add two to four seats in 2027, and you will own the 30/60/90-day ramp plan.
  • Establish a clear career path from BDR to Account Executive and prepare top performers for promotion.
  • Identify and address performance concerns early, document them appropriately, and partner with People Operations as needed.

Activity, Pipeline, and Meeting Quality

  • Establish daily and weekly activity standards, including dials, connects, emails, and booked and held meetings, and hold the team accountable to them.
  • Own the team’s held-meeting target and the conversion from held meeting to demo to signed deal.
  • Reduce no-shows by partnering with Marketing on confirmation and reminder sequences and defining a clear standard for a qualified meeting.
  • Maintain accurate HubSpot data: every booked meeting has an associated deal with an amount and the correct AE owner, every deal carries BDR attribution, and stale early-stage deals are either advanced or closed.
  • Report team performance to Sales leadership weekly and lead monthly and quarterly business reviews.

Targeting and Campaigns

  • Build and assign territories and target lists, including High Value Target lists, dormant-account outreach, and conference lead follow-up (e.g., Medtrade, ResMed Connect).
  • Keep the team focused on suppliers that match our ideal customer profile: those that bill insurance, hold a PTAN, and receive consistent order volume from multiple referring clinicians.
  • Partner with Marketing to improve MQL response times, optimize sequences, and execute account-based campaigns for priority targets.
  • Collaborate with HME Business Operations on contact data, lead routing, and reporting.

Partnership with the Account Executive Team

  • Route qualified meetings to the appropriate AE with thorough handoff notes covering product lines, payers, billing system, intake process, and key decision makers.
  • Maintain a regular feedback loop with AEs on meeting quality and address gaps promptly.
  • Share insights from the field, including objections, competitive intelligence, and pricing feedback, with Sales, Marketing, and Product, and keep scripts and battle cards current.

Compensation and Programs

  • Administer the BDR compensation plan: track meetings, prepare monthly commission results for approval, and recommend plan adjustments as the sales process evolves.
  • Design contests and recognition programs that reward the right outcomes, such as held meetings with qualified buyers rather than booked meetings alone.

What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months

  • The team meets or exceeds its held-meeting target each quarter, with a hold rate above 65%.
  • Fewer opportunities are lost to no-shows, unresponsive prospects, or stalled deals.
  • Every BDR-sourced deal in HubSpot includes an amount, an owner, and BDR attribution.
  • New BDRs are fully ramped within their first 90 days.
  • The team secures more meetings with owners and decision makers at higher-value suppliers, and BDR-sourced revenue grows as a share of total signed revenue.
  • At least one BDR is promoted into an Account Executive role.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in B2B sales or sales development, including at least 1–2 years leading, coaching, or managing SDRs or BDRs.
  • Proven track record of building outbound programs that achieve meeting and pipeline targets.
  • Successful experience as a BDR, with the ability to model effective calls for the team.
  • Proficiency in HubSpot or Salesforce reporting, with the ability to independently analyze data and diagnose activity and conversion issues.
  • Hands-on experience with prospecting and call tools such as HubSpot Sequences, ZoomInfo, and Gong.
  • Healthcare technology or HME/DME experience strongly preferred.
  • Direct communicator who raises issues early and takes ownership of results.
  • Ability to travel up to 20% for team meetings, conferences, and customer events.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field preferred.

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: Comprehensive plans with options for low-to-no-cost premiums.
  • Employer HSA Contribution: Company-funded contributions to your Health Savings Account.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Equity Incentive Plan
  • Annual Company-Wide Bonus: Opportunity for up to 15% bonus based on company performance.
  • Remote-First Culture: We are remote-first with a dedicated NYC office and reimbursement options for co-working spaces.
  • Flexible Vacation Policy
  • Summer Fridays: 5 additional Fridays off during the summer (separate from PTO).
  • Home Office and Wellness Stipend
  • Monthly Internet Stipend
  • Annual Learning and Development Stipend

Base Salary (based on level and experience)

$95,000 - $110,000 + Commission

raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Director of Sales Talent Acquisition to lead our global team of sales recruiters and make sales hiring a genuine competitive advantage for Grafana Labs. You will set the direction for how we attract, assess and hire the sellers who drive our growth, and you will do it as a core member of the sales organization, not a service function that sits beside it.

You’ll work hand in hand with senior sales leaders, RevOps, Finance and the wider People team to turn hiring plans into predictable outcomes. This is a leader who is energized by data, spots risks to hiring goals before they land, and turns insight into innovative, AI-powered tools that help the business make faster, better decisions. If you have built and rolled out ICP-based hiring and want to do it at global scale in a fast-growing, remote-first company, this is your role.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead, coach and develop a global team of sales recruiters and sourcers, setting a clear strategy, high standards and a culture of ownership across regions.
  • Be highly data driven: build a rigorous view of pipeline, funnel conversion, time to hire and capacity against hiring plans, and flag risks to hiring goals early so the business can act before targets are missed.
  • Plan effectively and remove surprises: build forward-looking hiring plans with sales leaders, RevOps and Finance, surface dependencies and trade-offs early, and keep stakeholders informed so there are no unwelcome surprises.
  • Set a high bar for the team and yourself, driving performance against ambitious hiring targets and consistently hitting and exceeding them.
  • Lead from the front and stay close to the work: step into key searches, candidate conversations and closes when it matters, and put the team’s success ahead of your own profile.
  • Turn insights and data into innovative, AI-based dashboards and tools that give sales leaders, RevOps and Finance real-time visibility and help the team work smarter.
  • Build strong, trusted partnerships with senior sales leaders, RevOps, Finance and other business stakeholders, becoming their go-to adviser on talent strategy, headcount planning and market conditions.
  • Position Sales TA as an integral part of the sales team, aligned to its goals, planning cycles and rhythms, and accountable for shared outcomes.
  • Define and roll out ICP-based hiring for sales roles, so that every search is anchored in a clear, evidence-based picture of what great looks like at Grafana.
  • Build an always-on sales talent pipeline: work with sourcers and use CRM tools to run nurture campaigns that keep future sellers warm, so the team is never starting from zero when a role opens.
  • Collaborate closely with the wider People team, including Talent Team peers, People Ops, Compensation and Total Rewards, to deliver a consistent, high-quality candidate and hiring manager experience.
  • Own the sales hiring process and tooling, including Greenhouse, ensuring data quality, process adherence and continuous improvement across the team.
  • Champion the Grafana Labs employer brand in the sales talent market, with a focus on engaging both passive and active candidates globally.

What makes you a great fit

  • 3+ years leading a Talent Acquisition team, ideally in a global tech sales capacity.
  • A deep understanding of what makes a great software sales professional, and how to assess for it across segments, regions and seniority levels.
  • Strong evidence of using data and AI to solve hiring problems, including building dashboards or tools that changed how a business made hiring decisions.
  • Evidence of implementing and rolling out ICP-based hiring.
  • Experience using sourcers and recruiting CRM tools to build nurture campaigns and an always-on pipeline of sales talent.
  • A competitive, goal-driven mindset: you thrive on a high bar, set ambitious targets for yourself and your team, and have a track record of hitting and exceeding them.
  • Excellent planning skills, with the ability to anticipate dependencies, build realistic hiring plans and remove surprises for the business before they happen.
  • A leader who rolls up their sleeves: you are happy to get stuck into a critical search, a candidate close or a messy process problem alongside the team, you share credit freely, and you care far more about the result than about who gets the recognition.
  • A track record of partnering credibly with senior sales leaders, RevOps and Finance, and of earning a seat at the table.
  • A collaborative mindset, with an understanding that success is not possible without being part of a wider People team.
  • Comfort in a high-paced environment, where you embrace change and ambiguity.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Tenstorrent is hiring a Senior Cloud Security Engineer to own the security of our multi-account AWS and GCP environments, our public internet perimeter, and our internal AI Gateway. As part of the Operations Security (OpSec) team reporting to the Head of Information Security, you will build continuous cloud security posture management, eliminate static credentials, feed cloud telemetry into our SIEM, and run our DAST and external penetration testing programs. Position Summary...

What you'll do...

Senior Manager, Automation Engineering
Engineering, Perishable Design
The Senior Manager, Automation Engineering is a senior technical leader responsible for advancing the engineering systems, technical standards, and design-assurance practices used to deliver Walmart’s automated Perishable Distribution Centers.
This role leads multidisciplinary technical reviews across automation equipment, controls, infrastructure, safety, compliance, maintenance, and operational design. The position applies engineering analysis, vendor negotiation, financial evaluation, and AI-enabled tools to improve design quality, accelerate decisions, reduce late-stage changes, and create repeatable solutions that support program scale.

About the Team

The Perishable Detailed Design team leads development and finalization of approved automated PDC designs from concept through final release and implementation handoff.
Our team leads Statement of Work execution, vendor technical accountability, design-change evaluation, technical specifications, final design assurance, and technical handoff to Implementation and Operations.
We work across the complete perishable distribution center environment, including material-handling equipment, controls, refrigeration, fire protection, infrastructure, racking, associate work areas, maintenance access, safety, ergonomics, egress, technology, and procured site equipment.
This is a high-performing engineering team solving a first-of-kind challenge at Walmart scale: automating the full Perishable distribution flow while creating reliable and reusable engineering solutions for a growing national program.

What You’ll Do
  • Lead multidisciplinary design assurance across Greenfield and Retrofit automation projects, identifying technical risks before construction, installation, and operational handoff.
  • Establish and advance engineering standards across controls interfaces, safety, compliance, maintenance access, associate access, infrastructure, and modular or non-MHE design.
  • Translate operational requirements and field learnings into reusable design requirements, modules, review criteria, and controlled design-package updates.
  • Evaluate design changes for technical feasibility, system compatibility, cost, schedule, safety, maintainability, and operational impact.
  • Partner across Product, Concept Design, Construction, Implementation, Operations, Safety, Maintenance, Technology, Procurement, and automation suppliers to resolve complex design challenges.
  • Apply data analysis, engineering economics, and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate design review, requirements traceability, change-impact analysis, and technical decision-making.
  • Lead UL testing and burn-testing initiatives to validate fire-protection strategies, support safety and compliance requirements, and translate results into scalable design standards and cost-effective infrastructure solutions.
  • Develop engineering talent and create repeatable practices that improve design quality, consistency, and program scalability.

What You’ll Bring
  • Proven experience in automation-system design, integration, technical review, or troubleshooting within complex industrial, manufacturing, distribution, or supply-chain environments.
  • Knowledge of automation equipment and its interfaces with controls, building infrastructure, safety systems, associate workflows, and maintenance requirements.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering reviews and identifying technical risks before installation, commissioning, or launch.
  • Working knowledge of CAD, automation controls, machine safety, ergonomics, maintainability, testing, and system-integration principles.
  • Strong analytical and financial-evaluation skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear engineering recommendations.
  • Effective communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams, senior stakeholders, and external suppliers.
  • An AI-forward engineering mindset, with interest or experience using emerging tools to improve analysis, technical quality, and preservation of engineering knowledge.

Hands-On 3D Modeling & Technical Design

  • Actively participate in the creation, development, and refinement of intelligent 3D models for electric utility equipment and infrastructure.
  • Develop complex or specialized models that require advanced utility engineering knowledge and modeling expertise.
  • Utilize AutoCAD, Inventor, Revit, and other applicable design tools to develop and maintain 3D model content.
  • Establish and maintain modeling standards, templates, workflows, and best practices.
  • Review and validate model geometry, engineering attributes, dimensions, connectivity, and other technical requirements.
  • Troubleshoot complex modeling issues and provide direct technical assistance to team members.
  • Identify opportunities to improve model accuracy, functionality, consistency, and reusability.

Team Leadership & Management

  • Directly manage, mentor, and develop a team of approximately seven 3D modelers with varying levels of experience.
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance and coaching to entry-level and senior-level team members.
  • Assign projects, establish priorities, and manage team workloads to meet customer and internal deadlines.
  • Monitor team performance, productivity, quality, and project deliverables.
  • Establish quality assurance and peer-review processes for all 3D modeling deliverables.
  • Identify training needs and develop team capabilities in utility engineering, modeling techniques, and SBS software tools.
  • Foster a collaborative environment focused on technical excellence and continuous improvement.

Utility Model Library Development

  • Lead the development and maintenance of SBS's standardized 3D utility model libraries.
  • Oversee the creation of models representing electric substation, transmission, distribution, and other utility infrastructure.
  • Ensure models accurately represent equipment geometry, engineering characteristics, specifications, and applicable design standards.
  • Manage new model development based on customer requirements, manufacturer specifications, and industry standards.
  • Ensure models are properly structured, attributed, and optimized for use within SBS software applications.
  • Establish processes for model version control, documentation, quality review, and ongoing library maintenance.

Utility Standards & Engineering Practices

  • Apply practical knowledge of electric utility engineering standards and design practices to guide model development.
  • Interpret utility engineering drawings, equipment specifications, and design standards and translate them into accurate 3D models.
  • Maintain familiarity with industry standards and utility-specific requirements.
  • Work with customers and internal technical resources to resolve engineering and modeling questions.
  • Ensure consistent application of engineering and modeling standards across the team.

Customer & Project Support

  • Coordinate and prioritize customer-specific 3D modeling requests.
  • Work with SBS customer-facing teams to understand technical requirements and establish project deliverables.
  • Participate in customer discussions requiring utility engineering or 3D modeling expertise.
  • Balance customer-specific requests with ongoing development and expansion of SBS's standard model libraries.
  • Ensure timely delivery of accurate, high-quality modeling projects.

Competitive Candidate Profile

  • Minimum of five years of experience in the electric power utility industry involving engineering standards, electrical design, equipment modeling, or related technical disciplines.
  • Direct experience with electric utility equipment, infrastructure, and engineering design practices.
  • Hands-on proficiency with at least one of the following: Autodesk AutoCAD, Autodesk Inventor, and/or Autodesk Revit.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining 3D engineering models or equipment libraries.
  • Previous experience leading, supervising, or mentoring technical personnel.
  • Strong understanding of engineering drawings, equipment specifications, and technical documentation.
  • Ability and willingness to remain actively involved in hands-on modeling and technical design.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with electric substation design, transmission, or distribution engineering.
  • Experience developing intelligent, parametric 3D models and reusable equipment libraries.
  • Experience with utility engineering standards and manufacturer equipment specifications.
  • Familiarity with BIM processes, CAD standards, and engineering content management.
  • Experience integrating 3D models with engineering design and analysis software.
  • Experience with automation or scripting to improve modeling productivity.
  • Experience working with software development and product management teams.

Key Success Factors

The successful candidate will:

  • Maintain an active role in 3D model development while effectively managing a seven-person modeling team.
  • Serve as the team's primary technical resource for complex utility modeling and design challenges.
  • Develop a consistent, high-quality, and reusable library of utility equipment models.
  • Establish efficient modeling standards, workflows, and quality assurance processes.
  • Develop the technical capabilities of entry-level and senior-level modelers.

Position: Senior Network Security Engineer
Reports To: Director, Global Security Engineering
Department: Security Engineering
Location: Remote, US – East Coast
Work Authorization: US Citizenship Required

BlueVoyant is seeking a highly skilled Senior Network Security Engineer to design, implement, and maintain our enterprise network infrastructure with a focus on security and performance. You'll own our Palo Alto Networks and Cloudflare estate across large-scale, multi-site and hybrid cloud environments, implementing network security controls aligned to our cybersecurity strategy and compliance requirements. Working within our Security Engineering team and alongside Security Operations and cloud infrastructure teams, you'll play a critical role in protecting and optimizing the network that powers our global operations.

What You'll Do:

  • Network Design & Engineering: Design, implement, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure, including routing and security components, across multiple locations and cloud environments.
  • Palo Alto Networks Management: Manage and optimize Palo Alto Networks firewall deployments and Panorama, including policy configuration, threat prevention, and advanced security features.
  • Cloudflare Services: Implement and maintain Cloudflare services, including CDN, DDoS protection, WAF, and Zero Trust network access (Access and Gateway).
  • Zero Trust & Segmentation: Design and implement network segmentation and micro-segmentation strategies to support a zero-trust security architecture.
  • Remote Access & Hybrid Connectivity: Manage VPN and remote access technologies, and work with cloud infrastructure teams to ensure secure, efficient hybrid cloud connectivity.
  • Monitoring & Assessment: Monitor network performance, availability, and security, conduct regular security assessments, and drive remediation.
  • Incident Response: Collaborate with Security Operations on incident response and forensic analysis of network-related security events.
  • Policy & Compliance: Develop and maintain network security policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with frameworks including NIST, ISO 27001, and SOC 2.
  • Automation & Optimization: Implement network automation to improve operational efficiency, and lead capacity planning and performance optimization initiatives.
  • Technical Leadership: Provide technical leadership, evaluate and implement new network and security technologies, and lead technical projects from design to delivery.
  • Resilience & Support: Support business continuity and disaster recovery planning, maintain detailed network documentation, and participate in an on-call rotation for critical infrastructure.

What You'll Bring:
You're a hands-on, senior network security engineer who combines deep technical expertise with sound judgment. You thrive in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities, take ownership of complex problems, and can explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • 5–10 years of progressive network engineering experience in enterprise environments (1,000+ employees), including large-scale network implementations and migrations.
  • 5+ years of expert-level, hands-on experience configuring, managing, and troubleshooting Palo Alto Networks PA-Series firewalls and Panorama.
  • 3+ years implementing and managing Cloudflare enterprise solutions, including CDN, DDoS protection, WAF, Access, and Gateway.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise networking protocols and services, including BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VLANs, VPN, SD-WAN, DNS, DHCP, and load balancing.
  • Deep understanding of network security principles, including micro-segmentation, zero-trust architecture, threat detection, and network access control (NAC) with identity integration.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking and hybrid cloud connectivity.
  • Proficiency in network automation tools and scripting languages, and experience with network monitoring and management tools.
  • Experience with network security incident response and forensic analysis.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and compliance requirements (NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2).
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and project management skills, with experience leading technical initiatives.
  • Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer (PCNSE) or equivalent.

Nice to Have:

  • Cloudflare Certified Professional, Cisco CCNP/CCIE, Juniper JNCIP/JNCIE, or equivalent vendor certifications.
  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or SANS/GIAC.
  • Knowledge of emerging network security technologies, including SASE and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA).

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.

Why BlueVoyant?

  • Join a global, mission-driven cybersecurity company defending organizations worldwide with cutting-edge data, technology, and expertise.
  • Competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, with support for wellbeing, development, and career growth.
  • Own the network security architecture of a cybersecurity company, shaping how Palo Alto Networks, Cloudflare, and zero-trust technologies protect our global operations.
  • Work alongside expert Security Engineering, Security Operations, and cloud teams, including former government cyber officials, with the autonomy to evaluate and introduce new technologies.

About BlueVoyant
BlueVoyant is an AI-driven cybersecurity company dedicated to standing between our customers and cyber threats. By combining human, artificial, and proprietary intelligence, we deliver a unified solution that protects every organization’s network, identities, vendors, and digital footprints as a single attack surface. The company’s award-winning Microsoft Security expertise helps organizations maximize their security investments while reducing risk and ensuring compliance.

Led by CEO, John Hernandez, BlueVoyant’s highly skilled team includes former government cyber officials with extensive frontline experience in responding to advanced cyber threats on behalf of the National Security Agency, Federal Bureau of Investigation, Unit 8200, and GCHQ, together with private sector experts. BlueVoyant services utilize large real-time datasets with industry leading analytics and technologies.

Founded in 2017 by Fortune 500 executives, including Chairman of the Board, Jim Rosenthal, Vice Chairman, Tom Glocer, and former Government cyber officials, BlueVoyant is headquartered in New York City and has offices in Maryland, Tel Aviv, London, Budapest, and Latin America and is committed to building a workplace where talented people are empowered to do their best work in the fight against global cyber threats.

All employees must be authorized to work in the United States of America. BlueVoyant provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, BlueVoyant complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities.

Disclaimer: Please note that pursuant to contractual requirements and applicable law, for employees to perform work on some of the company's federal contracts, U.S. citizenship is required. Accordingly, an employee's ability to perform work on such contracts is contingent upon the company's verification of the employee's citizenship status. Furthermore, individuals may be subject to additional background checks and fingerprinting.

Important Information for Applicants: BlueVoyant uses AI-assisted tools within our applicant tracking system to help identify candidates whose experience and skills best match the requirements of a role. This technology provides hiring teams with added insights to support fair and efficient hiring decisions. All applications are reviewed by a member of our hiring team, and final hiring decisions are made by humans, not AI. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that AI tools may assist in the evaluation of your resume as part of the recruitment process.

Interview Expectations: As part of our interview process, we assess your experience through real-time discussion, so we expect responses to be your own. At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

Disclaimer: We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication.

A day in the life:

A Creative Strategist will be the lead ideator on strategic accounts. They are required to have a robust understanding of paid social creative best practices, their client’s brand, performance goals, historical data, current ecommerce trends, and consumer behavior, to develop winning paid social advertising that impacts their client's growth.

Creative Strategists know how to act fast to capitalize on good results, or on the flip side know what to change if an ad isn’t performing to their goal. This means testing with the intention of moving the needle on key performance metrics — from improving CPA, CTR, or ROAS to driving brand awareness. Creative Strategists pitch new ideas and concepts to clients, write scripts, and follow the execution and review of ads through to production and delivery to clients.

An ideal candidate for the Creative Strategist role is a self-starter who is passionate about maximizing success for their clients through creative strategy, and is eager to take the lead on developing creative concepts that are intentionally produced to generate clear testing results and insights. They have mastered presenting creative reporting to clients and team members through storytelling, and are constantly implementing learnings to enhance future campaign results. Sr. Creative Strategists are zealous about continuously testing various creative concepts to develop a strong understanding of how to not only effectively and efficiently meet client goals, but to surpass them. If creative deliveries are not meeting client expectations, or creative tests are not hitting target goals, Sr. Creative Strategists will be relentless in the pursuit to troubleshoot and problem solve with a growth mindset.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Leads the paid social creative strategy for 8-10 clients
  • Using data insights along with consumer and brand research to design high performing creative assets
  • Collaborating closely with team members across internal departments and roles
  • Maintaining client communications and sentiment
  • Driven to iterate and ideate towards stated performance goals
  • Develops rapport with client to build a foundation of open discussion, including understanding client product and goals, as well as explaining Power Digital processes
  • Researches client brand, competitors, and industry trends, and effectively implements performance creative best practices by platform
  • Continually audits account to identify winning ads, present data to client, and dictate hypotheses and test strategy via monthly roadmaps
  • Writes strategic consumer-centric, direct response copy and messaging strategy
  • Manages requests and output with production team using Asana
  • Reviews video/image assets and provides clear and actionable feedback to editors
  • Leads productive internal creative team syncs and brainstorms
  • Works alongside client management team as client POC for all things creative strategy
  • Understands scope of requested edits, reshoots, and other deliverables
  • Pushes back on client on matters of timeline, scope, feedback, and direction to drive performance based on creative best practices
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

  • Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, and/or similar performance data tools (TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, etc)
  • Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends, insights, and inform creative roadmaps
  • Understanding of best practices for performance-driven creative & ability to apply these insights in work
  • Ability to write effective ad copy, structure a script, and see through on the execution with corresponding visuals
  • Ability to communicate and collaborate with clients, production, and post-production teams to deliver best possible creative output
  • Ability to yield strong campaign results for clients through strategizing top performing creative

Most Important Things (MITs)

About the Role

Founded in 2006, Pirkey Barber is one of the largest firms in the United States focused on trademark, trade dress, copyright, and unfair competition law. We are frequently recognized as one of the leading trademark firms in the country. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, the Pirkey Barber team includes a number of remote attorneys and paralegals, with additional concentrations in the DC, San Francisco and Minneapolis areas.

Our attorneys represent clients around the world in trademark-related matters, including intellectual property litigation, U.S. Patent and Trademark Office proceedings, domain name disputes, trademark policing, clearance, prosecution, portfolio management, trade dress, advertising counseling and false advertising litigation, social media and other online branding issues, and anti-counterfeiting enforcement. We have guided a wide range of extraordinary clients through dynamic shifts in technology and the world economy that have profoundly affected strategies for protecting and enforcing brands and content. We represent clients from a variety of industries, and our attorneys are well-versed in both prosecution and adversarial matters.

The Trademark Paralegal performs a variety of duties for clients under attorney supervision. They maintain positive contact with clients, attorneys, and staff and observe confidentiality of client matters. The successful applicant will be required, as an essential function of this job, to perform work for a variety of Pirkey Barber clients, including religious organizations. The successful applicant must be comfortable advocating on behalf of all firm clients.

For candidates in the Austin, Texas area, this is a hybrid position with in-office requirements. Out-of-state candidates will be considered for a fully remote position.

What You’ll Do

  • Conduct preliminary trademark clearance searches and order comprehensive trademark searches
  • Perform preliminary evaluations of trademark search results
  • Draft, prepare and file U.S. trademark applications, including drafting descriptions of goods and services
  • Prepare and file Extensions of Time, Allegations of Use, post-registration documents, and other standard trademark prosecution documents, to advocate for clients’ applications
  • Identify and capture appropriate trademark specimens from client websites for statement of use or Section 8 and 15 affidavits
  • Research Trademark Manual of Examining Procedure (TMEP) and other applicable law to determine procedural requirements, as requested
  • Draft, send and follow up on correspondence to foreign associates
  • Draft, send, and follow up on correspondence to clients requesting instructions or reporting on the status of their trademark matters
  • Maintain client records
  • Review incoming correspondence, determine appropriate action
  • Review and maintain docket and update as appropriate
  • Share responsibility with attorneys for meeting all deadlines
  • Maintain daily timekeeping for billing purposes, entering time records daily

Pirkey Barber is a growing firm that fosters a team-oriented environment where each employee is expected to assist as needed to ensure that the firm’s clients receive prompt, high-quality service. The trademark paralegal will have set core work hours, but overtime may be required on occasion.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and strong academic record required
  • Five to ten (5-10) years of trademark paralegal experience; law firm experience required
  • Strong sense of accountability, taking ownership over projects and responsibilities and resolving issues proactively
  • High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and excellent proofreading skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to assess information, anticipate issues and outcomes, and make effective decisions

raw.description:
Increasing digitalization makes software security a key prerequisite for trust, resilience, and innovation. This is precisely where we come in.

The National Research Center for Applied Cybersecurity ATHENE is a joint institution of the Fraunhofer Society with the participation of Fraunhofer SIT, Fraunhofer IGD, TU Darmstadt, and Darmstadt University of Applied Sciences. In a unique cooperation model, we combine cutting-edge university and non-university research in the field of cybersecurity.

Fraunhofer SIT is one of the leading research institutions for IT and software security in Germany and Europe. Our focus is not on classic software development, but on the analysis, evaluation, and securing of software.

Be part of change

  • You will work on applied research projects in the field of software security in cooperation with our partners in academic institutions, industry, and public administration
  • Development and scientific evaluation of new methods for detecting, analyzing, verifying, and fixing software vulnerabilities
  • Research into novel methods of static and dynamic program analysis, including fuzzing and the use of AI methods for vulnerability detection
  • Security analyses of real software systems, including:
    • Code reviews
    • Penetration tests and security assessments
    • Risk and threat analyses
  • Collaboration in publicly funded research projects and industry collaborations
  • Preparation of project reports and scientific publications
  • Presentation of research results at national and international confer

What you contribute

  • Completed university degree (master's) in computer science, IT security, or a related discipline
  • Strong interest in software security, program analysis, and security research with a focus on software-driven systems
  • Very good programming skills (e.g., Java, C/C++), with a particular focus on code-level security
  • Experience or interest in one or more of the following areas:
    • Static/dynamic program analysis, fuzzing
    • Pentesting, exploit analysis, vulnerability research
    • Risk/threat modeling
    • Code reviews and penetration testing
  • Very good written and spoken German and English skills

What we offer

  • Collaboration at a renowned, internationally leading institute in the field of cybersecurity
  • Support for your own scientific and professional development in the field of software security, including support for a doctoral project
  • Friendly, open, and collegial working environment with a dynamic and creative working atmosphere
  • Family-friendly work culture with flexible working conditions (various working time models, flexible working locations and hours, mobile working, job ticket subsidy, support services through the pme family service, etc.)
  • Company pension plan, capital-forming benefits, deferred compensation
  • Conveniently located (Darmstadt main station within walking distance in approx. 10 minutes), free parking and efficient charging infrastructure for electric vehicles with preferential conditions for employees, alternatively a centrally located office in Heilbronn

The weekly working time is 39 hours. This position is also available on a part-time basis. We value and promote the diversity of our employees' skills and therefore welcome all applications – regardless of age, gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, ideology, disability, sexual orientation and identity. Severely disabled persons are given preference in the event of equal suitability. Our tasks are diverse and adaptable – for applicants with disabilities, we work together to find solutions that best promote their abilities. Appointment, remuneration and social security benefits based on the public-sector collective wage agreement (TVöD). Additionally Fraunhofer may grant performance-based variable remuneration components.

With its focus on developing key technologies that are vital for the future and enabling the commercial utilization of this work by business and industry, Fraunhofer plays a central role in the innovation process. As a pioneer and catalyst for groundbreaking developments and scientific excellence, Fraunhofer helps shape society now and in the future.

Ready for a change? Then apply now and make a difference! Once we have received your online application, you will receive an automatic confirmation of receipt. We will then get back to you as soon as possible and let you know what happens next.

Fraunhofer Institute for Secure Information Technology SIT

www.sit.fraunhofer.de

The Product Marketing Leader – Analytical Instruments (ANI) (Americas) is a high-impact, strategic leadership position within the Evident Global Product Management & Marketing (PMM) organization. Reporting to the Director, Global Product Marketing for ANI, this role is the primary architect of growth for the AMERICAS region, responsible for driving the go-to-market strategy, tactical execution, customer demand, and product vitality for the entire ANI portfolio (Hardware & Software).

With a continuous pipeline of innovation now reaching the market, the mandate for this role is Strategic Market Growth. This leader will serve as a Commercial Catalyst, providing the deep technical, market expertise and competitive positioning required to gain market share in key industrial segments. This role is a proactive partner to Sales, acting as a Strategic Deal Architect to ensure we successfully displace incumbents and maximize the revenue potential of our renewed product pipeline. The Leader owns ANI performance KPIs in AMERICAS and serves as the strategic bridge between Global PMM vision and Regional Sales execution.

The Product Marketing Leader is the "Voice of AMERICAS," responsible for collecting and reporting high-level market intelligence—including VoC, VoS, win/loss root cause analysis, and competitor trends. This data is critical to ensuring the Global PMM team knows our customers better than anyone else and is used to guide marketing campaigns, product development priorities, and future roadmaps.

This leader must develop deep relationships with strategic customers, industry influencers, and regional sales teams. As the regional representative of Global PMM, you are the key person for the execution of marketing campaigns and the coordination of winning go-to-market activities with Sales, MarCom, Product Management and Operations. You will monitor sales performance against targets, identify issues early, and design targeted interventions to ensure target attainment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

1. Technical Leadership & Field Execution

  • Field-Level Technical Support: Act as the premier technical authority for the AMERICAS region, providing "hands-on" support for complex applications and high-value customer demos
  • Commercial & Customer Training Excellence: Design and lead technical "masterclasses" and refresher training for both sales specialists and key customers. This includes hands-on skill development on critical ANI applications related to metals scrap, QA/QC manufacturing, precious metals, Geoscience but not limited to.
  • Skill Gap Mitigation: Identify and bridge technical/commercial skill gaps within local sales teams. Lead technical onboarding and recurring "refresh" training to ensure field teams can effectively demonstrate the value of our hardware and software innovations.
  • Technical Content Creation: Independently develop and publish educational, demand-driving content, including short-form technical videos, application-specific blogs, and white papers that demonstrate the unique value of the ANI portfolio in solving complex material characterization and identification challenges.
  • Localized Competitive Playbooks: Transform global market intelligence into regional "How-to-Win" battle cards that give the Sales team the edge in head-to-head competitive displacements. In addition, develop detailed "Application Playbooks" for ANI priority segments translating technical specs into winning field-level sales tactics.
  • Demand Generation: Design and execute AMERICAS-specific marketing campaigns, customer webinars, and workshops to build sales momentum and thought leadership in ANI business priority segments.
  • Omnichannel Marketing: Partner with Marketing Communications to ensure lead generation, digital marketing, and sales enablement tools (e.g., Highspot) are localized and effective for the AMERICAS market.

2. Strategic Business Leadership & Market Offensive

  • Offensive Coordinator (Sales Partnership): Act as the primary strategic partner to Regional Sales Managers. Conduct monthly pipeline audits to identify commercial bottlenecks and deploy localized "How-to-Win" competitive playbooks to displace incumbent competitors.
  • Management Visibility & Accountability: Lead monthly Regional Business Reviews (RBR) with senior leadership to report on KPI attainment, market share recovery progress, and the ROI of regional marketing spend.
  • Market Intelligence & Reporting: Maintain a rigorous cadence of regional data collection (VoC, market share, and competitive shifts). Regularly share these insights with the Global PMM team to ensure product roadmaps remain aligned with AMERICAS’s industrial requirements.
  • Portfolio Strategy: Drive the regional commercial strategy for the full ANI ecosystem, including premium hardware, borescopes, and integrated digital/software inspection tools.

3. Operational Excellence & Regional Support

  • Regional "Concierge" Service: Serve as the accountable regional owner to unblock cross-functional bottlenecks between Service, Tech Support, and Logistics, ensuring regional revenue remains fluid and customer escalations are resolved.
  • Asset Readiness & ROI: Optimize the AMERICAS demo and loaner fleet. Ensure high-value assets are strategically deployed to high-potential accounts and maintain discipline regarding fleet health and utilization.
  • Strategic Planning: Create and communicate annual regional marketing plans based on market trends and competitor analysis, ensuring perfect alignment with Global PMM revenue targets.

4. Sales Alignment

  • Sales Specialist Alignment: Act as the primary strategic partner for regional Sales Specialists, providing "How-to-Win" battle cards and real-time competitive intelligence to unblock deals.
  • Governance & Accountability: Monitor sales performance against targets to identify regional issues early and design targeted marketing interventions to ensure target attainment.

Education and/or Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Science, or related field.
  • 5+ Years Product Management and/or Product Marketing and/or Sales Experience

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Knowledge of the science & technology related to ANI business line.
  • Outstanding written and oral communication skills, interpersonal skills in a multi-cultural environment, and an ability to effectively interact at a senior executive level.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in data analysis for strategy development, reporting, and presentation.
  • Ability to execute complex mid-to-long-term projects according to plan coordinating with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 tools, especially Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint.
  • Ability to travel within regions and globally internationally up to 25%.

The pay range would be $120,000 - $150,000 base salary depending on experience plus an annual bonus target.
