raw.excerpt: About the role Learning Sandbox is an education technology consultancy based in Cape Town, South Africa.
raw.description:
About the role

Learning Sandbox is an education technology consultancy based in Cape Town, South Africa. The heartbeat of our business is producing bespoke digital content while also offering strategic, pedagogical and digital asset research, design and production services. We're looking for an exceptionally skilled, knowledgeable and team-oriented learning designer for online learning in critical thinking.

You'll join a multidisciplinary team of high-performance professionals - from subject experts to creatives - who are responsible for developing premium, free-to-use educational content for the digital sphere. You will be part of the team focusing on critical thinking. We're looking for a proactive, forward-thinking individual who can help to unpack and communicate complex technical concepts in simple and accessible ways, keeping learner engagement and motivation front of mind.

This role calls for creativity, initiative, collaboration, and independent judgement. We are looking for someone who takes real ownership of the end product, is comfortable using AI tools to accelerate drafting while critically evaluating and refining outputs, and who can synthesise and evaluate feedback from multiple stakeholders across iterative rounds of review. You'll need to balance teamwork with self-directed execution, and bring a genuinely curious, evidence-based approach to how AI and technology can support (not replace) sound learning design judgement.

We're looking for someone with a passion for philosophy, education and inspiring learners around the globe through meaningful educational experiences. Your primary focus will be new content development, particularly in interactive formats and supporting educator resources that help teachers integrate digital materials into the classroom.

Attributes we value

  • High agency and initiative: You are proactive and comfortable taking ownership of the overall project outcome, not just your individual contribution, and stepping in to help unblock or move work forward when needed.
  • Sound judgement: You critically evaluate and refine AI-assisted work, and are able to justify your choices through sharing your thought process.
  • High personal standard of work: You review and check your own work critically before it is sent for stakeholder review.
  • Adaptability and resilience: You are comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment and manage feedback constructively rather than defensively. You are comfortable applying your skills and expertise to new tools and scenarios.
  • Collaboration: You are comfortable partnering with stakeholders and contributing constructively as part of a team.
  • Conceptual thinking: You contribute meaningfully to the quality of ideas, not just their execution.
  • Clarity of communication: You are able to clearly articulate your ideas, feedback, and reasoning to others.
  • Excellent attention to detail: You execute accurately and consistently against a brief.
  • Tool-agnostic: You are focused on outcomes rather than any particular software or process.

Key responsibilities

  • Take ultimate ownership of projects from initial concept through to final, production-ready delivery, proactively managing deadlines, dependencies, and review cycles.
  • Brainstorm, conceptualise, and develop proposals and scripts for interactive learning experiences focused on analytic philosophy and logic.
  • Direct a cross-functional team of subject matter experts, product designers, engineers, multimedia designers, and faculty to deliver cohesive and engaging learning experiences.
  • Design learning experiences grounded in learning science and pedagogical best practices, connecting analytic philosophy and logic concepts to meaningful, real-world challenges.
  • Exercise sound, independent judgement when translating learning objectives into learning experiences, scripted content, and assessments.
  • Responsibly leverage AI-powered tools to support ideation, scripting, and prototyping, while critically evaluating and refining AI-assisted outputs to ensure quality, accuracy, and original instructional thinking.
  • Analyse user feedback and usage data to identify opportunities to improve learning materials, experiences, and design strategies.
  • Collaborate with product design and engineering teams to research, prototype, and evaluate new approaches and content formats for philosophy learning.
  • Stay current with emerging developments in learning design, learning science, analytic philosophy, and logic, contributing to an internal community of practice.

Requirements: What you'll bring

  • Post-secondary education in philosophy, analytic philosophy, logic or mathematics with 3 or more years of work or teaching experience in relevant fields.
  • 4–5 years of learning design or instructional design experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate AI-generated content, including verifying claims and applying original pedagogical judgement rather than accepting output at face value.
  • Comfort with emerging technologies and a genuine interest in how they reshape content development workflows.
  • Strong problem-solving and people skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear and engaging manner suitable for the target audience.
  • Ability to work well independently as well as collaboratively, with good organisation, time-management skills, and a track record of meeting deadlines without compromising on quality.
  • Willingness to work remotely, very important.
  • MUST BE ELIGIBLE FOR WORK IN SOUTH AFRICA.

Good to have

  • Experience using generative AI capabilities for content development.
  • Experience working with product managers and engineers, especially on learning products.
  • Formal education in learning science, learning design, or teaching.
  • Knowledge of the US education system with a focus on high school.
  • Familiarity with relevant curriculum standards and frameworks.
  • Experience creating content for online learning environments.
  • Experience aligning content to established education standards.

About Us

Health is the most important thing in life, and the American healthcare system is completely broken - poor outcomes, high cost, bad patient experience. We're building a new system from the ground up.

Our mission is to improve people’s health by making it easy to live a healthy lifestyle.

Nourish is the country's largest dietitian-led metabolic health clinic. We’re an AI-native digital health system matching patients with 10,000+ Registered Dietitians, physicians, medications, lab testing, and AI agents to deliver insurance-covered care across all 50 states. Founded four years ago, we've completed millions of appointments, tripled year-over-year, and partnered with health plans covering 200M+ Americans across 250+ health systems.

In 2026 we raised a $100M Series C, bringing total funding to $215M. The round was led by Menlo Ventures, with participation from Thrive Capital, Index Ventures, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners, Maverick Ventures, Y Combinator, BoxGroup, Atomico, Daybreak, and Operator Partners.

Learn more about our Series C here: Nourish Blog, Bloomberg, Fierce Healthcare, Digital Native, The Pulse Podcast.

This is not a job for everyone. We hold an extremely high bar because we believe talent density is our biggest competitive advantage. We're looking for people who actively choose hard, ambiguous problems, who run toward unglamorous work, give and receive candid feedback, and bring relentless resilience without the ego. Our work is important, but we are not self-important. We do this because we’re solving one of the hardest problems in the world, and the problem matters. If that's you, we disproportionately reward it.

About the Role

Reporting directly to our Credentialing Manager, the Credentialing / Enrollments Lead will own day-to-day execution for our New Bets Credentialing or Enrollments pod. We're hiring for a number of roles and will make sure we match you with the best fit opportunity. You will translate credentialing or enrollments strategy into a clear operating plan, and oversee the virtual-assistant capacity supporting your workflows.

This role is critical to scaling Nourish’s provider network as we add payers, providers, provider types, and delegated arrangements. You will maintain a high bar for quality and compliance, ensure new-provider workflows do not become a growth bottleneck, and build the systems, team capabilities, and operating rhythms needed to support rapid growth toward 25,000+ providers.

This role is full-time and open to fully remote or NYC-based candidates.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and support a pod of New Bets Credentialing or Enrollments Associates or Senior Associates, setting priorities, clarifying ownership and deadlines, reviewing work quality, giving feedback, and holding the team accountable for outcomes.
  • Direct virtual-assistant capacity supporting the pod, including work allocation, training, quality assurance, and performance monitoring.
  • Own complex credentialing programs end to end, including payer enrollments, workflows for credentialing Medical Doctors, Nurse Practitioners and Therapists, ongoing monitoring, and delegated credentialing operations.
  • Build and maintain clear SOPs, operating cadences, quality controls, documentation standards, escalation paths, and audit-ready records.
  • Use metrics to manage capacity, throughput, timeliness, quality, provider experience, and execution risk; identify gaps early and lead practical improvement plans.
  • Investigate ambiguous payer, provider, or operational issues using data and primary sources; make sound tradeoffs across speed, compliance, provider experience, business impact, and cost.
  • Design scalable workflows and recommend tooling, automation, and ownership improvements in partnership with Product, Engineering, Payer Ops, Finance, RCM, Clinical Ops, and Customer Experience.
  • Serve as the day-to-day escalation point for the area you own, resolving blockers independently and escalating material risks with clear recommendations.
  • Communicate decisions, owners, deadlines, risks, and next steps clearly to team members, leaders, payers, providers, and cross-functional partners.
  • Build team capability by coaching associates into stronger owners and future leaders while ensuring reliable delivery against goals.

We’d love to hear from you if:

  • You have approximately 5–9 years of experience in payer enrollment, credentialing, provider operations, healthcare operations, or a closely related field for Registered Dietitians
  • You have meaningful credentialing domain depth across payer enrollment, provider onboarding, ongoing monitoring, delegated credentialing, accreditation, or related workflows.
  • You have demonstrated people-leadership experience, including setting priorities, directing work, giving feedback, managing performance, and developing team members.
  • You have owned complex operational programs with rigorous quality, compliance, documentation, and deadline requirements.
  • You use metrics to manage capacity, throughput, quality, timeliness, and execution risk.
  • You are a strong written and verbal communicator who can simplify complex operational or regulatory issues for different audiences.
  • You are tech-savvy and have experience improving processes through tooling, automation, or partnership with Product and Engineering.
  • You are flexible, adaptable, and effective in fast-changing conditions.
